INC_001.short_description: Locked out of SSO after password expiry
INC_001.description: User reports being locked out of the SSO portal after their password expired over the weekend. Cannot reach email or WMS.
INC_001.worknotes: Verified identity against directory record. Unlock issued, reset link sent.
INC_001.resolution_notes: Account unlocked and password reset completed. User confirmed SSO login works.

INC_002.short_description: WMS account password reset needed before shift
INC_002.description: Warehouse operator cannot log in to the WMS client and needs a password reset before the morning pick window.

INC_003.description: User working remotely reports the VPN client drops the tunnel every 20-30 minutes and has to reconnect manually each time.
INC_003.worknotes: Reproduced disconnects in client logs. Rebuilt VPN profile, updated client version.
INC_003.resolution_notes: VPN client updated and profile rebuilt. Stable for 48 hours per user.

INC_004.short_description: Cannot reach the logistics network share
INC_004.description: User cannot open the logistics department share from their laptop; drive mapping fails with a network path error.
INC_004.worknotes: Checked share permissions and drive mapping script. Re-added user to share group.
INC_004.resolution_notes: Share group membership corrected; drive maps on login.

INC_007.short_description: WMS client freezes during order picking
INC_007.description: WMS client freezes intermittently while scanning items during picking, forcing a restart and losing the current tote.
INC_007.worknotes: Collected client logs. Freeze correlates with the label print call.
INC_007.resolution_notes: Reinstalled WMS client and cleared the local print queue cache; no further freezes reported.
INC_007.close_notes: Warehouse lead confirmed stable picking for a full shift.

INC_008.short_description: Shared mailbox not syncing new mail
INC_008.description: The dispatch shared mailbox stopped showing new messages since this morning; two teams are working from it.

INC_010.short_description: Printer jams on every duplex job

INC_010.worknotes: Field tech inspected rollers, cleaned feed path, test prints queued.
INC_010.resolution_notes: Replaced worn duplex rollers; twenty duplex test pages printed clean.

INC_011.worknotes: Re-flashed scanner firmware and re-paired to tablet.
INC_011.resolution_notes: Scanner re-paired after firmware update; scans registering in WMS.

INC_014.worknotes: Provisioning checklist started: directory account, mailbox, WMS role, laptop from spares.
INC_014.resolution_notes: All accounts provisioned and laptop assigned; starter can log in on day one.

INC_015.description: User requests access to the dispatch shared mailbox to cover a colleague on leave.
INC_015.worknotes: Manager approval captured on ticket. Delegation added.
INC_015.resolution_notes: Access granted to the shared mailbox; visible in user's client.
INC_015.close_notes: Caller confirmed they can see the mailbox.

INC_016.resolution_notes: Software installed after license approval. Procedure link shared for future requests.

INC_033.short_description: Request to add/edit shipment tracking flags in WMS
INC_033.description: Hi, I'd like to be able to add tracking flags when Dispatch Operations needs new ones created. I already have some flag-editing permissions in WMS, but tracking flags aren't included in that set.
INC_033.worknotes: An agent reviewed the WMS role configuration and found that creating or editing tracking flags is hardcoded to the WMS Administrator role rather than exposed as a configurable permission, and discussed with the WMS admin team whether to add the Dispatch Operations lead role to that check or build a configurable permissions screen later. The WMS admin team updated the application so the Dispatch Operations lead role can create and edit shipment tracking flags directly, without granting full WMS Administrator access, and logged a follow-up to add a proper permissions screen later; the request was prioritized so Dispatch Operations wouldn't be blocked on updating flags they own.

INC_034.short_description: Create WMS role group for dispatch job permissions
INC_034.description: Please create a new WMS role group called "dispatch-ops" so we can manage permissions to the dispatch job scheduler. It should include me and one other dispatcher to start. Thank you!
INC_034.worknotes: Agent created the role group and added the requested members; a third team member was added to the group after a follow-up request in the thread. The WMS role group was created with all requested members, and each member logged out of the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com and back in to sync the new group into the WMS Application.

INC_035.short_description: New hire access setup: SSO groups, WMS role, network shares, and VPN Client profiles
INC_035.description: I have a new hire starting on the Network Operations team and they need a full round of access set up: SSO portal groups for the ops wikis, the dispatch dashboard, the internal directory, and our Slack channel; a WMS inventory role; network share access for the team and company-wide shares; and several Westfield VPN Client profiles, including source control, DNS management, firewall management, and vCenter access. Can you get all of this added to their account?
INC_035.worknotes: Agent added the SSO portal groups, WMS inventory role, network shares, and all requested VPN Client profiles to the new hire's account, checking each against the standard Network Operations access list.
INC_035.resolution_notes: All requested access was granted except the reporting/analytics tool, which needs a separate request to the Analytics team since they provision those accounts directly.
INC_035.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that the new hire now has SSO, WMS, network share, and VPN access, and that the analytics tool request needs to go to the Analytics team separately.

INC_036.short_description: Disable unused WMS shipment status flag
INC_036.description: Can we turn off the dock-release status flag in the WMS? It was mainly used by a dispatcher who left the company, and it's only been applied to one shipment since April 2018. Nobody else seems to rely on it anymore.
INC_036.worknotes: Agent pulled the WMS flag usage history, confirming only a single use since April 2018, then checked with the WMS system owner to confirm removal would not affect current workflows. The WMS system owner confirmed it was fine to remove; the agent deactivated the dock-release status flag in the WMS application.

INC_037.short_description: VPN Client access for network ops team to reach Chicago and Dallas monitoring consoles
INC_037.description: Requesting VPN Client access for the network operations group so we can reach the monitoring servers at our Chicago HQ and Dallas DC data centers. We need this to review device groups and monitoring status for our warehouse network hosts through the monitoring console's web interface, due to the transition of our monitoring operations center. Please add me and three other team members to the access group.
INC_037.worknotes: Agent checked existing VPN Client access groups and found none that granted access to both data center monitoring consoles.
INC_037.resolution_notes: Agent created a new VPN Client access group scoped to the Chicago HQ and Dallas DC monitoring consoles and added the caller and their three teammates to it.

INC_038.short_description: WMS defect reports fail with "must select OS" error for Mobile Picking category
INC_038.description: When I try to submit a defect report under the Mobile Picking - General category in WMS, it comes back with an error saying I must select or enter an OS before it will let me submit. I've attached a screenshot of the error. Shouldn't that field just default automatically like it does everywhere else?
INC_038.worknotes: Agent noted the OS field is supposed to default automatically per the WMS submission form documentation, and checked with the WMS config team whether the Mobile Picking - General category had that default set.
INC_038.resolution_notes: The WMS config team found the default operating system value was missing for that category and set it to "All," along with the default platform value; the caller then resubmitted the defect report successfully.

INC_039.short_description: Add automated inventory sync account to WMS write-access role
INC_039.description: Our automated inventory sync service needs write access to the Dallas distribution centre records in the WMS so it can push route updates. Right now the account isn't in the right role and the sync job is failing.
INC_039.worknotes: Agent confirmed the request was authorized and added the automated sync service account to the WMS write-access role scoped to the Dallas distribution centre.
INC_039.resolution_notes: The service account was granted the WMS write-access role, restoring automated route updates to the Dallas distribution centre.

INC_040.short_description: SSO Portal account disabled over email delivery issues
INC_040.description: My SSO portal account was disabled because the system flagged issues delivering email to my address, and now I can't log in to check my schedule or messages. I'm reaching out to get the account turned back on.
INC_040.worknotes: The agent had already reactivated the caller's account after the caller reached out directly over Slack chat, so the request wasn't visible in the queue until the caller followed up; the agent noted the access team should be looped in on these going forward.
INC_040.resolution_notes: The agent manually re-enabled the SSO portal account and confirmed the caller's email address was correct, noting the automated bounce-detection on the email delivery system has been unreliable.

INC_041.short_description: Grant WMS staging and production access for SKU catalog review
INC_041.description: I need a colleague on my team to be added to the WMS staging and production access groups so they can review recent changes to the SKU catalog collection. This is related to an update we made to how catalog categories are configured.
INC_041.worknotes: The access team verified the requested groups and confirmed the colleague did not already have staging or production access to the WMS Application.
INC_041.resolution_notes: The access team added the colleague to both the WMS staging and production access groups, granting the review access requested.
INC_041.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that the colleague now has the requested access and the request is complete.

INC_042.short_description: Warehouse associate requests WMS editor role after submitting change requests
INC_042.description: I've submitted two change requests through the WMS, reference numbers WMS-40213 and WMS-40889. Could I get editor permissions so I can mark WMS-40213 as needing follow-up documentation myself instead of asking someone else each time?
INC_042.worknotes: Agent reviewed the caller's WMS submission history, confirmed two completed change requests, and added the caller to the WMS editor role group.
INC_042.resolution_notes: Editor permissions were granted in the WMS application so the caller can update ticket flags on their own submitted records going forward.
INC_042.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that they can now flag the record as needing documentation.

INC_043.short_description: Request new tracking category under WMS Application for a Remote Agent diagnostics tool
INC_043.description: I'd like to request a new tracking category under the WMS Application area for upcoming work on a low-level remote diagnostics interface for our handheld scanners, based on a new device debugging protocol. I think 'Remote Agent' would be a good name for it. I'm fine being listed as the triage owner, and let me know if you need a longer, more official description.
INC_043.worknotes: Agent asked the caller for the category name, the parent application area, and a fuller description before it could be created; caller confirmed the name as 'Remote Agent' under WMS Application and described it as a low-level interface to inspect scanner device state, control running processes, simulate warehouse staff interaction for automated testing, and debug scanner application code. The access team created the 'Remote Agent' tracking category under the WMS Application area with the description the caller supplied and set the caller as triage owner.

INC_044.short_description: Update DNS CNAME for WMS help forum to new hosting target
INC_044.description: The WMS help forum we host outside our network keeps having reliability issues and needs to be redirected to a new host. Can someone update the DNS CNAME for the forum's hostname to the new target our hosting vendor gave us? It handles automatic SSL certificate renewal, so it should just need the DNS record updated.
INC_044.worknotes: Updated the internal DNS CNAME record for the forum hostname from the old load-balancer target to the new hosting target the caller provided, and confirmed propagation a few minutes later. When the caller reported the automated SSL certificate request was failing with a redirect-not-forwarding error, the agent had them retry the certificate issuance. The DNS cutover completed successfully and the certificate issuance failure cleared on a manual retry, treated as a one-time provisioning hiccup rather than a DNS misconfiguration.

INC_045.short_description: Re-enable former employee's SSO account and move it to personal email
INC_045.description: The caller says they left Westfield Logistics a few weeks ago but still need to get into their SSO Portal account to follow up on some incident reports they filed in the WMS. Their company email is gone, so they're asking to have the account switched over to their personal email address.
INC_045.worknotes: Agent confirmed the caller's identity through their former manager before making changes, reset MFA on the account, and removed all WMS roles except the read-only incident reporter role. The account email was set to a temporary placeholder address pending confirmation the caller actually controlled the personal email. Account was reset with the temporary placeholder email; the caller logged in successfully, confirmed control of their personal email, and updated the account and username themselves.

INC_046.short_description: Create new WMS project category for Falcon scanner pilot
INC_046.description: Please set up a new project category called "Falcon" with a "General" component in the WMS issue tracker. Falcon is a new handheld scanner app we're piloting at the Dallas distribution centre to redesign how drivers scan and confirm pallets on the floor. Please mirror the security group settings from the Kestrel project, and loop that team in if you have any questions.
INC_046.worknotes: Agent created the Falcon category with the General component and copied the security group from the Kestrel project, then followed up to ask whether General should be limited to security-sensitive issues, since the caller flagged it could otherwise catch items that belong elsewhere.
INC_046.resolution_notes: The Falcon category and General component were created in the WMS issue tracker with security group permissions mirrored from the existing Kestrel project, as requested.
INC_046.close_notes: Caller confirmed the category was in place and said they'd follow up separately on narrowing the General component's scope.

INC_047.short_description: VPN Client access needed for new warehouse equipment lab role
INC_047.description: I'm taking over management of the handheld scanner and equipment lab at the Dallas distribution centre, and I need Westfield VPN Client access to reach the lab systems remotely. Can you add me to the right access group for that?
INC_047.worknotes: Agent granted the caller VPN access for the Dallas equipment lab role. Access was added to the caller's account; they were advised to disconnect and reconnect their Westfield VPN Client session to pick up the change.

INC_048.short_description: Admin access to intranet site needed for stage and production
INC_048.description: Hi! I'm not sure which category to pick for this, but I need admin access to the intranet (intranet.westfieldlogistics.com) for both the staging and production environments. I'm the new UX/UI designer on the Digital Workplace team.
INC_048.worknotes: Agent routed the request to the access team for sign-off before creating an elevated account, since it involved admin-level rights on a production system. The access team approved the request, and an admin account was created for the caller covering both the staging and production intranet environments.

INC_049.short_description: Level 3 WMS access request for distribution center rollout work
INC_049.description: I need Level 3 access to the Warehouse Management System for upcoming work on the new distribution center rollout. I already have Level 1 access and have signed off on the access policy, so I just need my access level bumped.
INC_049.worknotes: Agent confirmed the caller already holds Level 1 WMS access with a signed policy agreement on file, so no new agreement was needed; ticket was held open pending a second supervisor sign-off to approve the Level 3 request. A second supervisor reviewed and approved the caller's Level 3 WMS access request, citing their strong work on the distribution center project, and the access team provisioned the elevated role.

INC_050.short_description: Password reset needed to use company SSO account for WMS override access
INC_050.description: I tried to submit an override in the WMS yesterday but was denied, with a message saying Level 3 override access is required. Checking my account, it looks like I've been logging in with my personal account instead of my Westfield company account, which actually has the right access levels assigned. Can you reset the password on my company account so I can log in myself and do the override?
INC_050.worknotes: The agent checked the caller's Westfield account and confirmed it already had the correct WMS access levels assigned, and that the caller had been signing in with a personal account instead of their company one. The agent reset the password on the caller's Westfield account and had them log into the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com to set up MFA, noting that if using the Duo app they should register the account as a "tablet" rather than a "phone".

INC_051.short_description: Add caller's account to WMS release-management role group
INC_051.description: Hi, can you add my account to the release-management role group in the WMS so my user inherits the scopes I need for that work? Thanks!
INC_051.worknotes: An agent vouched for the caller and checked the group, but was initially looking at the wrong account and found nothing to change; after locating the correct account, they added it to the role group.
INC_051.resolution_notes: The access team added the caller's account to the WMS release-management role group and had them log out of the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com and back in to pick up the new scopes.

INC_052.short_description: Network security team needs VPN access to internal IP history lookup tool
INC_052.description: Can our network security team get Westfield VPN Client access to the internal tool that lets us look up which host an IP address was assigned to, even after the host record has been deleted? This comes up during incident response when we're handed an IP with no forward or reverse DNS record and need to see its history. Please add the team to whatever VPN access list controls that tool.
INC_052.worknotes: An agent added the requested team members to the VPN Client access list for the internal IP-lookup tool, noting access would be available once each machine disconnected and reconnected from VPN. When the caller later reported that one team member still couldn't get in, the agent checked the access list and found that person had already been included.
INC_052.resolution_notes: The rest of the team confirmed working access after the VPN reconnect; since the access list already showed the reportedly-missing team member as included, the agent asked the caller to describe the exact failure being seen rather than making an unneeded change.

INC_053.short_description: Level 1 WMS write access request for a dispatch teammate
INC_053.description: Please set up Level 1 write access in the WMS for a colleague on our dispatch team so they can commit inventory adjustment transactions. I've read and agree to abide by the WMS access requirements policy, and I can vouch that they are a trusted team member who completed the required training.
INC_053.worknotes: The access team waited for vouching confirmation from two other trusted colleagues before proceeding, since a second and third vouch came in on the ticket confirming the requester's standing. The access team enabled the account in the WMS, applied the Level 1 write role, and added the required access key, noting the change could take up to an hour to propagate.

INC_054.short_description: VPN access to WMS staging console for QA testing
INC_054.description: I'd like VPN access so I can reach the WMS staging console for QA testing. Can this be set up on my account?
INC_054.worknotes: Agent verified the request with the caller's manager, granted Westfield VPN Client access, and provisioned a test account on the WMS staging console.
INC_054.resolution_notes: VPN permission was granted and a WMS staging test account was created for the caller.
INC_054.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that they can now reach the WMS staging console over VPN.

INC_055.short_description: Review and update WMS issue-tag glossary descriptions to name WMS specifically
INC_055.description: Several tag descriptions in the WMS issue-tag glossary on intranet.westfieldlogistics.com still say "Westfield" generically instead of naming the specific system - for example, the display/formatting bug tag should say "WMS application" instead of "Westfield," and the freeze/hang tag should say "WMS application freeze" instead of a generic "Westfield freeze." Could someone go through the glossary and tighten up the wording where it's actually about the WMS specifically rather than Westfield in general?
INC_055.worknotes: An agent updated the three tag descriptions the caller had flagged directly and closed the ticket. The caller thanked the agent for the three updates but noted they had expected to review the rest of the glossary together before any further changes were made; the agent apologized for missing that part, reopened the ticket, and offered to go through the remaining entries together.

INC_056.short_description: Level 1 WMS access request with SSH key attached for integration login
INC_056.description: I need Level 1 elevated access to the Warehouse Management System so I can push inventory updates directly through the integration login. I've attached my SSH public key for that account. Let me know what else is needed to get this approved.
INC_056.worknotes: Agent advised the caller that a manager's approval and a signed acknowledgment of the Elevated Access Requirements policy were required before the request could move forward; caller agreed to the requirements and their manager approved the request on the ticket.
INC_056.resolution_notes: With the manager approval and policy acknowledgment on file, the request was handed off to the access team, who provisioned the Level 1 WMS integration account using the submitted SSH key.
INC_056.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that the Level 1 WMS account was active and the integration login was working.

INC_057.short_description: WMS Level 1 write access request with SSH key attached
INC_057.description: I have read and agree to abide by the WMS Access Requirements. I'm requesting Level 1 write access for integration work tied to WMS change request #1524665. Please use my current Westfield network login for account setup — I've attached my SSH public key.
INC_057.worknotes: Two colleagues from the WMS integration team vouched for the caller based on prior work on related modules; the access team looped in the appropriate approvers to process the request.
INC_057.resolution_notes: Level 1 WMS write access was enabled and the caller's SSH key was added to the system; the caller was told to allow up to 1 hour for the changes to propagate.

INC_058.short_description: Request for Level 3 WMS access for warehouse supervisor
INC_058.description: Hi, now that I've been working at Westfield Logistics for a few years, I think it's time I get Level 3 access on the WMS. My WMS username is the same as always, and my device credentials are the same as what I registered in an earlier ticket.
INC_058.worknotes: Confirmed the caller met the tenure and eligibility criteria for Level 3 WMS access; the access team requires two supervisor vouches before this tier can be granted, so one was requested from the caller's manager and another from a second supervisor. One supervisor vouched right away; the second sign-off was delayed after the request email was buried in the approving supervisor's inbox, but once it came through the access team provisioned Level 3 WMS access on the caller's account.

INC_059.short_description: Request for WMS record-edit access from a frequent shipment-log contributor
INC_059.description: I've been adding correction notes to several shipment records in the WMS, including a couple that are already marked resolved and one that links back to a related order, but I can't edit them directly without editor access. Can you grant me edit permissions on those records? I can also help clean up tracking exception ranges if you give me access to that field too.
INC_059.worknotes: Agent reviewed the caller's WMS activity history, verified the specific shipment records they referenced, and submitted a role change request to grant edit permissions. WMS editor role was applied to the caller's account, giving them permission to edit shipment records and tracking exception ranges.

INC_060.short_description: Warehouse associate requests Editor role for WMS discrepancy tickets
INC_060.description: I've been actively contributing to the discrepancy tracking process in WMS for a while now, submitting corrections whenever I catch errors in the records. I'd like to be able to edit these tickets directly so I can take part in the review discussions more fully instead of just submitting fixes for someone else to apply. I'm including two discrepancy tickets I've corrected recently as examples — there are more under my account if you need them.
INC_060.worknotes: Access team reviewed the caller's contribution history in WMS, including the two discrepancy tickets referenced, and confirmed a consistent pattern of accurate corrections. Editor role was added to the caller's WMS account, granting permission to edit discrepancy tickets directly.

INC_061.short_description: Level 1 WMS access request for upcoming release rollout work
INC_061.description: Requesting Level 1 access to the WMS application for upcoming work on the new release rollout. A coworker is vouching for me on this request.
INC_061.worknotes: A colleague vouched for the caller; the request was rerouted from the account provisioning queue to the access team, who picked it up and processed it. The access team enabled Level 1 WMS access on the caller's account. An existing login credential was already on file and can be self-administered via the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com.

INC_062.short_description: Add ability to manage membership for Portland branch WMS role group
INC_062.description: Since there is little overlap between the Dallas distribution centre and Portland branch incident-review teams, we want to keep the two groups separate. To do that I need the ability to add and remove people from the Portland branch WMS role group, the same way I already can for the Dallas DC role group.
INC_062.worknotes: The access team granted the caller manage-membership rights on a WMS role group tied to the Dallas DC bug-tracking area. The caller reported the rights had been applied to the wrong group; the access team corrected the assignment so the caller can add and remove members of the Portland branch WMS role group specifically.

INC_063.short_description: Level 1 WMS Access for New Dallas Dispatcher
INC_063.description: I'm a new dispatcher starting at the Dallas distribution center and need Level 1 access set up in the Warehouse Management System. I've read and agree to abide by the WMS access requirements, and my manager has confirmed they're vouching for me to get this access.
INC_063.worknotes: Agent verified the caller's policy acknowledgment and the manager's vouch, then got sign-off from the access team lead before creating the account. The access team provisioned a new account with Level 1 WMS role, network share access, and VPN Client credentials, and emailed the temporary password to the caller.

INC_064.short_description: WMS Level 3 access request for new Warehouse Automation team member
INC_064.description: As a new member of the Warehouse Automation team, I need WMS access to do my job. I've attached my public key for setting up the secure connection, and I also need access to our team's network share, though I'm not sure if this is the right place to request that. I've read and agree to the WMS access requirements.
INC_064.worknotes: Two team members vouched for the caller before the request was routed to the access team, who confirmed the network share access was also needed for the role. The access team granted WMS Level 3 access, added the caller's SSH key for the secure connection, and granted access to the requested network share.

INC_065.short_description: Manual exceptions requested for auto-generated Dallas DC distribution list
INC_065.description: We have a request from two people who moved out of the Dallas distribution centre team but were wondering if they can still receive email sent to the auto-generated dallasdc-all distribution list. Let us know if just making an exception for those two people makes sense, or if adding a separate subscribable list feeding into dallasdc-all would be a better option.
INC_065.worknotes: Checked with the distribution list owner, who was fine adding manual exceptions. The request had come through an executive assistant on behalf of the two staff members, so the agent added exceptions for them. Manual exceptions were added for the two staff members on the dallasdc-all distribution list; the change would appear after the next overnight directory sync, within about an hour.

INC_066.short_description: Deactivate SSO Portal accounts for three departing employees
INC_066.description: The caller is asking IT to deactivate the SSO Portal accounts for three employees who are leaving Westfield Logistics staff. Those three will instead need contractor-tier portal accounts, but the caller says a separate request will be submitted for that once this one is closed.
INC_066.worknotes: An agent located the three accounts in the SSO Portal and deactivated them as requested. All three SSO Portal accounts were deactivated; the caller was reminded to file a separate request for the replacement contractor accounts.

INC_067.short_description: Update DNS/hostname records for internal WMS portal domain
INC_067.description: The hostname records for our warehouse system's public address look misaligned. Can IT set the root domain (wms.westfieldlogistics.com) as an ALIAS/ANAME to the hosting provider's assigned hostname, and the www subdomain as a CNAME to its own assigned hostname? Please reopen if anything still needs adjusting after this is done.
INC_067.worknotes: An agent updated the hostname records as requested, but the caller expected the www subdomain to canonically redirect to the root domain rather than point at a separate provider hostname; a second agent confirmed the intent was for one hostname to be canonical with an enforced redirect, then found the root domain still wasn't resolving and re-verified the required records with the hosting provider. Investigation found the CDN/edge provider was rejecting the apex-level alias record, which appears to be why the root domain wasn't resolving; the agent was still digging into the CDN configuration when the ticket notes end, with no confirmed fix logged.

INC_068.short_description: VPN Access to WMS Staging & Production Console for New Hire
INC_068.description: We need a new warehouse operations analyst set up on the Westfield VPN Client so they can reach the WMS staging and production consoles. Please add them under the warehouse-ops VPN profile. Looping in their manager for approval.
INC_068.worknotes: Agent confirmed the manager's approval, then added the caller's new hire to the warehouse-ops VPN Client access profile and provisioned their WMS console account.
INC_068.resolution_notes: The user was granted VPN access via the warehouse-ops profile and their account was set up in the WMS console for staging and production.
INC_068.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that VPN and WMS console access were both working for the new hire.

INC_069.short_description: Request VPN access to WMS delivery console on prod and stage
INC_069.description: Hi, I need VPN access to the delivery console on staging and production so I can do my job. Can you set this up for me?
INC_069.worknotes: The access team checked and found that Westfield VPN Client access to the WMS delivery console had already been granted by another member of the access team.
INC_069.resolution_notes: VPN access to the WMS delivery console on both staging and production was already provisioned before the ticket was picked up, so no further action was needed.
INC_069.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that they can reach the delivery console on both environments via the Westfield VPN Client.

INC_070.short_description: Deactivate accounts for two departed employees
INC_070.description: Two people at our Dallas distribution center left the company this week and their Westfield accounts are still active. Please delete their accounts so they no longer have access to any systems.
INC_070.worknotes: The access team located both accounts in the SSO portal, verified them against the departure notice from HR, and proceeded with deactivation.
INC_070.resolution_notes: Both accounts were disabled and removed from Outlook/Exchange and the SSO portal, revoking all system access.

INC_071.short_description: Locked out of SSO Portal after missing password update deadline
INC_071.description: I missed the window to update my SSO portal password and now I'm locked out of my account. I can't get into my email, Westfield Drive, or anything else. Can someone reset it for me?
INC_071.worknotes: Agent verified the caller's identity and reset the password through the SSO portal admin console. Password was reset and a confirmation email was sent to the caller's Outlook inbox; caller was told that if email access was also unavailable, they'd need to contact the service desk directly for a temporary password.

INC_072.short_description: Request for edit permissions on WMS ticket tracker
INC_072.description: I've been an active night-shift tester for 8 years and have logged more than 100 issues in the Warehouse Management System over that time. I'm especially active on the shipment-scanning module. Can I get edit permissions on the ticket tracker so I can update the issues I file?
INC_072.worknotes: Agent reviewed the caller's WMS ticket history, confirming a long track record of active, quality reports, before approving the elevated role.
INC_072.resolution_notes: Edit permissions were granted on the caller's WMS ticketing account.
INC_072.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that the new permissions were working as expected.

INC_073.short_description: WMS Application access (Level 1) requested for new Dallas warehouse intern
INC_073.description: I'm starting my internship at the Dallas distribution center and need Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System to begin working. I've attached the key file that was requested for the account setup, and I confirm I've read and agree to the WMS access requirements.
INC_073.worknotes: The agent asked for a manager to vouch for the request before provisioning; the caller's manager confirmed the caller is interning at the Dallas distribution center and vouched for the access. The access team created the WMS account and emailed the login information to the caller, then followed up twice asking the caller to confirm access; no confirmation was logged before the ticket was closed.

INC_074.description: Hi, could someone reset my password for the SSO portal? I'm locked out and can't log in to check my schedule.
INC_074.worknotes: Agent verified the caller's identity before making any account changes. Agent reset the password for the caller's SSO Portal account.

INC_075.short_description: Request for export of Westfield-owned internal hostname list
INC_075.description: I'd like an updated list of hostnames we own across our sites. Can you either grant me read access to the hostname registry tool, or export a list of everything we currently have registered?
INC_075.worknotes: Ticket was routed to the network team; the assigned engineer exported a spreadsheet of registered hostnames instead of granting direct tool access.
INC_075.resolution_notes: The network team provided a spreadsheet listing all Westfield hostnames with a status column; since there was no documentation for the status codes in the tool itself, the caller worked out they could filter out entries marked client action required, closed, expired, and deleted to isolate the active list.

INC_076.short_description: Grant Tier 3 WMS role to match access on other account
INC_076.description: I already have Tier 3 access in the Warehouse Management System under my other account. Can that same level be granted to my Westfield account too? Previous approvals for this are documented in an earlier ticket. Thanks!
INC_076.worknotes: Routed to the access team, who picked up the request and verified the prior approvals referenced by the caller before making the change.
INC_076.resolution_notes: The access team granted Tier 3 WMS role access on the caller's Westfield account, matching the level already approved on their other account.
INC_076.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that Tier 3 WMS access is now active on their Westfield account.

INC_077.short_description: VPN Client Access (Tier 1) Needed for New Developer Building China Import Module
INC_077.description: I'm the new developer working on the China import routing module for Westfield Drive. To build and test it I need Tier 1 VPN Client access, and I've attached my public key for the connection.
INC_077.worknotes: The caller confirmed they had read and agreed to the VPN Client access requirements, and their manager vouched for the request before the access team proceeded. The access team granted Tier 1 VPN Client access and added the caller's public key, then asked them to disconnect and reconnect to confirm.

INC_078.short_description: VPN Client access request for Portland dispatcher pending supervisor vouch
INC_078.description: I've attached my SSH public key for the VPN Client setup. I have read, and agree to abide by, the Remote Access Requirements. Let me know what else is needed to get connected.
INC_078.worknotes: Agent explained the caller needed a supervisor to vouch for the request before it could move forward; a colleague from the caller's team vouched, and the ticket was routed to the access team for account creation.
INC_078.resolution_notes: The access team created the VPN Client account for the caller once the vouch was on record.
INC_078.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that VPN Client access was active and the connection worked.

INC_079.short_description: VPN and WMS access not fully restored after parental leave
INC_079.description: I just got back from parental leave and need my access restored - it looks like a bunch of my groups were dropped while I was out. Can someone re-add me to the Westfield VPN Client groups I had before?
INC_079.worknotes: Agent re-added the caller's previously dropped VPN Client groups; caller followed up that the WMS dispatch-admin role might still be missing, since the WMS admin console was rejecting their login even when reached through otp.westfieldlogistics.com.
INC_079.resolution_notes: Re-adding the caller to the WMS dispatch-admin role put them under a different password expiration policy, which expired their password immediately and was causing the login failures; the agent reset the password to fix it.
INC_079.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that VPN and WMS access, including login through the SSO portal, were fully restored.

INC_080.short_description: Level 1 WMS integration access request with public key setup
INC_080.description: I'd like to request Level 1 integration access to the WMS scripting interface for automated inventory reports. I've attached my public key and confirm I've read and agree to the WMS integration access requirements. Please set up the account using my Westfield Logistics email on file.
INC_080.worknotes: A colleague on the logistics ops team vouched for the request, so the access team provisioned the WMS integration account and emailed the account details to the caller for confirmation.
INC_080.resolution_notes: When the caller tested the connection they got a 'Permission denied (publickey)' error; the access team made a small change to the account's key configuration and asked the caller to retry, which resolved the issue.

INC_081.short_description: Restore WMS application access disabled due to inactivity
INC_081.description: My access to the WMS test environment expired because I hadn't logged in for a while. I'm now running test cases for a scanning workflow change and need my access restored so I can verify it works before it goes live. When I tried logging in, the system found my account but told me WMS access is currently disabled due to inactivity.
INC_081.worknotes: Agent verified the caller's account was still valid but flagged as inactive, and asked the access team to re-enable WMS access for the account.
INC_081.resolution_notes: The access team re-enabled the caller's WMS access.
INC_081.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that they were able to log back into WMS.

INC_082.short_description: Account provisioning: WMS Level 1 role for new warehouse hire
INC_082.description: I need an account set up with Level 1 access in the Warehouse Management System so I can start making inventory edits. I've attached the public key file needed for VPN authentication. I have read, and agree to abide by, the WMS Access Requirements.
INC_082.worknotes: The caller's manager vouched for the request; the access team verified the attached VPN public key before provisioning the account. Account was created with the WMS Level 1 role, VPN Client access, and a network share added; temporary password was emailed to the caller.

INC_083.short_description: Level 3 WMS access request for a dispatch supervisor
INC_083.description: Requesting Level 3 access in the Warehouse Management System, using the same employee login and workstation as my earlier Level 1 request. My second approver is... myself, since I already hold supervisor-level access in the system. My first approver signed off on my original Level 1 request.
INC_083.worknotes: Agent flagged the self-approval as an unusual edge case and asked for one more supervisor approval per policy before proceeding; a second dispatch supervisor then approved the Level 3 request. With two supervisor approvals on file, the ticket was routed to the access team for account provisioning and the Level 3 WMS role was granted.

INC_084.short_description: Unblock former employee's SSO Portal login after MFA failure
INC_084.description: Filing this on behalf of a former employee who can't log into the SSO portal. He says his account still has 2FA enabled but it won't accept his code, and when he tried a password reset it wouldn't go through either. He's asking if the 2FA can just be turned off so he can get back in.
INC_084.worknotes: The access team checked the account and found the MFA enrollment had been orphaned when the caller's employment status changed, which was blocking both the code prompt and the reset flow.
INC_084.resolution_notes: The access team cleared the MFA hold on the account so the caller could log back into the SSO portal; a follow-up request to also grant him elevated WMS permissions was opened as a separate ticket rather than handled here.
INC_084.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that the account now logs in without issue.

INC_085.description: I need Level 1 access to the WMS Application integration environment. I've attached my SSH public key (id_rsa.pub). I have read, and agree to abide by, the WMS integration access requirements.
INC_085.worknotes: Ticket was routed to the access team for account provisioning; an agent picked it up and confirmed the integration environment was enabled for the request. Level 1 WMS integration access was granted and the caller's SSH key was uploaded to the WMS integration server; access can take up to an hour to propagate before becoming active.

INC_086.short_description: Upgrade to Level 3 WMS access for dispatcher already on Level 2
INC_086.description: I already have Level 2 access in the WMS, but I need to be bumped up to Level 3 since I'll now be entering shipment records directly into production and routing them through the automated dispatch queue going forward.
INC_086.worknotes: Agent confirmed two supervisor vouches were received and verified the caller's existing Level 2 access in the WMS admin console.
INC_086.resolution_notes: Access team added the caller's account to the WMS Level 3 role group, granting full write access to production shipment records and the automated dispatch queue.

INC_087.short_description: Restore WMS write access disabled for inactivity
INC_087.description: My write access to the WMS got disabled because I guess I haven't been logging enough transactions in it lately. I originally had this access set up through an earlier help desk request. Also, the error message I got pointed me to a page on the intranet where I couldn't submit a new request, so I wasn't even sure this was the right place to ask.
INC_087.worknotes: Agent confirmed the caller's identity and prior access request, then checked with the WMS admin team and confirmed the account had been auto-disabled under the inactivity policy. The access team manually re-enabled the caller's write access to the WMS.

INC_088.short_description: Level 1 WMS access request for new warehouse associate account
INC_088.description: I'd like to request Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System for my account. Please use my Westfield email as the login. I've read and agree to the WMS Level 1 access requirements.
INC_088.worknotes: Agent asked the caller's manager to vouch for the requested access; the manager confirmed Level 1 WMS access was appropriate and the request was routed to the access team for account provisioning. The access team provisioned the WMS account with Level 1 access as vouched by the caller's manager.

INC_089.short_description: WMS integration account needs Level 1 push access and SSH key added
INC_089.description: Caller asked for Level 1 push access to the Warehouse Management System integration environment so their automated manifest-upload script could authenticate, and attached the SSH public key for the account to be used.
INC_089.worknotes: The caller's manager and a second colleague vouched for the request; the access team added the SSH key to the account and granted Level 1 WMS push access, then had the caller log out and back into the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com for the change to take effect.
INC_089.resolution_notes: After logging back in, the caller's push still failed with a publickey permission denied error because the WMS integration login didn't match the account the new key was bound to; the mismatch was still being sorted out when the ticket ended.
INC_089.close_notes: Agent asked the caller to confirm once the account login is corrected and the push goes through.

INC_090.short_description: Request to create a WMS access group for Dispatch Operations team
INC_090.description: Hi there, my team in Dispatch Operations would like to set up a group in the Westfield Drive/WMS access system so we can manage Warehouse Management System permissions on a group basis instead of granting them one person at a time. The group would include our team's nine members, with the caller and their manager listed as the main points of contact. Let me know if you need anything else, I'm not totally sure how the group request process works on your end.
INC_090.worknotes: The access team created the new WMS role group with the requested team members and set the caller and their manager as the group owners. The group was created with the requested membership and owners, and each member was asked to log out of the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com and back in so the new WMS permissions would sync to their profile.

INC_091.short_description: Restore WMS test environment access after inactivity lockout
INC_091.description: I've submitted configuration test uploads to the WMS test environment for about 8 years, building and testing them on my local PC first. I hadn't used the test environment in around six months, ever since a directory layout change last summer broke my usual process, and when I tried again today my account was blocked. The message said my account was found but WMS access is currently disabled, and to request it be restored.
INC_091.worknotes: Routed the ticket to the access team queue to review and restore the caller's WMS test environment access.
INC_091.resolution_notes: The access team confirmed the account was valid but flagged inactive, then re-enabled WMS test environment access.

INC_092.short_description: Request for WMS Application Level 1 Deployment Access
INC_092.description: I've attached my SSH public key and confirm that I have read and agree to abide by the WMS Level 1 Access Requirements. I hope that I did this correctly! Thank you!
INC_092.worknotes: The caller's manager vouched for the request in the ticket thread; the request was then routed to the access team for provisioning.
INC_092.resolution_notes: The access team set the Level 1 role and enabled deployment access on the caller's WMS account, and advised allowing about 40 minutes before attempting to log in.
INC_092.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that access should be live within 40 minutes and to follow up if login still fails after that.

INC_093.short_description: Restore WMS access disabled due to account inactivity
INC_093.description: I tried to upload today's route manifest to the WMS from the Dallas distribution center using our usual upload tool, and the connection went through fine, but it says my account was found and configured for WMS access -- except that access is currently disabled, apparently from not logging in for a few months. I need my WMS access restored so I can push the manifest through.
INC_093.worknotes: Agent confirmed this was an inactivity-based lockout on the WMS account rather than a network or credentials problem, and escalated to the WMS access team to have the account re-enabled.
INC_093.resolution_notes: The WMS access team re-enabled the caller's WMS account access.
INC_093.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that they were able to upload the manifest successfully.

INC_094.short_description: Approval rights needed for three dock supervisors in WMS Receiving
INC_094.description: Myself and two other dock supervisors need the ability to approve load adjustment records in the WMS Receiving module. Right now none of us can sign off on these, so adjustments just sit there waiting on someone else to approve them.
INC_094.worknotes: Agent confirmed the request was for elevated WMS permissions and reached out to the WMS system administrator to add the caller and the two other supervisors to the WMS Approvers role for the Receiving module.
INC_094.resolution_notes: The WMS administrator added all three accounts to the WMS Approvers role, giving them sign-off rights on load adjustment records in the Receiving module.

INC_095.short_description: Level 1 access request for the Warehouse Management System
INC_095.description: I'm requesting Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System for my role at the Dallas distribution centre. I have read and agree to abide by the WMS access requirements. My manager has agreed to vouch for this request.
INC_095.worknotes: Agent confirmed the manager's vouch, provisioned Level 1 WMS role access plus the related network share and Westfield VPN Client access, and emailed temporary credentials to the caller.
INC_095.resolution_notes: Level 1 WMS access, network share, and VPN Client access were granted with temporary credentials; the caller confirmed the password reset and SSO two-factor setup were completed.
INC_095.close_notes: Agent confirmed with the caller that access was working before closing the ticket.

INC_096.short_description: Request for elevated WMS editor role to correct shipment records
INC_096.description: I've attached corrected data to two shipment records in the WMS that aren't assigned to my account, but I don't have permission to edit them directly. Can I get the appropriate role added to my account so I can make these updates myself?
INC_096.worknotes: The access team reviewed the two shipment records the caller referenced, confirmed the requested edits were legitimate, and applied the general WMS editor role to the caller's account. The WMS editor role was granted, giving the caller edit access to shipment records outside their own queue; the caller then asked why this let them open one previously restricted record but still not another, since some records carry additional compliance-based restrictions separate from the editor role.

INC_097.short_description: WMS Level 1 access request for new Dallas DC hire
INC_097.description: I need Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System to start my shifts at the Dallas distribution centre. I've attached my SSH public key since that's required for the secure account setup. I agree to follow the WMS access requirements.
INC_097.worknotes: Asked for the caller's supervisor to post approval before proceeding; the supervisor confirmed support for the request, and the ticket was routed to the access team for account provisioning.
INC_097.resolution_notes: The access team created the WMS account, installed the caller's SSH key, and granted Level 1 role access, then emailed the temporary password to the caller.

INC_098.short_description: WMS approval role needed for two warehouse ops leads on shipment overrides
INC_098.description: Two warehouse ops leads need the ability to approve shipment exception overrides for the Dallas distribution centre modules in the WMS. The caller isn't sure whether they, as the process owner, should also have that access to make the changes themselves.
INC_098.worknotes: An agent checked the WMS approver role membership and found one of the two staff already had the access, then reassigned the ticket to the access team member who holds admin rights over that approver role.
INC_098.resolution_notes: The access team confirmed the first staff member already held the shipment-exception approver role and added the second staff member to the role in WMS.
INC_098.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that both staff members now have shipment exception approval rights in WMS.

INC_099.short_description: Level 1 WMS access request for new Dallas DC analyst
INC_099.description: I need Level 1 access to the WMS application to start editing shipment and inventory records at the Dallas distribution center. I've attached my public key so the Westfield VPN Client can be set up for remote access. Two colleagues on my team can vouch that this access is needed for my role.
INC_099.worknotes: Two colleagues vouched for the caller's need for access, and the caller confirmed they had read and agreed to the WMS data handling policy and provided their work email for credential delivery. The access team added the caller's account to the Level 1 WMS access group, attached the submitted VPN public key, and emailed a temporary password, noting the change could take up to an hour to propagate.

INC_100.short_description: New hire requests Level 1 WMS access, needs sponsor vouch
INC_100.description: I need Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System so I can start logging inbound shipments at the Dallas distribution centre. I've attached my SSH public key as instructed and I agree to follow the WMS access requirements.
INC_100.worknotes: Ticket was originally logged in the wrong queue; agent redirected it to the WMS account-request intake and noted that Level 1 access needs one voucher from an existing user with Level 2 or higher access before the access team can create the account. The caller's supervisor and a Dallas DC lead, both existing Level 2 WMS users, vouched for the caller to satisfy the one-voucher requirement, and the access team created the WMS account using the submitted SSH key.

INC_101.short_description: New warehouse associate requests Level 1 WMS system access
INC_101.description: The caller requested Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System and confirmed they had read and agreed to the access requirements. They attached a device credential file for setup and asked that the access be granted so they could start work.
INC_101.worknotes: Their supervisor vouched for the request, and an agent confirmed with the caller which email address to use for the new account, matching the address on file.
INC_101.resolution_notes: The access team provisioned an SSO Portal account with network share access and Level 1 WMS Application access, and sent the temporary password to the confirmed email address.

INC_102.short_description: Level 1 write access request for WMS automation script repository
INC_102.description: The caller asked for Level 1 write access to the WMS automation script repository, attaching their SSH public key for the connection and confirming they had read and agreed to the access requirements. Their manager vouched for the request so it could move forward.
INC_102.worknotes: An agent confirmed the manager's vouch and the signed access requirements were on file, then provisioned the account: added the directory group membership, loaded the SSH key, granted repository access, and set the tier to Level 1. A temporary password was emailed to the caller's address on file.
INC_102.resolution_notes: Account provisioning was completed with directory group membership, SSH key, repository access, and Level 1 tier all applied, and the temporary password was sent by email.
INC_102.close_notes: The caller confirmed the new access was working and the ticket was closed.

INC_103.short_description: Delete unused WMS automation service account
INC_103.description: This account was set up a while back to handle some automated nightly syncing for the WMS, but that got moved over to different accounts some time ago. Can you delete it completely, it's not being used for anything anymore.
INC_103.worknotes: The access team located the service account in the identity system and confirmed it had no active automation jobs or logins tied to it.
INC_103.resolution_notes: The unused WMS service account was permanently deleted from the identity system.

INC_104.short_description: Update WMS internal hostname record from CNAME to direct IP
INC_104.description: Could you update the DNS record for workflow.wms.westfieldlogistics.com to point directly to our static IP address 35.227.118.54? We own that IP in our cloud environment and are migrating the WMS reporting application over to the new server there.
INC_104.worknotes: An agent asked what was actually breaking with the existing CNAME, noting that pointing hostnames straight at IP addresses is normally discouraged, and recommended keeping it as a CNAME pointed at the cloud provider's hostname for that static IP instead.
INC_104.resolution_notes: The agent created the record as a CNAME pointing to the cloud provider's assigned hostname for the static IP rather than the raw address, keeping the setup safe for future migrations.

INC_105.short_description: Caller blocked from SSO portal by MFA enrollment error
INC_105.description: I'm trying to log into the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com with my network username and password, but I get a message saying my account can't be verified for multi-factor authentication and to contact my system administrator.
INC_105.worknotes: Agent checked the account and confirmed the caller had never completed multi-factor authentication enrollment on the SSO portal. Caller was directed to the SSO portal's MFA enrollment page to register their device, then was able to log in normally.

INC_106.short_description: Restore WMS access for warehouse systems work
INC_106.description: I'll be working on WMS integrations and need my access restored. Thanks.
INC_106.worknotes: Agent checked the caller's WMS Application role and found it had been disabled.
INC_106.resolution_notes: WMS access was re-enabled for the caller's account.
INC_106.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that WMS access is working again.

INC_107.short_description: WMS Level 1 write access request for warehouse associate
INC_107.description: I've read and agree to the WMS data change policy for Level 1 access, and I've attached the security key required for the request. My supervisor is vouching for me so I can get set up to make inventory corrections directly in the system.
INC_107.worknotes: Access team confirmed the supervisor's vouch and the signed policy acknowledgment on file, then provisioned the caller's account with the WMS Level 1 edit role using the submitted security key and emailed a temporary password to their Westfield account. WMS Level 1 role membership and login credentials were provisioned for the caller; caller was asked to confirm access so the related inventory issue could be resolved.

INC_108.short_description: Request to upgrade WMS access from Level 1 to Level 3
INC_108.description: I already have Level 1 access in the WMS — see my earlier request for that. I'd like to upgrade to Level 3 access. I have read, and agree to abide by, the WMS Level 3 access requirements.
INC_108.worknotes: The agent confirmed the caller currently held Level 1 WMS access and noted the upgrade required vouches from two current Level 3 users before it could be processed.
INC_108.resolution_notes: Two colleagues with Level 3 WMS access vouched for the caller, so the access team approved and applied the Level 3 role.
INC_108.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that their WMS access now shows Level 3.

INC_109.short_description: Direct-publish access requested for WMS report templates
INC_109.description: I've submitted a number of fixes to our WMS report templates, and they've all been reviewed and applied by the WMS admin team. I'd like to get direct-publish access so I can push these updates myself instead of tagging them for the review queue each time.
INC_109.worknotes: Agent routed the request to the WMS admin team for peer endorsement; two colleagues vouched for the caller before the second endorsement required for the elevated role came through. WMS admin team granted the caller the direct-publish role for report templates once both required endorsements were confirmed.

INC_110.short_description: Level 1 WMS access request for new distribution center analyst
INC_110.description: I've read and agree to the Level 1 access requirements for the Warehouse Management System. I've attached my public key so it can be added to my VPN client profile for remote access. My supervisor is vouching for me, so please go ahead and set up my account so I can start testing shipment record updates.
INC_110.worknotes: Verified the supervisor's vouch and the requirements acknowledgment on the ticket, then routed the request to the access team for account provisioning.
INC_110.resolution_notes: The access team created the caller's WMS account, added the submitted key to their VPN Client profile, granted Level 1 WMS access, and emailed the temporary password.
INC_110.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that they could log in and access the WMS with Level 1 permissions before closing the ticket.

INC_111.short_description: WMS access disabled after inactivity, needs re-enabling
INC_111.description: I tried logging into the Warehouse Management System this morning and got a message that my account was found but WMS access is disabled. I think it's because I hadn't logged in for a few months while I was out. Can someone turn this back on for me?
INC_111.worknotes: Agent confirmed the caller's account was still active overall but the WMS role had been auto-disabled by the system's inactivity policy, and opened a request with the access team to have it reinstated. The access team restored WMS access on the caller's account.

INC_112.short_description: Level 3 WMS access request needs a second supervisor vouch
INC_112.description: I need Level 3 access in the Warehouse Management System so I can commit inventory adjustments directly instead of routing them through a supervisor. My shift supervisor already agreed to vouch for me.
INC_112.worknotes: Agent logged the first supervisor's vouch, then flagged that Westfield policy requires two supervisor vouches for Level 3 WMS access and reached out for a second approver, looping in another supervisor.
INC_112.resolution_notes: A second warehouse supervisor was contacted and provided the required vouch, satisfying the two-approver policy, and Level 3 WMS access was provisioned for the caller.
INC_112.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that Level 3 WMS access is now active and working as expected.

INC_113.short_description: Re-enable email account disabled by bounce-handling threshold
INC_113.description: One of our dispatchers' Outlook accounts got disabled because of bounced emails, and another agent in the team chat confirmed that's what happened. Can you please re-enable it so she can respond to an open ticket instead of asking a coworker to relay her message? Also, this keeps happening to people, so can someone review the threshold that's disabling accounts so easily? Two other people's accounts got disabled the same way when our mail server went down for a day.
INC_113.worknotes: Agent confirmed the mailbox had been disabled by the automated bounce-handling threshold and re-enabled the account, and noted that the same threshold had disabled several other users' accounts during a recent mail server outage.
INC_113.resolution_notes: The account was re-enabled, but bounced and was auto-disabled again shortly after; the underlying mail delivery issue was still being investigated with no permanent fix confirmed as of the last update.

INC_114.short_description: Merge company SSO portal account into personal account before departure
INC_114.description: I'm leaving Westfield Logistics and would like my company SSO portal account merged into my personal account, which already existed before I joined. Just flagging that my network username doesn't match the email address on that personal account, in case that matters.
INC_114.worknotes: The agent had the caller log into the original company SSO account and post a confirmation message to verify ownership before proceeding, then noted the caller also had a linked Zoom account that would need extra steps after the merge.
INC_114.resolution_notes: The access team merged the two SSO portal accounts; the caller was told to log out and back into Zoom using the merged login and check their profile under the avatar/settings menu to make sure it carried over correctly.
INC_114.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that the accounts were merged and Zoom logged in fine with the merged credentials.

INC_115.short_description: Level 1 WMS Test-Environment Access Request for New Integration Developer
INC_115.description: Requesting Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System test environment for our new integration developer. I've attached their SSH public key as required for the access request. They've read and agree to abide by the WMS access requirements.
INC_115.worknotes: The caller's manager vouched for them, so the access team enabled Level 1 WMS test-environment access and asked the caller to log out and back in, then test and confirm. The caller reported they still could not connect to the WMS test environment or run a test job after the grant, so the access team escalated the case to the engineer who manages WMS test-environment permissions for further checking.

INC_116.short_description: Request for WMS Level 1 account access
INC_116.description: I have read and agree to abide by the WMS Level 1 Access Requirements. I'm attaching my SSH public key as requested, and my supervisor is vouching for this request.
INC_116.worknotes: Routed to the Access Team for Level 1 WMS account provisioning; supervisor vouch verified before proceeding.
INC_116.resolution_notes: The Access Team created the account, emailed the caller a temporary password, and granted network share, SSH key, WMS, and Level 1 role access.

INC_117.short_description: WMS Level 1 change access request for warehouse systems analyst
INC_117.description: I'm requesting Level 1 change access to the WMS Application so I can push configuration updates. I've attached my public key for the request, and a colleague on the team has agreed to sponsor me. I've confirmed my email address and that I've read and agree to the WMS change access requirements.
INC_117.worknotes: The agent noted that a Level 1 sponsor must already hold Level 1 WMS access themselves and asked the sponsoring colleague to point to the record of their own approved access. The sponsoring colleague could not locate any record of their own Level 1 access being granted, so no valid sponsor was confirmed; the caller asked a second colleague to sponsor the request instead.

INC_118.short_description: WMS access disabled due to account inactivity
INC_118.description: I'm trying to sync data with the Warehouse Management System and I'm getting a message that my account was found but WMS access is currently disabled on it. It looks like this happens automatically after a period of inactivity since I haven't connected in a while. Can someone please re-enable it?
INC_118.worknotes: Agent checked the caller's account and confirmed WMS access had been automatically disabled due to prolonged inactivity.
INC_118.resolution_notes: The access team re-enabled WMS access on the caller's account.
INC_118.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that they were able to connect to WMS again.

INC_119.short_description: Level 1 WMS access request with SSH key for new team member
INC_119.description: I need Level 1 access to the WMS set up for my account before I can start pulling inventory reports. I've read and agree to the WMS Data Access Requirements, and I'm attaching my SSH public key so the secure connection can be configured.
INC_119.worknotes: The caller's supervisor vouched for the request, and the access team created the account, added the Level 1 WMS role, and installed the submitted SSH key for secure WMS access. The access team provisioned Level 1 WMS access, added the SSH key for secure connectivity, and emailed a temporary password to the caller's Westfield email.

INC_120.short_description: VPN access needed for two staff to RDP into WMS training server
INC_120.description: We were asked to stand up a training server for the team that supports the WMS platform, and two of our staff need VPN access to RDP into it. We think a new VPN access group might be needed, something like a WMS lab access group, but that's up to IT to decide. They'll be working alongside the team that already has access to that server to support the WMS Premium module, and now that local accounts are configured without issues, we can let them in with non-admin accounts for training.
INC_120.worknotes: Agent checked and found this maps to an existing Westfield VPN Client access group used for the WMS training server rather than needing a new group, and confirmed with the caller that they wanted the two staff members added to that group. Added both staff members to the existing VPN Client access group for the WMS training server; no new group was required.

INC_121.short_description: WMS Level 3 access request for warehouse associate
INC_121.description: I've read and agree to follow the WMS Data Change Requirements. I was already granted Level 1 access on an earlier request and now need Level 3 access to commit inventory adjustments in the Warehouse Management System.
INC_121.worknotes: Two colleagues on the team vouched for the caller's request; ticket was routed to the access team to provision the Level 3 WMS role.
INC_121.resolution_notes: The access team added the Level 3 WMS role to the caller's account and asked them to log out of the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com and log back in for the new permissions to take effect.

INC_122.short_description: Shift lead missing WMS role scope to trigger nightly inventory sync jobs
INC_122.description: I can't trigger the nightly inventory sync jobs in WMS because I seem to be missing some permissions. Specifically I don't have the scope to trigger either the Dallas DC nightly sync or the mobile scanner nightly sync.
INC_122.worknotes: Agent checked which roles carry the nightly-sync trigger permission (shift-lead, WMS admin, network ops, systems integration) and reviewed the caller's current role assignments, finding they held a legacy 'vpn_shift_lead' WMS role group alongside the newer 'shift-lead' role.
INC_122.resolution_notes: The trigger permission for the nightly sync jobs was still attached to the legacy 'vpn_shift_lead' WMS role group rather than the newer 'shift-lead' role, since that naming cleanup hadn't been finished yet; since the caller was still a member of the legacy group, they already had the access and were asked to confirm it showed up on the SSO portal.

INC_123.short_description: Request for WMS Level 1 (commit) access – Dallas DC
INC_123.description: Requesting Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System so I can start committing inventory record updates. I've read and agree to the WMS access requirements, and I've attached my public key for the account. Let me know if anything else is needed from my end.
INC_123.worknotes: Agent advised that Level 1 WMS access requires a supervisor to vouch for the request in the ticket before it can be actioned; the caller's supervisor then vouched.
INC_123.resolution_notes: WMS role was set to Level 1 and the caller's public key was added to their account, granting commit access to inventory records.

INC_124.short_description: New warehouse analyst requesting Level 1 WMS access with SSH key
INC_124.description: I'm starting on the warehouse operations team and need Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System. I've read and agree to the WMS access requirements, and I've attached my SSH public key so I can sign in securely. My supervisor already vouched for me on this request.
INC_124.worknotes: Confirmed the requester's supervisor had vouched for them, then routed the ticket to the access team to provision the account; also removed an unneeded confidentiality flag from the ticket.
INC_124.resolution_notes: The access team created the account, installed the submitted SSH key, and granted network share plus Level 1 WMS role access; temporary credentials were emailed to the requester.

INC_125.short_description: WMS write-access role request for new receiving clerk
INC_125.description: I'd like Level 1 write access set up in the WMS for our new receiving clerk in Dallas so they can post stock adjustments once they start next week. Just flagging it now so it's ready before their first shift.
INC_125.worknotes: Agent checked the open WMS access queue and found an existing request already covering the same employee and access level. Closed as a duplicate of the existing WMS access request already being processed for the same employee.
INC_125.problem_display: Request for WMS Level 1 access for new warehouse associate

INC_126.short_description: Request for WMS Level 1 access for new warehouse associate
INC_126.description: I'd like to request Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System. I want to use my work email address as my login name. I've read and agree to abide by the WMS access requirements.
INC_126.worknotes: Agent confirmed the caller was requesting Level 1 WMS access and asked that the caller's name be included on the request for easier lookup if the access level needs to change later; noted a supervisor vouch was required before provisioning could proceed. The caller's supervisor vouched for them on the request, and the access team provisioned Level 1 WMS access tied to the caller's work email login.
INC_126.problem_display: Request for WMS Level 1 access for new warehouse associate

INC_127.short_description: Level 1 WMS access request for new systems team member
INC_127.description: Requesting Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System. I'll be using my Westfield Logistics email account for this. I have read, and agree to abide by, the WMS Access Requirements.
INC_127.worknotes: A colleague vouched for the request; the access team picked it up to provision the account and add the caller's SSH key. The access team added the caller's SSH key and enabled Level 1 WMS access, noting they may need to log out of active sessions and back in before it takes effect.

INC_128.short_description: Request for edit access to WMS issue records
INC_128.description: I've submitted fixes for two issues in the Warehouse Management System that I ran into on the floor, and I've got a longer list of other issues I've corrected that I can send along if it helps. I currently only have Level 1 sandbox access to test my fixes, so I'm asking for edit access so I can update the records directly. Let me know if you need anything else from me.
INC_128.worknotes: Agent reviewed the caller's list of previously submitted WMS fixes and confirmed their current sandbox-level access before routing the request to the WMS access team. Access team granted the caller edit-level access to WMS issue records based on their track record of verified fixes.

INC_129.short_description: Re-enable contractor accounts disabled after bounced emails
INC_129.description: Several of our contract staff at the Dallas distribution centre had their SSO accounts disabled in the last hour and can't log in. Our supervisor thinks the lockout was triggered by emails to those accounts bouncing. This is urgent — manual QA checks on outbound shipments have come to a complete stop until the accounts are back.
INC_129.worknotes: Agent could not reach anyone through the normal queue, so tried the access team lead and the on-call access approver by phone and left voicemails for both, since the contact numbers were listed in the internal directory.
