INC_129.resolution_notes: No callback was logged after the voicemails were left; the fix depended on the access team returning the call to confirm the bounce-triggered lockout and clear it from the SSO portal.

INC_130.short_description: Level 1 WMS scripting access request – automation server
INC_130.description: I'm requesting Level 1 access to the WMS automation scripting server so I can start committing changes to our warehouse automation scripts. I've attached my SSH public key for the account setup. I have read and agree to abide by the WMS Scripting Access Requirements.
INC_130.worknotes: A colleague on the automation team vouched for the caller's work on the warehouse scripts, and the request was routed to the access team for account provisioning. The access team created the caller's account, added the submitted SSH key, and granted WMS scripting group membership at Level 1, then emailed the temporary password.

INC_131.short_description: Add new legal team hire to Legal network share access group
INC_131.description: Please add our new IP paralegal to the Legal network share group so they have access to legal case files. They just joined the legal team this week. Thanks!
INC_131.worknotes: Reached out to the two share owners who have permission to manage membership on the Legal network share, since they need to approve additions; one owner replied that they didn't realize they had that access or know how to use it, and asked for a quick walkthrough before proceeding. Explained that the share owner has manage-membership rights on the Legal network share group via the self-service access panel on intranet.westfieldlogistics.com, and walked them through adding a member; they added the new hire and confirmed the ticket could be closed.

INC_132.short_description: Reactivate lapsed WMS supervisor access for returning employee
INC_132.description: My WMS supervisor-level access has lapsed from disuse — could someone on the access team re-enable it? It should be tied to my regular Westfield Logistics email account, not the contractor alias I used when I first started here.
INC_132.worknotes: The access team re-enabled the caller's supervisor-level WMS access at the manager's request. When the caller reported that the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com still showed the access as expired even though the WMS admin console reflected the change, the agent checked and found the SSO portal doesn't refresh permissions dynamically. WMS supervisor access was re-enabled by the access team; the caller just needed to log out of the SSO portal and log back in for the elevated role to take effect.

INC_133.short_description: Request Tier 3 (Supervisor) access in the Warehouse Management System
INC_133.description: I need Tier 3 supervisor access in the WMS at the Dallas distribution centre. I've attached the signed access authorization form. My shift lead and another supervisor are willing to vouch for me if you need confirmation.
INC_133.worknotes: Two supervisors vouched for the caller's request, and the access team enabled the Tier 3 role on their WMS account, then re-verified the role bit was set after the caller reported no change. The access team confirmed Tier 3 was enabled on the caller's WMS account and asked them to fully sign out of all Westfield SSO sessions at otp.westfieldlogistics.com and sign back in before retesting.

INC_134.short_description: Restore WMS account access disabled for inactivity
INC_134.description: Please restore my WMS access (that's me). It got disabled because I hadn't logged into the system in a while - I forgot I need to check in periodically or it locks out automatically.
INC_134.worknotes: Checked the account in the WMS admin console and confirmed it was disabled by the automatic inactivity policy, not a security flag. WMS account re-enabled.

INC_135.short_description: Reinstate WMS access for supervisor who moved to reporting dashboards
INC_135.description: I get it, I'm a supervisor now and haven't logged directly into the WMS in a while - I've mostly been using the reporting dashboards instead. But I still occasionally need to push manual inventory corrections or handle exceptions directly in the system. Can I please have my WMS access reinstated?
INC_135.worknotes: The access team added the caller back to the appropriate WMS access group to restore their application access. WMS access was reinstated for the caller; they needed to log out and back in for the change to take effect.

INC_136.short_description: SFTP write access (Level 1) to dispatch reports network share
INC_136.description: I need Level 1 write access to the dispatch reports network share so I can push automated report uploads over SFTP. I've attached my SSH public key for the access team to add to my account. I've read and agree to abide by the network share access requirements.
INC_136.worknotes: Agent noted that both the caller's manager and a peer colleague vouched for the request in the ticket thread, then routed it to the access team to add the public key and grant access.
INC_136.resolution_notes: The access team added the caller's SSH public key to the dispatch reports share and granted Level 1 write access.

INC_137.short_description: Service account request for warehouse route-optimization bot
INC_137.description: I need a service account for Dispatch Ops' route-optimization bot, which pushes nightly route updates into the Warehouse Management System. I've attached the SSH public key this account must authenticate with. It only needs base-level access.
INC_137.worknotes: The access team confirmed manager sign-off on the request, then worked with the caller to settle on an account name matching the one already used for this bot on the intranet dashboard. The access team provisioned an SSO service account (display name "Route Optimization Bot", username routeoptbot) using the supplied SSH key and granted it base-tier WMS Application write access.

INC_138.short_description: Add editor role to WMS bot account for automated exception tickets
INC_138.description: I'm setting up a bot account that will automatically log WMS tickets for exceptions resolved by the Cold Chain Compliance team. I've already created the account but I think it needs the WMS editor role. I found the bot registry page on the intranet and will add an entry there.
INC_138.worknotes: Agent confirmed the automation account and the intended use case, then reviewed the requested role against the WMS bot registry entry. Editor role was added to the automation account so it can create and update WMS tickets on its own.

INC_139.short_description: Reactivate Level 3 WMS write access for returning dispatcher
INC_139.description: I need my Level 3 access back in the Warehouse Management System so I can approve inventory adjustments again. I had this level before but it must have expired since I was working outside the Dallas distribution center for the past few months. My supervisor has already agreed to vouch for me.
INC_139.worknotes: Agent verified the caller previously held Level 3 WMS access and that it had lapsed due to inactivity; confirmed one supervisor vouch was on file and that a second vouch was still required before the request could be routed to the access team. A second supervisor vouch was obtained and the request was escalated to the access team, who used the caller's retained access history to reactivate Level 3 WMS access without requiring a full re-review.

INC_140.short_description: WMS Level 1 access request for a Dallas warehouse associate
INC_140.description: I'm requesting Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System for my role at the Dallas distribution centre. I've attached the security key file as required, and my SSO login is my Westfield Logistics email address. I've read and agree to the WMS access requirements.
INC_140.worknotes: Agent asked the caller's supervisor to post their endorsement on the ticket, then routed the request to the access team once the vouch was recorded.
INC_140.resolution_notes: The access team created the WMS role, verified the attached security key matched the one on file, and enabled Level 1 access; the caller was told to log out of the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com and log back in to pick it up.

INC_141.short_description: Add Slack access for vendor developer's contractor account
INC_141.description: Please add Slack permissions to the contractor's account. They are an employee of our vendor partner and need it to communicate with our other developers. Thank you.
INC_141.worknotes: The agent added the contractor's account to the Slack access group in the identity system.
INC_141.resolution_notes: The account was added to the Slack access group; membership takes effect once the user logs out of the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com and logs back in.
INC_141.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that the contractor can now sign into Slack after re-authenticating through the SSO portal.

INC_142.short_description: Level 1 WMS access request for new warehouse team member
INC_142.description: Requesting Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System for a new team member I'm vouching for. They've read and agree to the WMS access requirements. Please set up their account and let me know once access is active.
INC_142.worknotes: Access team verified the vouching manager's sign-off and the requirements acknowledgment, then routed the request to the identity and access provisioning queue. Provisioning created the new SSO Portal account, enabled Westfield VPN Client access, and granted the Level 1 WMS role; a temporary password was emailed to the caller, who was asked to confirm once access was verified.

INC_143.description: I previously had Level 1 access to push integration scripts to the WMS, but I think it's expired. I've got some scripts ready to test through the staging environment soon, so I need that access restored. I've attached my current public key since it's changed since I last requested access.
INC_143.worknotes: Access team reactivated the account and updated the stored public key to match the one attached to the ticket, then reset the password on the account.
INC_143.resolution_notes: Level 1 WMS integration access was reinstated with the caller's updated public key and the account password was reset; the caller was told to set up MFA on the SSO portal for future access to the WMS admin console.

INC_144.short_description: WMS account access disabled due to inactivity, needs restoring
INC_144.description: I tried logging into the WMS application this morning to start my shift and got a message saying the connection went through and my account was found, but WMS access is disabled on my account. Can you please restore it? Thanks.
INC_144.worknotes: Agent verified the caller's account existed and was locked out because WMS flags accounts inactive after several months without a login; submitted a request to the access team to reactivate WMS access. The access team re-enabled the caller's WMS account and confirmed login succeeded.

INC_145.short_description: SSO portal password needs to be reset
INC_145.description: My SSO portal password needs to be reset, I think I locked myself out after a few failed attempts. Sorry for the trouble I caused with this.
INC_145.worknotes: Agent verified the caller's identity and reset the SSO portal password at otp.westfieldlogistics.com.
INC_145.resolution_notes: Password was reset and the caller confirmed they were able to log back into the SSO portal.

INC_146.short_description: Contributor Account Needed for Former Intern to Continue Data Analysis
INC_146.description: My internship at the Dallas distribution centre just wrapped up, but I'm continuing on part-time as a contributor on the route optimization project. I'll need a new account set up since my intern account is being deactivated, along with the same network share access I had before so I can keep working with the results.
INC_146.worknotes: Agent confirmed with the caller's manager that the move from intern to contributor status was approved and that continued network share access was needed for the ongoing analysis. The access team provisioned a new contributor account and carried over the same network share permissions used during the internship.

INC_147.short_description: Add Information Security Risk Manager to restricted WMS security-incident role
INC_147.description: Our Information Security Risk Manager needs access to the restricted WMS role that surfaces newly logged security-incident records, since new theft and tampering flags are automatically assigned that classification by default. I believe the access team lead needs to approve this, so please loop them in. Ping me on Slack with any questions.
INC_147.worknotes: Agent flagged the request as needing approval and routed it to the access team lead before making any changes. The access team lead approved the request and the agent updated the caller's WMS role to include the restricted security-incident permissions.

INC_148.short_description: Level 1 WMS staging environment access with SSH key setup
INC_148.description: I need Level 1 access to the WMS staging environment to start testing integration changes, and I've read and agree to the WMS staging access requirements. I've attached my SSH public key so it can be added to the new account.
INC_148.worknotes: Confirmed the access voucher from the caller's manager, then routed the request to the infrastructure team to create the Level 1 account. Infrastructure created the staging account, emailed the credentials, granted Level 1 access, and added the caller's SSH key to the account.

INC_149.short_description: Request to host a new campus recruiting page on the intranet
INC_149.description: As part of our Campus Talent Outreach Program we'd like to host a new page on intranet.westfieldlogistics.com for prospective drivers and warehouse hires. Can someone help me get that set up and walk me through the process?
INC_149.worknotes: Agent asked the caller whether hosting already existed or this needed a fresh internal hostname pointer, and whether the page content would be static. Caller confirmed they were starting from scratch with a static HTML page plus a few CSS and image files, with more functionality possibly added later. The clarified scope (static page, starting from scratch) was used to route the request to the team that provisions intranet hosting, with a follow-up promised by end of day; the thread does not show the page actually going live.

INC_150.short_description: Request for a WMS admin account
INC_150.description: Hello! I need admin privileges for the Warehouse Management System, and I understand that requires a separate WMS admin account. Can I get that set up? Thanks!
INC_150.worknotes: The caller's manager approved the request before the access team proceeded with provisioning.
INC_150.resolution_notes: The access team created the requested WMS admin account for the caller.

INC_151.short_description: Add two team members to Westfield VPN Client access group for WMS test server
INC_151.description: Please add two of my warehouse IT team members to the VPN Client access group for the WMS test server. They'll need remote access once their Westfield VPN Client is set up.
INC_151.worknotes: The access team enabled VPN Client access for both team members on the WMS test server access group, and added the caller's manager and another teammate as watchers for visibility. Access was granted for both team members; once they configure their Westfield VPN Client, they will be able to reach the WMS test server.

INC_152.short_description: Request VPN Client access group for WMS scanner device-pool servers
INC_152.description: Could you set up a new Westfield VPN Client access group for me? It controls SSH access to three servers running our warehouse scanner device-pool at the Dallas distribution center (wms-scanner-pool-0, -1, and -2), with port 22 as the primary port needed. Please add my team and two colleagues who support this system to the allowed list.
INC_152.worknotes: The access team created the VPN Client access group scoped to the three device-pool servers and restricted it to port 22/SSH only, reading the caller's note that this was the 'primary' port as meaning it was the only one required. A new Westfield VPN Client access group was created allowing SSH (port 22) to the three scanner device-pool servers, with the caller's team added as approved users.

INC_153.short_description: Requesting Level 3 WMS access after Level 1 access was disabled
INC_153.description: I previously had Level 1 access to the WMS Application, but that appears to have been disabled. I'm now working with the Performance team and need access to the WMS staging environment to test workflow changes. I've read and agree to the elevated access requirements, and my supervisor and a colleague on the Performance team can vouch for me.
INC_153.worknotes: Two colleagues vouched for the caller, but an agent flagged that this queue only handles reinstating Level 1 access and that Level 3 requests need to go through the separate Account Provisioning intake, then asked the caller which path they actually needed. The caller confirmed they were not aware of the separate process and that they need Level 3 access rather than just a Level 1 reinstatement, so the request was redirected to the Account Provisioning intake for elevated WMS access.

INC_154.short_description: Request for Level 3 WMS access and additional role group membership
INC_154.description: I got my Level 1 WMS access approved a while back and have been covering dispatch-lead duties on the floor since then, so I think I'm ready for Level 3 access now. Can you also check I'm a member of wms_autoreplenish and wms_vendorportal, and confirm whether I should be in both vpn_dispatchlead and dispatchlead, and both vpn_dockstatus and dockstatus, since those are being renamed?
INC_154.worknotes: Two colleagues vouched for the caller and confirmed the request was ready for action; the access team reviewed and approved the Level 3 WMS role change along with the group additions.
INC_154.resolution_notes: Access team granted Level 3 WMS access and added the caller to wms_autoreplenish, wms_vendorportal, vpn_dispatchlead, dispatchlead, vpn_dockstatus, and dockstatus, then advised logging out of the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com and any active Westfield VPN Client sessions and logging back in to pick up the new permissions.

INC_155.short_description: Request for Level 3 (Advanced) WMS access with peer vouching
INC_155.description: I'd like to request Level 3 advanced access to the Warehouse Management System so I can work directly on core inventory records. I've read and agree to the Level 3 WMS access requirements and attached the signed acknowledgment form. Could two people who already have Level 3 access vouch for me so this can be approved?
INC_155.worknotes: Two existing Level 3 WMS users replied to vouch for the caller, and the access team looped in a WMS access approver to review the request before granting it. With both peer vouches confirmed, the access team approver signed off and provisioned Level 3 WMS access for the caller.

INC_156.short_description: WMS Level 1 access request for inventory record corrections
INC_156.description: Requesting Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System so I can make direct inventory corrections. I've attached my device authentication key for the WMS terminal login. I have read and agree to abide by the WMS Level 1 Access Requirements.
INC_156.worknotes: The caller's manager was asked to post sponsorship approval in the ticket, a colleague added a supporting comment, and the request was then routed to the WMS administration team for Level 1 provisioning. WMS administration confirmed the caller's existing device key, added Level 1 write-access permissions, and noted changes can take up to 1 hour to propagate.

INC_157.short_description: WMS Level 3 role upgrade request with peer vouching
INC_157.description: I'm asking for my WMS account to be upgraded to Level 3 access so I can process inventory overrides on my shift. The login and device details are the same ones already on file for my account. Can my shift supervisor and a fellow dispatcher vouch for me so this can go through?
INC_157.worknotes: Agent confirmed two vouches were logged on the ticket, one from the caller's shift supervisor and one from a fellow dispatcher, both confirming the caller in good standing.
INC_157.resolution_notes: With both vouches recorded, the request was forwarded to the access team to complete the WMS Level 3 role upgrade; the ticket does not record confirmation that the upgrade was applied.

INC_158.short_description: Re-enable WMS account access disabled due to inactivity
