INC_204.worknotes: Two coworkers vouched for the caller in the thread; the access team confirmed the existing WMS login and handheld scanner credentials were already provisioned, so only the Level 3 role needed to be added to the account. Added the caller's WMS account to the Supervisor Level 3 role group; no changes were needed to the existing login or device credentials.

INC_205.short_description: Assign new triage owner for WMS dock scheduling queue
INC_205.description: Per the attached email, please make our dispatch lead the triage owner for the WMS dock scheduling queue instead of the current owner. My manager has already signed off on this change.
INC_205.worknotes: Agent confirmed the manager's email approval and updated the ownership record for the WMS dock scheduling queue in the WMS admin console.
INC_205.resolution_notes: Triage ownership for the WMS dock scheduling queue was reassigned to the requested employee as approved by the manager.

INC_206.short_description: Grant WMS edit access to warehouse associate who fixes data issues
INC_206.description: They've been contributing to the WMS for a while now, both logging problems and fixing them. They'd benefit from having edit access so they can update WMS records directly. Thanks in advance!
INC_206.worknotes: The access team reviewed a few WMS records the associate had corrected as examples and confirmed the request met the bar for edit-level access. Edit access to the WMS Application was granted on the associate's account.

INC_207.short_description: WMS Level 1 Access Request for New Warehouse Associate
INC_207.description: I need Level 1 access set up for me in the Warehouse Management System. I've attached my public key file for VPN sign-on, and I've read and agree to follow the WMS access requirements. Please use my employee email address as my login name.
INC_207.worknotes: Confirmed the caller had acknowledged the WMS Level 1 access requirements and reached out to their shift supervisor for the required sign-off before provisioning could proceed. The caller's supervisor vouched for the Level 1 access, and the request was handed off to the access team to create the WMS account.

INC_208.short_description: Add M5 milestone flag to WMS shipments and open it to the WMS Editor role
INC_208.description: Please add an M5 milestone value to the WMS shipment tracking flag, and please also allow anyone with the WMS Editor role to be able to set that flag.
INC_208.worknotes: Agent added the M5 milestone value to the WMS shipment flag. On follow-up the caller reported that WMS Editor role users still could not set it; agent explained they had pointed the flag's permission at the M5 Program Drivers group, same as the other milestone values, since 'WMS Editor' isn't a group normally used for flag permissions and was assumed to be a typo.
INC_208.resolution_notes: Agent realized the caller's original request had been misread and reset the flag's permission group to WMS Editor, so users with that role can now set the M5 milestone.

INC_209.short_description: Level 1 WMS Access Request with Key Authentication
INC_209.description: I'm requesting Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System so I can start making edits to shipment records at the Dallas distribution centre. I've attached my public key for authentication and confirm I've read and agree to the WMS Access Requirements.
INC_209.worknotes: The caller asked whether a colleague could vouch for the request; a co-worker confirmed on the ticket, and it was then routed to the access team for account provisioning.
INC_209.resolution_notes: The access team added the caller's key to the WMS account and granted Level 1 access to the shipment records module.

INC_210.short_description: VPN Client access (Level 1) request for summer dispatch intern
INC_210.description: I'm a summer intern on the dispatch team and need Level 1 access to the Westfield VPN Client. I've attached my public key for the connection profile. I have read and agree to abide by the VPN Client access requirements.
INC_210.worknotes: The caller's manager vouched for them as a summer intern on the dispatch team, and the request was routed to the access team for account provisioning.
INC_210.resolution_notes: The access team added the caller's public key with a Level 1 VPN profile, noted it could take about 40 minutes to propagate, and advised logging out of the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com before using other systems.
INC_210.close_notes: Ticket closed once the access team confirmed the key and profile were added; no further issues were reported.

INC_211.short_description: Assign triage owner for WMS exception report queue
INC_211.description: Exception reports are piling up in the WMS with nobody assigned to review them. The caller is asking who on the support team should take ownership so incoming exceptions get routed and triaged going forward.
INC_211.worknotes: Agent reached out to the WMS support team lead to identify who should take ownership of the exception report queue. The WMS support team lead agreed to take over as triage owner for the exception report queue.

INC_212.short_description: Determine triage owner for new WMS exception-report module
INC_212.description: There's a proposal to add an exception-reporting module to the WMS, and we've suggested a specific engineer on the WMS team as the owner. Can you confirm who on your team should take this on, and whether that person should also be the triage owner?
INC_212.worknotes: Agent followed up with the WMS team lead to confirm ownership, noting that the engineer already proposed for the new module would be a natural fit to also own triage for related WMS reports. WMS team lead agreed to assign the proposed engineer as triage owner for the new exception-reporting module, consolidating ownership under one person.

INC_213.short_description: New hire requests Tier 1 WMS access, needs supervisor vouch
INC_213.description: I'm requesting Tier 1 access to the Warehouse Management System for my new role at the Dallas distribution centre. I've attached my public key as requested, and I confirm I have read and agree to the WMS access requirements.
INC_213.worknotes: Agent asked the vouching supervisor to confirm they hold Tier 3 WMS access, since that level is required before someone can vouch for a new user's access request; the supervisor confirmed they have held Tier 3 access for over 10 years.
INC_213.resolution_notes: With the supervisor's vouch confirmed, the request was approved and handed off to the access team for account provisioning in WMS.
INC_213.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that their WMS account was provisioned with Tier 1 access as requested.

INC_214.short_description: Request edit rights for Warehouse Management System records
INC_214.description: I'd like to request edit rights for Warehouse Management System records for myself. I've been contributing to a couple of open WMS tickets and would like to be able to edit them directly.
INC_214.worknotes: The access team reviewed the request and confirmed the caller's contributions to the referenced WMS tickets before granting the role.
INC_214.resolution_notes: The access team added the caller to the WMS editor role, giving them edit rights on WMS records.
INC_214.close_notes: Thanks for your contributions — you've been added to the editor role.

INC_215.short_description: New internal hostname needed for Dallas WMS application server
INC_215.description: Can we get wms-dallas.westfieldlogistics.com pointed to 10.44.12.56? This ties into the change already logged with the network team about migrating this server, and we need it live before the new distribution center goes live.
INC_215.worknotes: An agent noted that wms-dallas.westfieldlogistics.com is still registered with the domain registrar and has several address records pointing at the old vendor-hosted environment, and flagged that DNS for this hostname may need to move to the internal DNS management platform first; while the primary agent was on leave, another agent covered the request and confirmed that, since this is an apex hostname, an A record is required rather than a CNAME. The network team confirmed an A record was the correct fix for the apex hostname, matching the caller's original request, and logged the broader move of this domain to centralized DNS hosting as separate follow-up work.

INC_216.short_description: Remove WMS admin access for former routing coordinator
INC_216.description: This is a bit of an unusual request, but one of our former routing coordinators has asked us to remove their admin access to the WMS Application. It's been a while since they've made any changes there, and we think it's good practice to pull access that's no longer needed.
INC_216.worknotes: Agent confirmed the request and flagged that the caller is also still listed with WMS Application access tied to the Dallas distribution center, likely from their time overseeing routing there, and suggested looping in the site lead to have that access removed too. The caller had temporarily lost access to the SSO portal, so they emailed instead to confirm: please also remove my Westfield VPN Client access and my Dallas network share access.
INC_216.resolution_notes: The access team removed the caller's WMS Application admin role and forwarded the VPN Client and network share removal request to the network access team to complete.
INC_216.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that the WMS admin access was removed and that the remaining access removal request had been passed along.

INC_217.short_description: Level 1 write access request for WMS route-optimization scripting repo
INC_217.description: I've attached my SSH public key as requested. I've read and agree to the WMS scripting access requirements, and I'm requesting Level 1 write access so I can keep fixing bugs I've found in the route-optimization engine.
INC_217.worknotes: Agent asked for a vouch from someone with Level 3 access before granting the request; a colleague on the routing team vouched, noting the caller had already fixed several bugs in the route-optimization engine and that access would let them work more efficiently.
INC_217.resolution_notes: The access team provisioned the caller's network account with the SSH key on file, granted access to the route-optimization scripting repository, and assigned the Level 1 role; login credentials were emailed to the caller.

INC_218.short_description: Assign internal DNS hostnames for two new WMS application servers
INC_218.description: I spun up two new virtual servers for the WMS application at the Dallas distribution centre and need internal DNS entries created so each one resolves to its full hostname. Server 1 is 10.134.30.66, which should map to wms-app-dal-01.westfieldlogistics.com, and server 2 is 10.134.30.21, mapping to wms-app-dal-02.westfieldlogistics.com.
INC_218.worknotes: The network team added A records for both hosts in internal DNS and verified forward and reverse lookups resolved correctly from the Dallas network. Both internal hostnames were created and confirmed to resolve to the correct IP addresses for the new WMS servers.

INC_219.short_description: Add emergency-approval flag to WMS Inventory Adjustments module
INC_219.description: Following up on an earlier request, it looks like the emergency-approval flag never got added to the Inventory Adjustments module in the WMS. Can someone add that so adjustment requests in that module go through the same approval flow as the rest of the system?
INC_219.worknotes: Agent checked the WMS module configuration, confirmed the emergency-approval flag was missing from Inventory Adjustments, and added it to match the other modules. Added the emergency-approval flag to the Inventory Adjustments module in the WMS.

INC_220.description: Can someone update the description on the Shipment Alerts component in the WMS ticketing setup to: 'Issues related to the Shipment Alerts (a.k.a. Load Alerts) feature within the WMS interface. For issues with the driver portal, please submit a request via the WMS Application feedback form on intranet.westfieldlogistics.com.' The current description is outdated and drivers keep filing driver-portal issues under this component instead of the right place.
INC_220.worknotes: Agent located the Shipment Alerts component configuration in the WMS Application ticketing setup and applied the requested description text.
INC_220.resolution_notes: The component description was updated to the requested wording, pointing driver-portal issues to the WMS Application feedback form on the intranet instead.
INC_220.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that the updated description is correct and visible.

INC_221.short_description: Update owner and auto-CC contact on corporate blog shared mailbox
INC_221.description: Hi, could you please change the owner of the corporate blog shared mailbox from its current owner to me, and add my colleague as an auto-CC so they get copied on all incoming mail to that mailbox? Thanks!
INC_221.worknotes: Agent confirmed the request with the caller's manager, then updated the shared mailbox owner assignment and added the requested auto-CC forwarding rule in the Exchange admin console.
INC_221.resolution_notes: Shared mailbox ownership was reassigned to the caller and an auto-CC rule was configured to forward incoming messages to the requested colleague.
INC_221.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that the new owner and auto-CC were correct; ticket closed.

INC_222.short_description: Request for WMS Level 1 access for new warehouse associate
INC_222.description: Our team lead asked me to request Level 1 write access to the WMS so I can start updating inbound receiving records at the Dallas distribution centre. I've read and agree to the WMS access requirements and have attached my signed access form.
INC_222.worknotes: The caller's supervisor vouched for the Level 1 request, and the access team provisioned the WMS account with the Level 1 role once the signed access agreement was received. Level 1 WMS access was granted; the caller was told the change could take up to an hour to propagate and to log out and back into the SSO portal for it to take effect.

INC_223.short_description: Level 1 WMS access request with SSH key for EDI file drop
INC_223.description: I need Level 1 access to the WMS so I can push files through the automated EDI drop — my public SSH key is attached. Please set up the account and let me know once it's active.
INC_223.worknotes: Confirmed vouching from the caller's manager, then added the caller's SSH key and granted Level 1 WMS access permissions. Access team applied the SSH key to the caller's WMS account with Level 1 access, noting propagation can take up to an hour, and linked the intranet setup guide for configuring the connection.

INC_224.short_description: Elevated WMS role needed to edit shipment status tags
INC_224.description: I need the elevated WMS role that lets me edit status tags on shipment records - specifically to add the 'needs-recheck' tag on three shipments I'm handling (WMS-1534285, WMS-1557112, WMS-1549265). Right now my account can open and update the shipment notes, but I can't touch the status tags field.
INC_224.worknotes: Agent confirmed the caller's WMS account was assigned to the shipments in question and that the current role excluded status-tag edit rights, then submitted the role change to the access team. The access team granted the caller's WMS account the elevated role that includes status-tag edit permissions.

INC_225.short_description: New internal hostname needed for WMS reporting service
INC_225.description: This is for a new reporting service we just stood up for the WMS team. Could I get an internal hostname pointed at it? Let me know if you need anything else from me, thanks!
INC_225.worknotes: Agent found the request had been missed after the initial filing, apologized for the delay, and created the requested hostname record. Agent created the internal hostname record pointing to the new WMS reporting service and asked the caller to allow time for the change to propagate.

INC_226.short_description: WMS access level request stalls on mismatched voucher level
INC_226.description: I'm requesting Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System for my role at the Dallas distribution centre. I've attached my completed WMS access acknowledgment form and confirm I've read and agree to abide by the WMS access requirements.
INC_226.worknotes: The access team asked the caller's manager to post a voucher confirming the requested access level, then routed the ticket to the WMS administration team to process the grant. The WMS administrator checked the account and found the caller already had Level 1 access, which didn't match the level the manager had vouched for. No fix was applied in the ticket; the WMS administrator asked the manager to clarify whether the voucher was for Level 1 (already active) or Level 3 (supervisor) access before any change could be made.

INC_227.short_description: WMS access disabled due to inactivity, needs restoring
INC_227.description: I tried to submit a batch job in the Warehouse Management System and got an error saying my account was found but that WMS access is currently disabled on my account, most likely from inactivity. The message told me to file a request to get my WMS access restored. Can I get this fixed?
INC_227.worknotes: Agent checked the caller's account status in the access system and re-enabled WMS access, then asked the caller to log out and back in to confirm the fix worked. WMS access was restored and the caller confirmed they could submit jobs again; they then hit a separate error trying to retrigger an automated job due to a missing permission scope, which was logged for the access team to review.

INC_228.short_description: Reactivate SSO portal access for returning employee
INC_228.description: I lost access to the SSO portal after coming back from parental leave. I used to log in with my Westfield email, but since that login stopped working during my two years away, my account got switched over to a personal Gmail address. I'd like my access restored under my original Westfield email address.
INC_228.worknotes: Access team located the caller's original Westfield account, which had been disabled during the leave period, and identified the personal Gmail address that had been substituted in the meantime.
INC_228.resolution_notes: The agent re-enabled the caller's SSO account tied to their original Westfield company email address.
INC_228.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that they were able to log in again using their Westfield email.

INC_229.short_description: Add new staging WMS admin UI domain to SSO Portal client config
INC_229.description: We're rolling out a new version of the WMS admin console and want to run it side by side with the current one for testing. It needs to authenticate through the SSO Portal, so the new staging domain has to be added to our SSO client config. The staging domain is https://wms-admin-ui-stage.westfieldlogistics.com/ with a redirect URI of https://wms-admin-ui-stage.westfieldlogistics.com/login, and I believe the client ID we're using for the WMS staging environment is SSO-STAGE-WMS-04A1.
INC_229.worknotes: The access team added the new redirect URI to the SSO Portal's staging client configuration for the WMS admin application. The new domain and redirect URI were added to the SSO Portal stage client, letting the new WMS admin UI authenticate alongside the existing one.

INC_230.short_description: Re-enable WMS test environment submit access
INC_230.description: I need my submit access to the WMS test environment re-enabled so I can push a configuration change for testing.
INC_230.worknotes: The access team looked up the caller's WMS account and found the test environment submit-level access had been disabled. Submit-level access to the WMS test environment was re-enabled on the caller's account.

INC_231.short_description: Restore WMS access disabled during extended leave
INC_231.description: I was out of the office for a while and now my access to the Warehouse Management System has been disabled. I need my access restored so I can get back to work.
INC_231.worknotes: The access team verified the caller's account had been automatically deactivated due to prolonged inactivity and confirmed with their manager that the caller remained an active employee before restoring access.
INC_231.resolution_notes: The caller's WMS account was re-enabled by the access team.
INC_231.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that WMS access was working again.

INC_232.short_description: Add WMS edit permissions for new team member
INC_232.description: I'd like to get edit permissions set up in the Warehouse Management System for our new intern joining the team this week. I've cc'd them on this ticket so the access team has their details on hand.
INC_232.worknotes: Agent verified the intern's account already existed in the WMS Application and confirmed with the caller which records the role should cover.
INC_232.resolution_notes: Edit permissions were added to the intern's WMS account as requested.
INC_232.close_notes: Confirmed the caller now sees the new edit access working for their intern.

INC_233.short_description: WMS Level 1 access request for warehouse associate
INC_233.description: I need WMS Level 1 access to log in and update shipment records. I've attached the access credential file as required, and my supervisor has confirmed they'll vouch for my request.
INC_233.worknotes: Confirmed the supervisor's vouch, created the caller's account in the access system, and assigned the WMS Level 1 role; credentials and login instructions were emailed to the caller. Access was granted and synced to the warehouse servers within about an hour; the caller confirmed they could log in with full WMS Level 1 permissions.

INC_234.description: I need to change the authentication key on my VPN Client account. I've attached my new key file for the team to install in place of the old one.
INC_234.worknotes: Ticket was routed to the access team, who removed the caller's old VPN Client key and installed the new key from the attachment. The access team swapped in the caller's new VPN Client key, resolving the original request; the caller then reported they could not log into the SSO portal and separately found their WMS access disabled after a period of inactivity, which were logged as follow-up items for the access team.

INC_235.short_description: Restore access permissions to network share drive
INC_235.description: Can someone please restore my access permissions to the network share drive? I use it for my work and it looks like my access was affected.
INC_235.worknotes: The access team checked the caller's account and confirmed their network share permissions had not expired, then asked the caller to provide the exact error message they were seeing. The caller reported the restore permission errors had cleared on their own and the share was accessible again; no further action was needed.

INC_236.short_description: Reactivate Level 3 WMS integration access and update SFTP key
INC_236.description: The caller is asking for their Level 3 WMS integration access to be reactivated, noting it was previously granted and uses the same email as their WMS account. They've attached an updated public key for the SFTP feed and confirm they've read and agree to the WMS integration access requirements.
INC_236.worknotes: The access team re-enabled the caller's Level 3 WMS integration access and added the updated public key; keys are managed through the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com. When the caller later got stuck partway through 2FA enrollment on the SSO portal right after the QR code step, the agent removed their registered device so they could re-enroll from scratch.
INC_236.resolution_notes: Level 3 WMS integration access was reactivated with the caller's updated public key, and their SSO portal 2FA device was reset so they could complete enrollment.

INC_237.short_description: Update DNS name servers for WMS hostname to new host
INC_237.description: The DNS servers for wms.westfieldlogistics.com need to be switched over to our new provider. The new name servers should be: ns1 at 198.51.44.6, ns2 at 198.51.45.6, ns3 at 198.51.44.70, and ns4 at 198.51.45.70. The zone is already set up on the new side, so it can be switched at will.
INC_237.worknotes: The access team confirmed the new DNS zone for wms.westfieldlogistics.com was already active on the new provider before submitting the delegation change.
INC_237.resolution_notes: The name server records for wms.westfieldlogistics.com were updated at the registrar to point to the four requested addresses.
INC_237.close_notes: The agent confirmed with the caller that the change was submitted and noted propagation would take some time.

INC_238.short_description: Add caller to Dispatch team network share
INC_238.description: I just moved over to the Dispatch team at the Dallas distribution center. Can someone add me to the team's shared network drive?
INC_238.worknotes: Agent confirmed the caller's new team assignment and added their account to the Dispatch team folder on the network shares.
INC_238.resolution_notes: Caller's account was granted access to the Dispatch team network share.
INC_238.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that they can now reach the shared drive.

INC_239.short_description: Restore WMS submit access for dispatcher account
INC_239.description: I tried to submit a load update through WMS today and it told me my access was disabled and to file a ticket. Can someone turn that back on for me?
INC_239.worknotes: Agent checked the caller's WMS role assignment and confirmed the account had been disabled on the application side. WMS submit access was re-enabled for the account.

INC_240.short_description: Move WMS Level 3 access to Westfield corporate account
INC_240.description: In an earlier ticket I requested WMS Level 3 supervisor access tied to the account under my personal email. Now that the WMS requires login through the SSO portal, it would be a lot more convenient to have that same access level on my Westfield account instead. Thanks!
INC_240.worknotes: An agent confirmed this didn't need to go through the standard access-request process, added the caller's Westfield account to the WMS Level 3 role, and confirmed their VPN client credentials were already on file (noted they may need to update their local config). WMS Level 3 access was granted on the caller's Westfield corporate account; they were told to log out of the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com and log back in so the WMS would pick up the change.

INC_241.short_description: CNAME update for shares.westfieldlogistics.com not propagating after DNS change
INC_241.description: I updated the CNAME for shares.westfieldlogistics.com in our DNS console three days ago on Friday so it points to the new file server cluster, but the change still isn't showing up when I look it up. I'm wondering if our DNS system isn't authoritative for that zone anymore for some reason.
INC_241.worknotes: Confirmed via DNS lookup that shares.westfieldlogistics.com now correctly resolves to the new file server cluster's IPv4 and IPv6 addresses. Checked the domain registrar record and found the nameservers on file were an old set, not the current anycast nameservers our DNS system uses. Updated the nameserver records at the domain registrar to the current anycast set, which restored our internal DNS zone as authoritative and allowed the CNAME change to propagate.

INC_242.short_description: VPN Client and WMS staging access requested to test a defect fix; certificate error blocks login
INC_242.description: I need Level 1 access to connect to the WMS staging environment so I can push test builds while validating a fix for an open routing defect. I use my personal email for now and have a usual VPN login handle on file; my manager is happy to vouch for the request.
INC_242.worknotes: The access team provisioned a WMS staging role, generated a VPN Client certificate, and granted Level 1 permissions, then emailed temporary credentials to the address on file and asked the caller to confirm once everything was working.
INC_242.resolution_notes: The caller reset the password and enrolled in OTP through the SSO portal, confirming the account itself was working, but then hit a permission-denied error tied to the VPN Client certificate when trying to actually connect to the WMS staging environment, and that piece was still unresolved when the thread went quiet.
INC_242.close_notes: Agent confirmed the account, OTP enrollment, and role provisioning were all in place, and asked the caller to open a follow-up if the VPN certificate permission-denied error kept blocking their connection.

INC_243.short_description: Rename OAuth client display name for employee directory app on SSO Portal
INC_243.description: When staff sign into the employee directory through the SSO portal, the consent screen says a third-party app called 'Warehouse Roster Prod' would like to access their account, which doesn't mean anything to most people. We never gave it a proper label when it was first set up. Could the SSO team change the display name to something clearer, like intranet.westfieldlogistics.com?
INC_243.worknotes: The access team located the OAuth client entry for the employee directory app in the SSO portal admin console, updated its display name, and asked the caller whether the staging environment's client should also be renamed. The SSO portal OAuth client's display name was changed from 'Warehouse Roster Prod' to 'intranet.westfieldlogistics.com'; the caller declined to rename the staging client.

INC_244.short_description: Reenable disabled SSO portal account and verify ownership
INC_244.description: My account on the Westfield SSO portal got disabled and I need it reenabled. I also no longer have access to my old Westfield email, so please use my personal email address for any follow-up on this.
INC_244.worknotes: Agent checked with the access team and confirmed the account would be reenabled under a temporary placeholder domain pending re-provisioning, then asked the caller to log in to the SSO portal with their password to confirm ownership.
INC_244.resolution_notes: The account was reenabled and the caller logged into otp.westfieldlogistics.com with their password to confirm ownership; the contact email on file was updated to the personal address the caller provided.
INC_244.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that login succeeded and the account was working again before closing the ticket.

INC_245.short_description: Re-enable WMS test environment access for QA testing
INC_245.description: The caller asked the service desk to re-enable their access to the WMS test environment, which had been disabled. They noted it was blocking required testing they needed to complete that day.
INC_245.worknotes: The agent escalated the ticket to critical priority since it was blocking necessary testing, looped in the access team, and confirmed the account's WMS test access had been re-enabled. Access team re-enabled the caller's WMS test environment access and asked the caller to log out of all active sessions, then log back in and verify access before resuming testing.

INC_246.short_description: Register staging Driver Training Portal app with SSO Portal
INC_246.description: Hi, following up on our earlier conversation, we'd like to get another portal set up behind the SSO Portal. We'll start by testing on the staging instance for now. Could you configure the Driver Training Portal (Staging) with these parameters: Login URL https://driverportal-stage.westfieldlogistics.com/login and Allowed Callback URL https://driverportal-stage.westfieldlogistics.com/callback?sso=1
INC_246.worknotes: Agent created the OIDC client application in the SSO Portal for the staging Driver Training Portal and generated the client credentials, sending them to the caller over a secure internal channel. SSO Portal client application was provisioned for the staging Driver Training Portal with the requested login and callback URLs; the caller then explained the ticket had been filed on a colleague's behalf, so the agent reissued the credentials directly to that colleague.

INC_247.short_description: WMS Level 1 access request for new hire at Dallas DC
INC_247.description: I'm requesting Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System for the Dallas distribution centre. I've attached my VPN client certificate for the request. I'd like to use my preferred login name for the account instead of the default naming convention.
INC_247.worknotes: The caller confirmed they had read and agreed to the WMS access requirements, and their manager vouched for the request before it was routed to the access team to provision the account.
INC_247.resolution_notes: The access team enabled WMS access and found the account already existed with Level 1 access and the same VPN certificate on file; they asked the caller to log out of all sessions, log back in, and confirm access worked.
INC_247.close_notes: Caller confirmed access was working after logging back in.

INC_248.short_description: Add my account to the network-share-administrators group to fix folder permissions
INC_248.description: The network share system has some built-in behavior that assumes admins are in the local network-share-administrators group instead of a custom one, and part of that behavior is supposed to bypass folder-level permission checks. I need to be added to that group so I can see everything and help staff fix folder permission issues on the shares.
INC_248.worknotes: Confirmed the network-share-administrators group is a built-in local group on the file server and not tied to a Westfield Drive access group, and pointed the caller to the share browser in the file server admin console as an alternative way to inspect folder permissions; when the caller reported local group membership wasn't available to them directly, the access team looked into mapping an equivalent Westfield Drive access group instead. The access team added a matching Westfield Drive access group, which the file server treated the same as the built-in local group and resolved the permission issue at the time; about a year later the group was found to have only one member whose account had since been disabled, so it was deleted.

INC_249.short_description: Reset MFA on SSO portal after new laptop fails to authenticate
INC_249.description: When I try to log into the SSO portal from my new laptop, I get an 'Access Denied' message saying my username can't authenticate with multi-factor verification, and it happens before I'm even prompted for a code. I also can't turn off MFA from my account preferences because I get the same error. Can someone reset MFA on my account so I can log back in?
INC_249.worknotes: Caller reached out via Slack; agent confirmed the MFA error was blocking both login and self-service MFA disablement, so temporarily disabled MFA on the account.
INC_249.resolution_notes: Agent temporarily disabled MFA on the SSO portal account so the caller could log back in, then asked them to re-enroll MFA as soon as possible; caller confirmed they logged in and re-enrolled.

INC_250.short_description: Level 1 WMS access request for new hire
INC_250.description: Requesting Level 1 WMS access for a new hire on our team. I've read and agree to abide by the WMS access requirements, and I'm vouching for them - full disclosure, we're related, but I'm confident based on the reconciliation work they completed on two recent inventory tickets, one of which bounced out of the production sync queue and will need staging access to finish.
INC_250.worknotes: Agent verified the read-and-agree acknowledgment and the manager's vouch, then created the account, added the Level 1 WMS role and staging network share, and attached the submitted public key. Account was provisioned with Level 1 WMS access, staging share access, and the key on file; login credentials were emailed and access was confirmed live within 40 minutes.

INC_251.short_description: Level 1 WMS test-environment submit access request
INC_251.description: I need Level 1 access to the WMS test environment so I can start submitting trial putaway adjustments. I've attached my VPN client certificate as required and confirm I've read and agree to the WMS access requirements.
INC_251.worknotes: A colleague vouched for the request; the access team enabled Level 1 WMS test-environment access on the caller's account and asked them to log out of all SSO portal sessions and log back in to pick up the new permissions.
INC_251.resolution_notes: Level 1 WMS test-environment access was enabled on the caller's account after the vouch was confirmed; re-authenticating through the SSO portal applied the new permissions.

INC_252.description: I'd like to request Level 3 role access in the Warehouse Management System. My earlier request ended up getting tied to my personal account instead of my Westfield one, and since the SSO portal only lets me stay logged into one account at a time, it's been a real hassle switching back and forth. Could my supervisor vouch for me on this so it gets fixed?
INC_252.worknotes: The caller's shift supervisor confirmed the caller is still active on the dispatch team and vouched for the access; the access team found an existing device credential on file from the earlier, misassigned request.
INC_252.resolution_notes: WMS Level 3 role access was enabled against the caller's correct Westfield SSO account; the caller was asked to log out of all active sessions on the SSO portal and log back in to pick up the change.

INC_253.short_description: Update DNS nameserver records for SSO portal move to new host
INC_253.description: We're ready to move the SSO portal over to the new hosting provider, so I need the whois/nameserver information updated to point to their DNS servers. Everything is already set up on the new host's side, so this can happen whenever is convenient.
INC_253.worknotes: The access team verified the new nameserver records supplied by the caller and submitted the change to the domain registrar for otp.westfieldlogistics.com. The nameserver change was completed at the registrar; the caller was told to allow up to 24 hours for the update to fully propagate.

INC_254.short_description: Point DNS/nameservers for WMS load-tracker subdomains to new host
INC_254.description: We're moving the load-tracker tool over to our new hosting platform and it uses three internal hostnames under westfieldlogistics.com. Could you get the DNS/nameserver records for those changed to the new nameservers whenever it's convenient - everything is already set up on the new host's end. Please allow up to 24 hours for the changes to take effect.
INC_254.worknotes: Agent confirmed the four target nameserver addresses with the caller and submitted the DNS update for the three hostnames to the network team. Network team updated the nameserver records for two of the three hostnames and confirmed they were resolving correctly on the new platform; the third was still pending propagation, consistent with the standard up-to-24-hour window.

INC_255.short_description: Grant WMS order-edit role for warehouse associate
INC_255.description: One of the caller's warehouse associates needs edit access on WMS orders instead of always routing changes through the caller. The caller notes the associate has already handled corrections on a couple of specific orders and has enough experience to work directly in the system.
INC_255.worknotes: Reviewed the associate's WMS activity history and confirmed prior order corrections on two orders, then forwarded the role change request to the WMS access team for approval.
INC_255.resolution_notes: WMS access team granted the associate the Order Editor role in the Warehouse Management System.
INC_255.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that the associate now has edit access and the change is working as expected.

INC_256.short_description: WMS Level 1 access request for new distribution centre associate
INC_256.description: I'm joining the receiving team at the Dallas distribution centre and need Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System. I've attached my device key as requested and have read and agree to the WMS access requirements.
INC_256.worknotes: The caller's team lead confirmed the caller is joining the team and vouched for the access request; the access team verified the attached device key and the signed access requirements acknowledgment.
INC_256.resolution_notes: The access team provisioned Level 1 WMS access and registered the device key, noting that changes can take up to an hour to propagate across the system.

INC_257.short_description: New Hire Requests Level 1 VPN Client Access, Vouched by Manager and Teammate
INC_257.description: I'm requesting Level 1 access to the Westfield VPN Client and have attached my public key file for the account. I've read and agree to abide by the VPN Client access requirements, and I understand my manager needs to vouch for me before the account can be created.
INC_257.worknotes: Confirmed that both the caller's manager and a teammate submitted vouches for the request in the ticket thread, then forwarded the attached public key to the access team for account setup.
INC_257.resolution_notes: The access team created the caller's VPN Client account with Level 1 access using the submitted public key.

INC_258.short_description: New Level 1 WMS submit access request for warehouse clerk - Dallas DC
INC_258.description: I'm a new hire at the Dallas distribution centre and need Level 1 submit access on the Warehouse Management System so I can post inventory adjustments. I've attached my terminal login key as requested. My shift supervisor has agreed to vouch for the request.
INC_258.worknotes: The caller's supervisor confirmed they vouch for the request and acknowledged the WMS access policy; ticket handed to the access team to provision the account. The access team created the WMS account, added the terminal login key and Level 1 submit access, and emailed the caller their credentials; noted the change can take up to 40 minutes to sync and may require logging out of the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com to appear in SSO-linked tools.

INC_259.short_description: Level 1 WMS write access request for inventory sync scripts
INC_259.description: I'm requesting Level 1 write access to the Warehouse Management System so my sync scripts can push inventory updates. I've attached my SSH public key. I have read and agree to abide by the WMS Access Requirements.
INC_259.worknotes: The access team confirmed the vouch from the caller's manager and handed the request to the systems team, who added the SSH key and enabled Level 1 write access on the WMS servers. Level 1 WMS account was provisioned (allow about 40 minutes to propagate on the WMS servers); caller was told to log out and back into the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com for the new access to show up, and to configure SSH per the intranet WMS integration guide before pushing.

INC_260.short_description: Add caller to VPN access group for WMS staging environment
INC_260.description: The caller's manager submitted this request explaining that the caller is doing a lot of work on the new WMS interface and would benefit from access to the new staging site. They're asking that the caller be added to the VPN access group that covers that environment.
INC_260.worknotes: Agent verified the request with the caller's manager and added the caller to the VPN access group covering the WMS staging environment.
INC_260.resolution_notes: The caller was added to the group; they needed to reconnect the Westfield VPN Client and log out/back into the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com for the change to propagate across systems.

INC_261.short_description: Request for edit access to a submitted WMS incident report
INC_261.description: I logged an issue in the Warehouse Management System a while back, but I can't go in and edit the description I originally wrote. Can someone add edit permissions to my account so I can fix up that report?
INC_261.worknotes: Access team confirmed the caller's account and reviewed two prior reports they had submitted in the WMS before approving the edit-level access request. Edit permissions were added to the caller's WMS account, allowing them to update descriptions on reports they have submitted.

INC_262.short_description: WMS Level 3 access request for warehouse data corrections
INC_262.description: I currently have Level 1 access in the WMS. I'd like to be upgraded to Level 3 so I can fix small data entry errors, like typos in bin locations or SKU descriptions, without having to loop in someone else every time.
INC_262.worknotes: The caller's manager vouched for the upgrade, and the ticket was routed to the access team to provision the higher WMS role. The access team enabled Level 3 WMS access on the caller's account and asked them to log out of all active sessions and log back in for the change to take effect.

INC_263.short_description: Restore VPN access disabled due to account inactivity
INC_263.description: I haven't connected through the Westfield VPN Client in over six months, and now when I try to log in I get a message saying my account was found but VPN access has been disabled. Can someone get this turned back on for me?
INC_263.worknotes: Agent confirmed the account was located and configured for VPN access but had been auto-disabled after 6+ months without a connection, per the standard inactivity policy; routed the request to the access team to reactivate it. The access team restored VPN access on the caller's account.

INC_264.short_description: Level 1 write access request for Warehouse Management System account
INC_264.description: I need Level 1 write access enabled on my Warehouse Management System account so I can start making inventory updates. I've attached my access key file as required and confirm I've read and agree to the WMS access requirements.
INC_264.worknotes: The caller's supervisor vouched for the request on the ticket, so it was routed to the access team to provision the Level 1 WMS role.
INC_264.resolution_notes: The access team enabled Level 1 access and the inventory-update permission on the account, then asked the caller to log out of all sessions and log back into WMS to test.
INC_264.close_notes: The caller confirmed access was working and the ticket was closed.

INC_265.short_description: Westfield VPN Client access appears to have been revoked
INC_265.description: My VPN client access to the Westfield network seems to have stopped working — I can no longer connect from my laptop. I ran a verbose connection test and it shows the handshake starting but authentication never completes.
INC_265.worknotes: The access team checked the caller's network access group membership and confirmed it was still active, then pointed them to the VPN client setup guide on intranet.westfieldlogistics.com.
INC_265.resolution_notes: The caller updated the Westfield VPN Client configuration file on their laptop per the documentation, which resolved the connection issue.
INC_265.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that VPN access was restored and closed the ticket.

INC_266.short_description: Level 3 VPN Client Access Request for Systems Analyst
INC_266.description: Requesting Level 3 access on the Westfield VPN Client so I can remotely manage internal systems from the Dallas distribution center. Attached is my public key for the certificate-based connection. I have read and agree to abide by the VPN Level 3 Access Requirements.
INC_266.worknotes: Two colleagues vouched for the caller's need for elevated access, and the ticket was routed to the network access team to provision the account with the submitted public key.
INC_266.resolution_notes: The network access team enabled Level 3 VPN Client access for the caller's account using the submitted public key.
INC_266.close_notes: Agent asked the caller to log out of all VPN sessions, reconnect, and confirm the elevated access works.

INC_267.short_description: Remove warehouse worker's WMS role and VPN Client group after reassignment
INC_267.description: Please remove this employee from the WMS driver role and the matching Westfield VPN Client access group. They've been reassigned and no longer need access to the Warehouse Management System.
INC_267.worknotes: Access team removed the account from the WMS role group and the corresponding Westfield VPN Client access group.
INC_267.resolution_notes: Access was removed from both groups; the caller was told the user will need to log out and back into the Westfield VPN Client and SSO portal before the change takes effect.

INC_268.short_description: WMS scripts repository - Level 1 commit access request
INC_268.description: I need Level 1 write access to the WMS scripts repository so I can start committing configuration changes. I've attached my SSH public key and I've read and agree to abide by the access requirements for this system.
INC_268.worknotes: The caller's team lead vouched for the request, so it was routed to the access team for WMS Level 1 provisioning; the access team confirmed the SSH key already on file for the account was valid before adding the caller to the WMS-Scripts-L1 group.
INC_268.resolution_notes: The access team granted the caller Level 1 write access to the WMS scripts repository using the existing SSH key on the account and pointed them to the setup guide on intranet.westfieldlogistics.com for testing access and configuring their client.
INC_268.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that Level 1 access was working before closing the ticket.

INC_269.short_description: Re-enable WMS account access disabled due to inactivity
INC_269.description: My WMS login isn't working anymore. I think it's because my account was flagged for inactivity. I was granted full inventory access a while back on a previous ticket and just need it turned back on so I can get back to work.
INC_269.worknotes: Ticket was routed to the access team, who confirmed the account had been automatically disabled by the WMS platform after several months without a login, per the system's standard inactivity policy. Another agent flagged the ticket to keep it moving. The access team manually re-enabled the caller's WMS account access.

INC_270.short_description: Add internal dispatch tool to SSO portal trusted app list
INC_270.description: Hi, I'd like to add our new internal app to the SSO portal's list of trusted applications so we can use it for login. The service is Dispatch Route Planner (Dev), running at driveplan-dev.westfieldlogistics.com, and I'm the service owner. It's for internal dispatch use only, under 30 users and used pretty inconsistently, and access should be limited to Westfield dispatch staff only.
INC_270.worknotes: Agent flagged that the callback URL shouldn't point to the domain root and asked the caller to use a dedicated path instead; caller updated it to driveplan-dev.westfieldlogistics.com/login. Access team issued SSO credentials for the app and deployed the access rule restricting login to Westfield dispatch staff only.

INC_271.short_description: SSO Portal API credentials needed for new WMS dev environment
INC_271.description: We're spinning up a new dev instance for the WMS and need SSO Portal API credentials registered for it. The callback URL is https://wms-dev.westfieldlogistics.com/auth/sso/callback. Could we also get the same access scopes as our existing WMS production integration, with the credentials sent to my teammate on this project?
INC_271.worknotes: The access team registered the new client and sent the credentials to the caller's teammate; when the caller reported an access-denied error requesting a token against the management API, the agent found the new client was missing a client-grant for that API. The access team added the missing API scopes to the new client so its grants matched the production integration, which cleared the access-denied error.

INC_272.short_description: New WMS elevated access request for Dallas DC associate, needs supervisor vouching
INC_272.description: I've read and agree to abide by the WMS Data Access Requirements. I'm requesting elevated access to the Warehouse Management System so I can start making inventory adjustments — my supervisor can vouch for me and help get this set up.
INC_272.worknotes: Agent confirmed the caller's supervisor vouched for the request, noting the caller would start on the open inventory reconciliation task before moving into broader dispatch scheduling work; ticket routed to the access provisioning team for account setup. The access provisioning team completed setup of the caller's elevated WMS account once supervisor vouching was on record.

INC_273.short_description: Grant WMS record edit access to warehouse associate
INC_273.description: Requesting edit access in the WMS for a colleague on my team so they can update shipment and order records directly instead of routing every change through me. They've already worked on shipment records SH-1553545 and SH-1565562, which should show they're ready for the added access.
INC_273.worknotes: Agent reviewed the two referenced shipment records to confirm the associate's prior work on them, then submitted the role change to the WMS access team.
INC_273.resolution_notes: The WMS access team granted the associate the WMS record edit role.
INC_273.close_notes: Closed after confirming with the caller that the associate now has edit access in the WMS.

INC_274.short_description: Level 1 WMS access for new warehouse associate at Dallas DC
INC_274.description: I'm starting as a warehouse associate at the Dallas DC and need Level 1 access to the WMS so I can start scanning inbound shipments. I've read and agree to the WMS access requirements. I don't have my Westfield email set up yet, so please send anything to my personal address for now.
INC_274.worknotes: The caller's supervisor vouched for them, confirming they'd already been doing good work on the floor, so the ticket was handed off to the access team to provision the account.
INC_274.resolution_notes: The access team created the caller's WMS account with Level 1 associate access and emailed the temporary password to their personal address.

INC_275.short_description: WMS Level 1 Access Provisioning for New Warehouse Associate
INC_275.description: Requesting Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System so I can start logging inbound and outbound inventory moves at the Dallas distribution centre. I've attached my public authentication key as required. I have read and agree to abide by the WMS Level 1 Access requirements.
INC_275.worknotes: Their supervisor confirmed and vouched for the access request; ticket routed to the access team to provision the account. The access team enabled WMS access on the account, added the caller's authentication key, and granted Level 1 permissions.

INC_276.short_description: Level 1 VPN Client access requested for WMS staging environment
INC_276.description: I'm requesting level-1 VPN access so I can use the WMS staging environment for testing. I have read, and agree to abide by, the Access Requirements. SSH public key attached.
INC_276.worknotes: The caller's manager vouched for the request; ticket routed to the access team to provision the Level 1 account. Access team enabled WMS staging access and added the caller's SSH key to the account; caller was directed to manage keys going forward via the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com.

INC_277.short_description: WMS Level 2 access request for dispatcher at Dallas DC
INC_277.description: I need Level 2 access to the Warehouse Management System so I can process inventory adjustments and shipment overrides at the Dallas distribution centre. I've attached my completed WMS access request form and agree to abide by the WMS Level 2 Access Policy. My supervisor is vouching for me on this request.
INC_277.worknotes: The caller's supervisor confirmed the caller is ready to take on Level 2 WMS duties, so the access team escalated the request to provision the WMS Level 2 role. The access team granted WMS Level 2 access and asked the caller to log out of the SSO portal and back in, noting the change could take up to an hour to apply; the caller then confirmed a successful WMS login showing membership in the wms_level_1 and wms_level_2 role groups.

INC_278.short_description: Level 1 WMS access request for new reporting team hire
INC_278.description: I need Level 1 WMS access set up for a new hire joining the reporting team at the Dallas distribution centre. They'll be working on load-time and throughput reporting projects, and I can vouch for them as their manager.
INC_278.worknotes: Agent confirmed the manager's approval was documented in the ticket thread and checked whether a higher access tier had already been requested for the same person.
INC_278.resolution_notes: Closed as a duplicate of the related Level 3 WMS access request already in progress, since Level 3 access includes all Level 1 permissions.
INC_278.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that the Level 3 ticket covers this request and no further action is needed.
INC_278.problem_display: WMS Level 3 access request for new distribution centre auditor

INC_279.short_description: WMS Level 3 access request for new distribution centre auditor
INC_279.description: Requesting Level 3 WMS access for a new starter joining the Dallas distribution centre. Their manager can vouch for them - they will be working on cycle count and inventory audit tasks in the warehouse system.
INC_279.worknotes: Agent found two open requests for this employee, one for Level 1 access and one for Level 3, and asked the caller which level was actually needed.
INC_279.resolution_notes: Per the WMS onboarding guide, working as a cycle count auditor requires both Level 1 and Level 3 access, so both were granted, and the duplicate Level 3 request was closed as a duplicate of this ticket.
INC_279.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that both access levels were provisioned as expected.
INC_279.problem_display: WMS Level 3 access request for new distribution centre auditor

INC_280.short_description: VPN Client access request pending sponsor vouch and email verification
INC_280.description: I need Level 1 access set up on the Westfield VPN Client and I've attached my device's public key file for it. I haven't been issued a westfieldlogistics.com mailbox yet, so please use my personal email address for this request for now.
INC_280.worknotes: The agent asked the caller to confirm agreement to the VPN Client access policy and have a manager with elevated access rights vouch for them on the ticket; the caller's manager vouched for them, citing solid work on a prior access request. The agent then noted the personal email on file could not be confirmed as belonging to the caller and asked for a verifiable address before proceeding.
INC_280.resolution_notes: As of the last update on the ticket, the policy acknowledgment and manager vouch were on record but the agent was still waiting on the caller to confirm a verifiable email address, so Level 1 VPN Client access had not yet been granted.

INC_281.short_description: Reactivate WMS Application login after account was deactivated
INC_281.description: My WMS login got deactivated and I need it turned back on - thank you! Also, is there any way accounts used for the dispatch routing integration could get a 2-year expiration instead of the standard 6 months? We don't log into WMS directly anymore, but the routing system needs an active WMS account behind the scenes to keep retriggering and queuing jobs.
INC_281.worknotes: Agent re-enabled the caller's WMS Application account and asked them to log out and back in to confirm access was restored. Access was restored and confirmed working by the caller; the question about extending the expiration window for integration-only accounts was outside the service desk's authority, so the caller was asked to email the WMS platform lead directly for an answer.

INC_282.short_description: Grant service desk agent access to reset SSO Portal passwords for on-call coverage
INC_282.description: Our service desk team is trying to expand on-call coverage. With one of our agents out on leave, we'd like another team member to be able to perform SSO Portal password resets for corporate, warehouse, and driver portal accounts. Can you set up that access for them?
INC_282.worknotes: The access team reviewed the request and added the agent to the SSO Portal password-reset access group. The agent was added to the SSO Portal password-reset ACL, giving them the ability to reset passwords for corporate, warehouse, and driver-portal accounts.

INC_283.short_description: Cannot cancel jobs in WMS - SSO password expired since 2016
INC_283.description: When I try to cancel shipment jobs in the WMS, I get an error that my account does not have permission to do that action. I logged out of the WMS and the SSO portal and logged back in but it still fails. I was told I need to authenticate directly through the SSO portal, and it looks like my password has not been changed since 2016 so it must be expired.
INC_283.worknotes: The agent asked the caller to log out of WMS and the SSO portal and log back in after their access was restored, then when the error persisted pointed them to the WMS support channel on Slack since the permissions issue was outside the agent's queue.
INC_283.resolution_notes: The access team found the caller's SSO Portal password had not been reset since 2016 and issued a new one, which restored direct authentication and let them cancel jobs in WMS.
INC_283.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that they could log into the SSO portal and cancel WMS jobs successfully.

INC_284.short_description: Grant access to the WMS staging environment for a colleague
INC_284.description: The caller is asking that a colleague on the operations team be granted access to the WMS staging environment. They explain that the colleague will need to both reach the staging environment over the network and be able to log in to it, so two things are likely needed: routing access and a staging login role.
INC_284.worknotes: The access team reviewed the request and added the colleague to the WMS staging role and the matching Westfield VPN Client group used to route to the staging subnet.
INC_284.resolution_notes: Added the colleague to both the WMS staging access role and the corresponding VPN Client routing group.
INC_284.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that the colleague can now route to and log in to the WMS staging environment.

INC_285.short_description: Request to upgrade WMS access to Level 3 for returning warehouse associate
INC_285.description: I'm asking that a returning seasonal warehouse associate be upgraded to Level 3 access in the Warehouse Management System. They held Level 1 access during their internship last summer and handled inventory adjustments responsibly the whole time, so I'm happy to vouch for them. They've also confirmed they've read and agree to the WMS Access Policy.
INC_285.worknotes: Agent checked the prior case where Level 1 access was granted during the associate's internship, confirmed two team leads submitted vouches for the Level 3 request, and verified the associate's acknowledgment of the WMS Access Policy was on file. WMS role was upgraded to Level 3, granting full inventory adjustment and override rights, once both vouches and the policy acknowledgment were confirmed.

INC_286.short_description: Reset password for WMS-to-Slack notification bot account
INC_286.description: I'm listed as the owner of the automated service account that posts WMS shipment alerts into Slack. IT flagged the account as due for a password reset and asked me to confirm before they proceed.
INC_286.worknotes: Agent checked the service account registry, confirmed the caller was the listed owner, and got their go-ahead to reset the credentials. The access team reset the service account's password.

INC_287.short_description: Disable two-factor authentication on SSO Portal account
INC_287.description: Please disable two-factor authentication on my SSO Portal account, as I requested by email. I no longer have access to my authenticator device and need to get back in.
INC_287.worknotes: Agent verified the caller's identity using the encrypted message signed with the security key on file for their account before making any changes. Two-factor authentication was disabled on the caller's otp.westfieldlogistics.com SSO Portal account after identity was confirmed via their encrypted email request.

INC_288.short_description: Set up hostnames for new WMS analytics dashboard
INC_288.description: We need two internal hostnames set up for the new WMS analytics dashboard going to production: analytics.wms.westfieldlogistics.com and analytics-frame.wms.westfieldlogistics.com, both pointing to the dashboard's backend servers. Let me know if you have any questions.
INC_288.worknotes: Agent created the two requested hostname records pointing to the dashboard backend servers. Both hostnames were created and pointed to the correct backend servers as requested.

INC_289.short_description: Provision SSO Portal application for production branch intranet sites
INC_289.description: We requested this same setup for the staging branch intranet sites a while back — could the access team please create a new SSO Portal application for the production versions of those sites too? There are six sites total across the branches.
INC_289.worknotes: Agent gathered the login URLs for all six production intranet sites and confirmed the new SSO Portal application needed a matching callback URL entry for each one.
INC_289.resolution_notes: The access team added the requested callback URL pattern (allowing the '/index.php?auth0=1' redirect) to the SSO Portal application for each of the six sites; a login error appeared afterward and was still being investigated with the caller when the ticket was last updated.
INC_289.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that the callback URLs were updated for every site and asked them to send the full error details from the login page so the remaining issue could be tracked down.

INC_290.short_description: WMS Level 1 access request for new warehouse associate
INC_290.description: I've read and agree to the WMS Level 1 access requirements. My supervisor has agreed to vouch for me so I can get the account set up. Please let me know once it's ready.
INC_290.worknotes: Supervisor confirmed approval for Level 1 WMS access; agent looped in the access team to provision the account. Access team granted Level 1 WMS role along with the associated network share and VPN client permissions, and advised that changes can take up to 1 hour to propagate, after which the caller needs to log out and back into the SSO portal.

INC_291.short_description: Reactivate WMS staging access for dormant contractor account
INC_291.description: I used to work on the Dallas warehouse scanner integrations for the WMS as a contractor, but I stopped in 2015 and haven't touched the system since. I recently came across an issue I want to help fix, but for that I need my push access to the WMS test/staging environment restored. I saw a note on intranet.westfieldlogistics.com about dormant accounts needing to file a ticket with IT, but I'm not sure this is the right queue, so please redirect if it isn't.
INC_291.worknotes: Agent searched open tickets for the same account and found an existing request already tracking reactivation of this access. Closed as a duplicate of an existing ticket already in progress for the same WMS access reactivation; no separate action was taken here.
INC_291.problem_display: Reactivate WMS test-queue access so a fix can be submitted for testing

INC_292.short_description: WMS staging account appears inactive, blocking patch testing
INC_292.description: I'm working on a couple of patches for the WMS and think I need to run them against the staging environment, so could someone reactivate my staging account? I haven't used it in years and want to make sure it's actually working before I start testing.
INC_292.worknotes: Looped in the WMS access team to check; they confirmed the account was active with staging access enabled and both required roles showing enabled, and asked the caller to describe the exact error since everything looked fine on their end. Caller reported hitting an authentication error over the weekend, which was expected given the account's long inactivity, but confirmed it was working normally again the following day.

INC_293.short_description: Elevated WMS staging access for performance test scripts
INC_293.description: I need elevated access to the WMS staging environment so I can run custom performance test scripts against the new mobile scanner module. I've attached my SSH public key and confirm I've read and agree to the access requirements.
INC_293.worknotes: The caller's supervisor vouched for the request, confirming it was needed to run performance tests against the mobile scanner module. The request was routed to the access team, who enabled the staging role and added the caller's SSH key.
INC_293.resolution_notes: The access team enabled the staging environment role and installed the caller's SSH key; the caller was asked to log out of all sessions, log back in, and test.
INC_293.close_notes: Caller confirmed they were able to commit test scripts to staging and successfully launch a performance test against the mobile scanner module.

INC_294.short_description: Reactivate WMS test-queue access so a fix can be submitted for testing
INC_294.description: I'm trying to submit a fix to the WMS test queue for a scanning workflow issue, but every submission fails with a permission error. My manager thinks my test-environment account may have gone inactive at some point, so we're asking IT to check what's needed to get my access working again so we can verify the fix.

The caller reported the same permission error after the access change and noted they had no active session to log out of; they were last seen re-running the submission tool to capture further error output for the access team.
INC_294.problem_display: Reactivate WMS test-queue access so a fix can be submitted for testing

INC_295.short_description: Re-enable WMS account disabled due to inactivity
INC_295.description: My WMS login was disabled because of inactivity and now I can't run the test batch loads I need for an upcoming slotting change. Can someone get my account turned back on?
INC_295.worknotes: Access team located the caller's WMS account, confirmed it had been auto-disabled for inactivity, and submitted it for re-enablement.
INC_295.resolution_notes: Access team re-enabled the caller's WMS account.
INC_295.close_notes: Agent asked the caller to confirm access was restored; caller confirmed it now works.

INC_296.short_description: Add new callback URL to WMS staging app in SSO Portal client config
INC_296.description: Can we get the URL https://wms-staging.westfieldlogistics.com/auth/callback added to the list of allowed callback URLs for the WMS staging application's client configuration in the SSO portal? We can remove the callback URL for the old staging environment later once that one is shut down.
INC_296.worknotes: The access team located the WMS staging client configuration in the SSO portal and added the requested callback URL to its allowed list.
INC_296.resolution_notes: The new callback URL was added to the SSO portal client configuration; the legacy staging callback URL was left in place pending decommission of that environment.

INC_297.short_description: WMS Level 3 Role Access for Secondary Account
INC_297.description: I already have Level 3 role access to the WMS granted under my work email from a previous request, and I'd like the same access added to my personal email account. I've attached my SSH public key and confirm I've read and agree to the WMS access requirements.
INC_297.worknotes: An agent noted the caller already held Level 3 access and vouching was not required since this was only an account change; the request was routed straight to the access team. The caller then switched to a new computer and submitted a new SSH public key to replace the original one on file. The access team granted WMS Level 3 role access under the caller's personal account, attached the new SSH key, and emailed a temporary password.

INC_298.short_description: Copy WMS/share access permissions to new contractor account for intern
INC_298.description: I'm currently an intern with a Westfield Logistics network account. I'd like to have my existing WMS and network share access permissions copied over to a new contractor account, since my prior access was set up under a separate request. I've read and agree to abide by the account access requirements.
INC_298.worknotes: The access team located the caller's prior access request for reference and confirmed the new contractor account should mirror the same WMS role and network share permissions, then routed the request to the provisioning team.
INC_298.resolution_notes: The access team provisioned the new contractor account with network login, WMS role access, and matching network share permissions, and sent the temporary password to the caller's on-file email.

INC_299.short_description: Create service account for third-party WMS-to-intranet sync tool
INC_299.description: We need to create a service account for a third-party tool that syncs work order records between the WMS and the intranet dashboard. Can this account be called "WMS Sync Service"? The only access it needs is to the WMS system. Let me know if you have any questions.
INC_299.worknotes: Agent asked what mechanism performs the sync, noting that SSO accounts usually don't work well with automation tools and a local WMS account with an application key is more likely what's needed; caller explained the sync runs through a third-party tool and the account needs to be a WMS admin, a collaborator on the intranet dashboard, and the login for the sync tool itself, and that they'd been testing with a temporary test account in the meantime. Agent created the service account with the requested access and sent the credentials to the caller through the secure credential vault.

INC_300.short_description: Copy Level 3 WMS access from personal to Westfield account
INC_300.description: My personal account already has Level 3 access in the WMS, and it's linked to my new Westfield account through the SSO portal. Juggling two-factor logins across two separate accounts for WMS and Westfield Drive is a nightmare — can you copy that Level 3 permission over to my Westfield account instead?
INC_300.worknotes: The agent verified the caller's existing Level 3 role on their personal account and applied the same role, including system access and security key setup, to their Westfield employee account, flagging that changes could take up to an hour to propagate and would require a fresh SSO portal login. Level 3 permission was granted on the caller's Westfield account; after logging out and back into the SSO portal, the caller confirmed they could perform Level 3 actions in WMS, with Westfield Drive access to be tested the next time it was needed.

INC_301.short_description: WMS contributor-level access request for warehouse intern
INC_301.description: I'm a current intern with a Westfield Logistics account and previously had read-only access to the WMS staging environment. I'd like my existing WMS permissions copied over to a contributor-level account so I can commit changes there, and I'll be using my personal email address as the login for that account. I've read and agree to the WMS contributor access requirements.
INC_301.worknotes: The access team confirmed the caller's mentor vouched for the request per WMS access policy, then created the contributor-level WMS account tied to the caller's personal email, issued a temporary access credential, and enabled Level 1 permissions on the WMS staging environment. The access team granted Level 1 contributor access on the WMS staging environment and sent the caller their new login credentials.

INC_302.short_description: Merge old SSO Portal account into new account
INC_302.description: The caller asked the access team to merge their old SSO Portal account into the new one issued after they moved from a Portland branch contract role to a full-time Dallas position, and hoped their existing permissions and ticket history could carry over. They apologized for the extra work.
INC_302.worknotes: An agent had the caller confirm ownership by replying from the other account before proceeding with the merge. The access team merged the old SSO Portal account into the caller's new account, preserving existing permissions and history.

INC_303.short_description: WMS Level 1 access request for logistics capstone intern
INC_303.description: I'm a university capstone student working with the operations team and need Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System, not Level 3. I've read and agree to the WMS access requirements, and my project sponsor can vouch for me.
INC_303.worknotes: The caller's project sponsor confirmed Level 1 was the correct tier for this engagement and vouched for the caller; a second manager also signed off before the request moved forward.
INC_303.resolution_notes: The access team created a Level 1 WMS account for the caller.
INC_303.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that the new WMS Level 1 account was working.

INC_304.short_description: Level 1 WMS access for mentored intern at Portland branch
INC_304.description: I only need Level 1 access to the WMS for now. I'm a college student my supervisor is mentoring this semester, and I've attached my signed access agreement and confirm I've read and agree to the WMS access requirements.
INC_304.worknotes: The caller's manager vouched for the intern as a mentee for the semester and confirmed Level 1 was the right access tier before the request was routed to the access team.
INC_304.resolution_notes: The access team provisioned a new WMS account for the intern with Level 1 permissions under their supervisor's sponsorship.
INC_304.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that their Level 1 WMS access is active and working.

INC_305.short_description: WMS Level 1 access request for new warehouse associate at Dallas DC
INC_305.description: I need Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System so I can start scanning and picking orders at the Dallas distribution centre. I've read and agreed to the WMS access requirements, and my supervisor has already signed off on the request.
INC_305.worknotes: Confirmed the supervisor's approval was on file, then forwarded the request to the access team to provision the WMS account. The access team created a Level 1 WMS operator account with handheld scanner login enabled and emailed the credentials to the caller.

INC_306.short_description: Service account needs additional scope to read org hierarchy data via SSO portal API
INC_306.description: To pull organizational hierarchy information for our reporting integration, our service account needs read access to hierarchy data through the SSO portal's directory API, but it looks like the account doesn't have enough permissions for that.
