The initial access for this account was set up under a previous request.
INC_306.worknotes: The access team reviewed the service account's current permissions on the SSO portal and confirmed the hierarchy-read scope was missing.
INC_306.resolution_notes: The access team granted the service account the additional hierarchy-read scope needed to query organizational data through the SSO portal API.
INC_306.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that the integration could now successfully pull hierarchy data.

INC_307.short_description: WMS Level 1 Access Request for Seasonal Dallas DC Intern
INC_307.description: I'd like to request Level 1 access to the WMS for my account, and I'd prefer to use my personal email as the login for now. I've attached my SSH public key for the connection. I've read and agree to abide by the WMS Access Requirements.
INC_307.worknotes: The caller's manager confirmed they are a college student working with the Dallas distribution centre team this semester and vouched for Level 1 WMS access; the access team created the account and applied the Level 1 role along with the submitted SSH key.
INC_307.resolution_notes: The access team emailed the new account credentials to the caller and noted the SSH key could take up to an hour to propagate to the WMS servers.
INC_307.close_notes: Following up with the caller to confirm WMS Level 1 access is working now that the key has propagated.

INC_308.short_description: Zoom access permission request for account
INC_308.description: Hi, can I please get Zoom permission added to my account if possible? I work as a dispatcher but I'm also part of the Driver Support Council, and our regular meetings are starting back up soon.
INC_308.worknotes: Agent granted Zoom access permission on the caller's account and asked them to log out and back into the SSO portal, then navigate to the Zoom app tile at otp.westfieldlogistics.com/zoom to confirm access.
INC_308.resolution_notes: Zoom access permission was added to the caller's account; logging out and back into the SSO portal enabled the Zoom app tile.
INC_308.close_notes: Caller confirmed the Zoom login is working after logging back into the SSO portal.

INC_309.short_description: Level 1 WMS role access request for new warehouse associate
INC_309.description: I'm requesting Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System for my new role. I've read and agree to abide by the WMS access requirements. Let me know if you need anything else from me to get this approved.
INC_309.worknotes: The access team confirmed sign-off from the caller's supervisor and two colleagues vouching for the request per the WMS access policy, then routed it to the account provisioning team to create the account. Account provisioning created the Level 1 WMS role account for the caller once the required approvals were on file.

INC_310.short_description: Zoom meeting host access for non-staff program coordinator
INC_310.description: Hi, I'd like to get Zoom access set up on my account. I'm the coordinator for the Carrier Partner Hub pages on the intranet and would like to host meetings for that group. Is this possible?
INC_310.worknotes: Agent confirmed the caller holds a non-employee partner account with no Zoom license assigned and looked into whether hosting rights could be extended to that account type. No access was provisioned; the caller confirmed before this was completed that the Zoom access was no longer needed.

INC_311.short_description: New Dallas DC contractor requests Level 1 WMS system access
INC_311.description: I've attached my VPN public key and the signed access agreement as requested. I've read and agree to abide by the Level 1 System Access Requirements for the WMS. Sorry, I just realized after uploading that I can't go back and edit the attachment.
INC_311.worknotes: The caller's supervisor vouched for them to receive Level 1 access; the access team verified the request and the attached public key before provisioning the account.
INC_311.resolution_notes: Level 1 access was granted: a directory account was created, the VPN client key was added, and the WMS role was assigned; a temporary password was emailed to the caller with a request to confirm login.
INC_311.close_notes: Caller confirmed they were able to sign in and thanked the team; ticket closed.

INC_312.short_description: WMS Level 1 access request for returning seasonal contractor
INC_312.description: I was a seasonal warehouse associate last summer and had WMS access, and I'd like that same permission level copied over to a new account now that I'm returning as a contractor. My previous access was requested in an earlier ticket. I don't have a Westfield email yet, so I'd like my login tied to my personal email, and I've read and agree to the WMS Access Requirements.
INC_312.worknotes: The access team pulled up the caller's prior seasonal ticket to confirm the access level originally granted, then set up the new contractor account and applied WMS Level 1 access with the requested login.
INC_312.resolution_notes: WMS Level 1 access was granted on the caller's new contractor account, matching their prior seasonal permissions, and a temporary password was emailed to them.

INC_313.short_description: Level 3 WMS access needed on primary Westfield account, not temp login
INC_313.description: I need Level 3 access granted on my official Westfield account, not my old temporary one — I already have this level of access there, but I now do all my WMS and network share work through my main login. I've attached my new device key since it's different from what's on file for the old account. Can my supervisor vouch for me here?
INC_313.worknotes: Agent verified the supervisor's vouch in the ticket thread and confirmed the attached device key matched the caller's identity before making the account change. The access team granted Level 3 permissions (device key, WMS role, and network share access) to the caller's primary Westfield account and noted the change could take up to an hour to propagate, asking the caller to log out and back into the SSO portal.

INC_314.short_description: Reactivate Westfield VPN Client access after long inactivity
INC_314.description: I think I was inactive for too long, maybe a couple of years, and now the system says my account is there but my VPN access is deactivated. Could someone restore my Westfield VPN Client access, or let me know if I need to do anything else?
INC_314.worknotes: Agent checked the account, confirmed it was disabled due to prolonged inactivity, and re-enabled Westfield VPN Client access. VPN Client access was restored; caller was asked to log out of all active sessions and log back in to test the connection.

INC_315.short_description: Grant blocker-flag role in WMS for frequent carrier contact
INC_315.description: Can we get the blocker-flag role turned on in WMS for one of our regular carrier contacts? They're a partner dispatcher we lean on a lot for feedback — they log shipment exception reports in WMS and we usually ask them to mark blockers themselves instead of routing everything through our team.
INC_315.worknotes: The access team located the contact's account in the WMS directory and confirmed they were already a known, trusted reporter before applying the role.
INC_315.resolution_notes: The blocker-flagging role was enabled on the contact's WMS account, so they can now mark their own exception reports as blockers.
INC_315.close_notes: All set — the role is live in WMS, and thanks to your contact for staying on top of the reports.

INC_316.short_description: Request for WMS publisher role in staging and production
INC_316.description: I'd like to be added to the WMS publisher role for both the staging and production environments so I can publish and review load-routing content updates. Thanks!
INC_316.worknotes: The access team confirmed the request with the caller's manager and added the account to the WMS publisher role in both the staging and production environments.
INC_316.resolution_notes: Account was granted WMS publisher access in staging and production, allowing the caller to publish and review routing content.
INC_316.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that publishing access now works in both environments.

INC_317.short_description: Slack access for WMS integration project contractor
INC_317.description: Hello, our contractor on the WMS integration project needs to get onto Slack to coordinate with the Westfield team, since a lot of that work touches our internal systems. Could we get him some kind of account set up for that? He doesn't need access to network shares, the WMS application, or any other systems, just Slack. Not sure what else you need from us, thanks!
INC_317.worknotes: Routed the request to the Identity & Access Management team since no WMS or network share access was needed, then followed up to confirm whether a full SSO portal account was required just to enable Slack, or whether it could be handled through the contractor NDA process instead. The access team indicated Slack access could potentially be granted without a full SSO portal account via the contractor NDA process, but final confirmation from that team was still pending when the thread closed.

INC_318.short_description: SSO portal credentials needed for former employee contributing to WMS scripts
INC_318.description: A former employee who still contributes to our WMS integration scripts has lost access to the SSO portal and can't update his SSH key or push changes to the test environment. His old account no longer exists, so I'm vouching for him if we can get a new one set up with the same access he had before.
INC_318.worknotes: Agent confirmed with the caller that a new account should be created with the same access level as the former employee's original account, since that account no longer exists. The access team provisioned a new SSO portal account, restored the SSH key, and matched network share and test-environment access to his prior level; credentials were emailed to him directly.

INC_319.short_description: WMS application access disabled due to account inactivity
INC_319.description: I tried to log into the Warehouse Management System this morning and got a message that my account was found but WMS access is currently disabled. It said this usually happens after a few months without logging in and that someone needs to restore it. Can you get my WMS access turned back on?
INC_319.worknotes: Agent located the account and looped in the access team to review and re-enable the WMS role that had been disabled for inactivity. The access team restored the caller's WMS role, re-enabling their Warehouse Management System access.

INC_320.short_description: Add admin account to IT Service Desk Admins group
INC_320.description: Hi - can you please add my admin account to the IT Service Desk Admins group in the SSO Portal? It should be under the production admins section. Thanks!
INC_320.worknotes: Agent located the account and added it to the requested admin group via the SSO Portal's Account Provisioning tool. Account was added to the IT Service Desk Admins group; changes typically propagate within about an hour.

INC_321.short_description: Create two named login accounts for third-party reporting/dock tools
INC_321.description: We need two individual login accounts created for our reporting dashboard tool and the dock scheduling console, since neither third-party app can authenticate properly with a shared service account. Suggested names are 'reporting' and 'dockconsole', but we're not attached to the exact names.
INC_321.worknotes: Agent provisioned both accounts through the SSO portal; the caller confirmed they could log in and complete MFA enrollment on each account, leaving only backend data access outstanding. The access team granted both accounts read access to the WMS data feeds the tools needed to pull reports.

INC_322.short_description: WMS Level 1 configuration access request for integration developer
INC_322.description: I need Level 1 write access to the WMS configuration repository so I can push routing script updates, and I've attached my SSH public key for the account. I've read and agree to the WMS Level 1 access requirements.
INC_322.worknotes: The caller's manager vouched for the request, so the access team created the account with the WMS Level 1 role, added the caller's SSH key, noted the key can take up to an hour to propagate, and emailed the account details.
INC_322.resolution_notes: The caller hit a 'Permission denied (publickey)' error because their SSH config used only the account name as the username; the access team explained the username must be the caller's full corporate email address, had them test the connection directly, and it worked once they restarted their terminal with the corrected config.

INC_323.short_description: WMS Level 1 access request for inventory adjustment rights
INC_323.description: I've attached my public key for the WMS integration tool. I've read and agree to abide by the WMS System Access Requirements, and I'm requesting Level 1 access so I can commit inventory adjustments directly in the system. My supervisor already vouches for this request.
INC_323.worknotes: Agent confirmed the supervisor's vouch on file and granted Level 1 WMS access, applying the write/commit and public-key permissions to the caller's account.
INC_323.resolution_notes: Level 1 WMS access was granted; caller was told to allow up to an hour for the change to propagate, then log out and back into the SSO portal (otp.westfieldlogistics.com) to pick it up.
INC_323.close_notes: Caller confirmed access was working and the ticket was closed.

INC_324.short_description: Add prod callback URL to intranet portal's SSO client before DNS cutover
INC_324.description: Hi, could we get https://intranet-prod.westfieldlogistics.com/auth/sso/callback added to the allowed callback URLs for the intranet portal's SSO client? This points to the new production instance on the IT-hosted infrastructure ahead of the DNS cutover, and it would help to be able to log in there before we make the switch.
INC_324.worknotes: The access team located the SSO client configuration for the intranet portal and added the requested callback URL to the allow list.
INC_324.resolution_notes: The new callback URL was added to the SSO portal client configuration, allowing login on the new production instance ahead of the DNS switch.

INC_325.short_description: VPN Client access disabled due to inactivity, requesting reactivation
INC_325.description: I tried to connect through the Westfield VPN Client and got a message saying my account was found but VPN access is currently disabled. It said this usually happens after a few months without logging in, and that I need to connect periodically to keep the account active. Could someone restore my access?
INC_325.worknotes: Looped in the access team to review the account; confirmed the caller's identity and that the account had been auto-disabled by the inactivity policy rather than any security flag. Access team re-enabled VPN Client access on the caller's account after verifying their identity.

INC_326.short_description: Add custom field to WMS issue reports for related operational area
INC_326.description: Our analytics team would like a new field added when filing issues against the WMS Application, to capture which non-analytics operational area the issue relates to (options like Dispatch, Warehouse Floor, Fleet, Safety, Customer Service, and others). This would be tied to our team's request queue and possibly required when submitting a new issue.
INC_326.worknotes: Agent confirmed with the WMS admin team that there was no objection to adding the field, then asked the caller to supply the exact list of values, whether the field should be restricted to their queue, the display name to show on the issue form, and whether it should be mandatory when filing a new issue. Implementation is on hold because the caller has not yet supplied the finalized list of values for the field, so it has not been created.

INC_327.short_description: Transfer VPN Client and WMS access to new corporate account
INC_327.description: I've attached my public key for the Westfield VPN Client. This is a follow-up to my previous requests to get my Warehouse Management System access set up - one for basic (Level 1) access and one for full (Level 3) access. Can you transfer all of that over to my new corporate account? I'm no longer using my old personal email for work.
INC_327.worknotes: Agent routed the request to the access team queue and followed up with the caller to confirm exactly which permissions and account needed the transfer.
INC_327.resolution_notes: The access team enabled WMS access with Level 3 permissions on the caller's new corporate account and let them know they can manage their VPN Client keys going forward through the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com.
INC_327.close_notes: Agent asked the caller to confirm their access was working correctly on the new account.

INC_328.short_description: Data team requests credentials for employee directory API access
INC_328.description: Our data team would like access to specific fields in the employee directory feed - employee ID, work email, active status, worker type, team, and staff flag - so we can keep an up-to-date record of every employee's status in our reporting database. We're classifying this data by sensitivity level, and it will determine what access level a user gets in our internal reporting database. We already have a similar data-sharing setup in place for the HR staff roster we pull from HR.
INC_328.worknotes: Agent generated service account credentials for the employee directory feed and arranged a secure, non-email channel to send them to the requester.
INC_328.resolution_notes: Credentials were issued and delivered securely to the data team; the requester confirmed the account was working.

INC_329.short_description: Level 3 WMS access request – Dallas distribution centre
INC_329.description: Requesting Level 3 access to the Warehouse Management System for the Dallas distribution centre. I've attached my Westfield VPN Client public key as instructed. I have read and agree to abide by the WMS Level 3 Access Requirements.
INC_329.worknotes: A colleague and a testing peer both vouched for the caller in the ticket thread, after which the request was handed to the access team to provision the elevated account. The access team granted Level 3 WMS access, adding the VPN client key, updating the SSO portal account and network share group, and confirming the WMS application role; the caller was told the change could take up to an hour to propagate and to log out and back into the SSO portal.

INC_330.short_description: Grant WMS exception-handler access to warehouse associate who has been filing reports
INC_330.description: I've been logging discrepancy reports in the WMS for a while now, filing them under the right module and flagging issues as I find them. I'd like to start resolving these myself, so could I get the exception-handler role to log reports in the correct category, take ownership of open ones, and edit them directly?
INC_330.worknotes: Access team checked with the caller's manager, who confirmed the request and that the caller had been actively using the WMS to log exception reports.
INC_330.resolution_notes: The exception-handler role was added to the caller's WMS account.

INC_331.short_description: Restore network share access disabled due to inactivity
INC_331.description: I used to log into the shared drive regularly for work, but I haven't accessed it in a while and now it's been switched off. Can someone restore my access to it?
INC_331.worknotes: Agent looped in the access team to check the account status, who confirmed it had been deactivated under the inactivity policy.
INC_331.resolution_notes: The access team re-enabled the caller's network share access and verified permissions were restored.
INC_331.close_notes: Agent confirmed with the caller that they were able to reach the share again.

INC_332.short_description: Request for Level 3 WMS editor access to push routing config changes
INC_332.description: Hi, I'd like Level 3 editor access to the WMS so I can use the staging environment and push routing configuration changes to production. Two of my colleagues are willing to vouch for me. I've read and agree to abide by the WMS Change Access Requirements.
INC_332.worknotes: Two colleagues vouched for the caller in the ticket thread, and the access team reviewed and approved the Level 3 WMS editor role request.
INC_332.resolution_notes: Level 3 WMS editor access was granted (staging write plus production push permissions); the caller was told the change could take up to an hour to propagate and to log out and back into the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com afterward.
INC_332.close_notes: Caller confirmed the new access was working and the ticket was closed.

INC_333.short_description: Request to rename Slack username to preferred nickname
INC_333.description: When I created my account I didn't realize there was a separate display name field, so I ended up using my full legal name as my Slack username. It's hard for people to find me and connect with me because of that, so I'd love to get renamed to my nickname, "Duke94". Thanks in advance!
INC_333.worknotes: Agent confirmed the SSO portal profile has no separate nickname field, but explained the display name can be updated to show the nickname in brackets next to the real name as a workaround.
INC_333.resolution_notes: The agent manually updated the caller's display name in the SSO portal to include the nickname, and after the caller also asked about their WMS login showing the same issue, a colleague on the access team updated that username to match.

INC_334.short_description: Level 1 WMS Application access request – Dallas distribution centre dispatcher
INC_334.description: I need Level 1 access to the WMS Application for the Dallas distribution centre so I can enter and update shipment records. I've read and agree to the WMS access requirements, and my supervisor is willing to vouch for this request.
INC_334.worknotes: Agent asked the caller's supervisor to confirm sponsorship directly in the ticket; once the supervisor vouched, the access team provisioned Level 1 WMS access and asked the caller to test login via the SSO portal. Caller confirmed the WMS Application login worked but reported an error connecting through the Westfield VPN Client during a nightly route sync, with a screenshot showing their username duplicated in the server address, and mentioned they had recently edited their VPN client profile.
INC_334.resolution_notes: Level 1 WMS Application access was provisioned and confirmed working for login; the VPN Client sync error appeared to be caused by a stale duplicate entry in the caller's VPN profile, which was flagged for the access team to review separately.
INC_334.close_notes: Caller confirmed WMS access was working and agreed to open a follow-up ticket if the VPN sync error continued.

INC_335.short_description: Grant WMS edit permissions for associate submitting inventory corrections
INC_335.description: One of our warehouse associates has submitted a few inventory correction requests in the WMS and I think they'd benefit from having edit permissions so they can make those changes themselves. Examples: correction requests 1341018 and 1586068. Thanks in advance!
INC_335.worknotes: Agent reviewed the request and updated the associate's WMS account role to include edit permissions on correction requests.
INC_335.resolution_notes: The associate's WMS role was updated to grant edit permissions for inventory correction requests.

INC_336.description: I need Level 1 write access to the WMS so I can submit inventory adjustments directly instead of routing them through my supervisor every time. I've attached my SSH public key for the secure WMS connection. Let me know if you need anything else from me to get this set up.
INC_336.worknotes: Agent asked the caller to review and accept the WMS data-entry access policy, and asked that a supervisor or colleague vouch for them directly in the ticket before the request could be processed.
INC_336.resolution_notes: The caller confirmed they had read and agreed to the WMS access policy, their supervisor vouched for them in the ticket, and the request was handed off to the access team to provision the Level 1 WMS account.
INC_336.close_notes: Closed after confirming with the caller that their Level 1 WMS account was active and working as expected.

INC_337.short_description: Re-activate WMS access disabled after account inactivity
INC_337.description: I haven't logged into the WMS in a while, and now I can't push inventory updates from my terminal. When I tried, I got a message saying my account was found but Warehouse Management System access has been disabled on it. Can you please reactivate it?
INC_337.worknotes: Agent checked the account and confirmed WMS access had been auto-disabled under the inactivity policy, which requires periodic sign-in to stay active. Agent re-enabled the WMS access flag on the caller's account and asked them to retry.

INC_338.short_description: Request for elevated WMS editor role
INC_338.description: I'd like to request editor access in the WMS so I can update shipment records directly instead of routing every correction through a supervisor. I can provide the ticket numbers of two exception reports I've already submitted fixes for, if that's what's needed to confirm I'm an active contributor.
INC_338.worknotes: The access team asked the caller to supply two example WMS exception tickets showing prior corrections before approving the elevated role. The caller provided two qualifying exception ticket numbers, and the access team granted WMS editor permissions.

INC_339.short_description: Request for Level 3 access in the Warehouse Management System
INC_339.description: Could you grant me Level 3 access to the Warehouse Management System, please? I've read and agree to abide by the WMS elevated access requirements. I was granted Level 1 access previously through a separate request.
INC_339.worknotes: Agent confirmed the caller already holds WMS Level 1 access, then reached out to two colleagues with existing Level 3 access to vouch for the request per policy; both confirmed their support.
INC_339.resolution_notes: With both peer vouches received and verified, the access team granted the caller Level 3 access in the Warehouse Management System.
INC_339.close_notes: Agent confirmed with the caller that Level 3 WMS access is now active and asked them to verify the new permissions work as expected.

INC_340.short_description: Restore WMS login access disabled due to inactivity
INC_340.description: My WMS login stopped working today — I think it's because I hadn't logged in for a while. Can you get my access turned back on?
INC_340.worknotes: Agent contacted the caller's manager to confirm the account should be reactivated for the caller. The access team confirmed with the caller's manager and reactivated the caller's WMS account.

INC_341.short_description: Admin service account needed for WMS Staging carrier integration
INC_341.description: We need an admin-level account for the WMS Staging environment so it can authenticate through the SSO portal and connect out to an external carrier tracking integration. I need to be able to create apps and view integrations from the WMS admin settings, which means the account needs admin rights, and it needs access to both WMS Staging and the carrier portal. Not sure if this should be a _user or _admin style login, and whether WMS Staging at the Dallas datacenter has different plugin restrictions than the cloud-hosted production WMS.
INC_341.worknotes: The access team lead confirmed the plan was to create a service account and add it to the WMS integration access group for application access, noting that group doesn't currently control admin-level rights inside WMS itself and that would need a separate follow-up. The ticket sat for a while because the assigned agent was out on leave before picking it back up. The access team created the WMS Staging service account and had the caller reset the password and enrol it for MFA at otp.westfieldlogistics.com, registering it as a 'Tablet' device rather than 'Phone' to avoid conflicting with their primary account's push token, then adding it as a second token in the same authenticator app.

INC_342.short_description: VPN Client access (Level 1) request for returning Dallas DC contractor
INC_342.description: I've read and agree to the Westfield VPN Client access requirements and need Level 1 remote access set up again. I previously had this access when I was a warehouse intern at the Dallas distribution centre, but that was tied to an account tied to my old intern email, which I no longer have access to.
INC_342.worknotes: The caller's manager vouched for the request and it was routed to the access team to provision the account; the agent asked the caller whether to update their existing VPN Client account or set up a new one. The caller confirmed they no longer had access to the old intern account or its key file (wiped during laptop reissue), so the access team set up a new VPN Client account instead of editing the old one.

INC_343.short_description: Set up SSO login for new dispatch scheduling application
INC_343.description: Later this week I'll be standing up the new dispatch scheduling application and need it provisioned with SSO login through the company SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com. The service will run at dispatch.westfieldlogistics.com, this is a production instance, and I'm the service owner for it. This is part of a planned migration off our current scheduling tool, which already uses SSO, so I'd expect a similar user base.
INC_343.worknotes: The caller followed up when the missing integration became a blocker for their go-live and asked to expedite; the access team then created the SSO integration, confirmed the production callback URL, and emailed the login credentials to the caller using encrypted delivery. SSO integration was created for the new application and credentials were issued to the caller; the access-control configuration was submitted for peer review before being deployed live.

INC_344.short_description: New vendor contractor needs SSO access to WMS for data segmentation
INC_344.description: We just brought on a new vendor to help out since our dispatch team doesn't have the bandwidth. We need one of the vendor's employees to get SSO access so they can help us segment our shipment data by region. Can we get an SSO account set up for them?
INC_344.worknotes: Ticket had been sitting open in triage; agent followed up with the caller to confirm whether the access request was still needed. Caller confirmed the vendor access was no longer required, so no account was provisioned and the request was closed.

INC_345.short_description: Re-enable VPN Client access that lapsed from inactivity
INC_345.description: My Westfield VPN Client access got disabled after going dormant while I was out on a long assignment - I let it lapse without meaning to. The remote access policy's dormant account section says it should be a quick fix to get reinstated. I've attached my public key, same one as before, and my work email on file hasn't changed. I've also had to do this once before, for reference. I've read and agree to abide by the remote access requirements again.
INC_345.worknotes: Agent checked the account history and confirmed the caller previously held approved VPN Client access with no policy violations, so no new request form or re-approval was needed. Agent re-enabled the caller's Westfield VPN Client access using the public key on file and verified the account was active.

INC_346.short_description: WMS test-environment access needed to verify a fix
INC_346.description: I'm working on a fix for the pick-list export issue in the WMS and need test-environment access so I can check whether my change broke anything before it goes live. My supervisor on the warehouse ops team said they'd vouch for me for this level of access.
INC_346.worknotes: Agent confirmed with the caller's supervisor that they vouched for the request, then forwarded it to the access team to provision the WMS test-environment role.
INC_346.resolution_notes: The access team created the account with WMS test-environment access and sent the caller their credentials, noting it could take up to an hour for the change to sync across warehouse terminals.
INC_346.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that the access came through and they were able to test their change.

INC_347.short_description: Add new WMS dispatch analyst to dispatch-ops access group
INC_347.description: Please add my account to the dispatch-ops access group. I'm the new systems analyst on the dispatch team and need access to the Warehouse Management System.
INC_347.worknotes: Confirmed the request would grant the caller the required WMS dashboard access through the SSO portal, then added the caller's account to the dispatch-ops group.
INC_347.resolution_notes: The caller's account was added to the dispatch-ops access group, granting the needed WMS Application access.

INC_348.short_description: Create CNAME for WMS reporting hostname
INC_348.description: Please create a DNS entry so wms-reports.westfieldlogistics.com points to wms-backend-prod.internal.westfieldlogistics.com. This is needed to launch the updated warehouse ops reporting dashboard. Thanks!
INC_348.worknotes: Agent created the CNAME record for wms-reports.westfieldlogistics.com in the internal DNS zone, then added a matching record in the public-facing zone as requested. Both CNAME records were created successfully and confirmed to resolve to the backend reporting host.

INC_349.short_description: Add two accounts to WMS direct-update role
INC_349.description: Please add me and the inventory-sync service account to the WMS direct-update role so we can push changes straight to the live warehouse database instead of waiting on the nightly batch job. The service account will still have restricted access to the system as defined in an existing configuration.
INC_349.worknotes: The access team confirmed the direct-update role, created under a prior request, was the correct one and added both accounts to it.
INC_349.resolution_notes: Both the caller's account and the inventory-sync service account were added to the WMS direct-update role, giving them direct push access to the live system.

INC_350.short_description: Request for WMS Level 1 data-entry access
INC_350.description: I need Level 1 data-entry access on the Warehouse Management System for the Dallas distribution centre. I've read and agree to follow the WMS access requirements, and my supervisor has already signed off on this.
INC_350.worknotes: A colleague vouched for the caller, and the request was routed to the access team for provisioning.
INC_350.resolution_notes: The access team granted WMS Level 1 access on the caller's account; the requested account alias couldn't be used since WMS permissions must be tied to the caller's primary corporate account, not an alias. Changes could take up to an hour to propagate, and the caller might need to log out and back into the SSO portal.

INC_351.short_description: Set up SSO application and API for internal route annotation tool
INC_351.description: I need an SSO application and matching API registered for our new route annotation tool, which is reachable from a few different hosts including our staging environment and a local dev server. The application needs specific callback, logout, and CORS URLs, a 20-minute token lifetime, and needs to support three tiers of users - public, portal customers, and employees. Can you also get the API resource set up so the app can authenticate against it?
INC_351.worknotes: The access team configured the application and its matching API resource with the requested callback/logout URLs, CORS origins, and 20-minute token expiration, but noted the device-code grant type isn't currently supported and that the API required a unique identifier value, offering a few naming suggestions. The caller later uploaded a new encryption key through the intranet self-service page so credentials could be sent securely.
INC_351.resolution_notes: The caller picked an identifier for the API, the access team finished the SSO application and API configuration, and the client ID and secret were sent to the caller via encrypted email using their uploaded key.

INC_352.short_description: Level 3 VPN Client access granted but login still failing after logout
INC_352.description: I currently have Level 1 access on the Westfield VPN Client and need Level 3 access for my role. I've attached my public key and confirm I agree to the VPN access policy.
INC_352.worknotes: Two colleagues vouched for the caller's request before the access team enabled Level 3 access on the VPN gateway using the attached public key, then asked the caller to log out of all sessions and log back in to test connectivity. The caller confirmed that logging out of Slack, Zoom, and the intranet did not restore VPN connectivity. They also asked whether the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com was rejecting their alias email because it wasn't linked to their SSO account, so the access team escalated to confirm the correct login alias.

INC_353.short_description: Add two accounts to restricted WMS inventory-sync role group
INC_353.description: Please add my account and the automation sync account to the WMS role group that has restricted access to the distribution centre inventory tree. The automation account should only get the limited access described in the integration setup notes for the warehouse sync job.
INC_353.worknotes: Agent verified both accounts and added them to the requested WMS restricted-access role group. Both accounts were added to the role group, giving them the restricted access needed for the inventory sync integration.

INC_354.short_description: Add two staff to Route Optimization network share access group
INC_354.description: Hi, can you please add myself and a colleague on our Route Optimization project team, the program lead and the program manager, to the routeopt-dev network share group? We both need access to the shared project files. Thank you!
INC_354.worknotes: Agent verified the request with the caller and added both accounts to the routeopt-dev network share group.
INC_354.resolution_notes: Both accounts were added to the network share group, restoring access to the shared project folder.

INC_355.short_description: Enable SSO for employee engagement survey platform
INC_355.description: I'd like to request that we set up Single Sign-On for our employee engagement survey platform through the Westfield SSO Portal. We use it for our engagement surveys and are planning to expand it to other HR processes that need to be easy to access for staff across all our sites. Let me know if you need a vendor contact or anything else from me to help move this along.
INC_355.worknotes: Agent confirmed SSO could be set up and asked for someone with admin rights on the survey platform account, then shared the SSO Portal IDP metadata (https://otp.westfieldlogistics.com/samlp/metadata/ax7RGaXPRd5pe60fnEllluSN76MefFX1E) and offered a call to configure and test it together; a later check-in asked the caller whether this was still needed since the ticket had gone quiet.
INC_355.resolution_notes: The SSO integration had already been completed as part of a separate access-provisioning change, so no further configuration was required.

INC_356.short_description: Merge two SSO Portal accounts, keep legacy account as the surviving primary
INC_356.description: My Westfield Logistics account keeps getting disabled because mail to it keeps bouncing, so I'd like to switch it over to a different address. There's an older SSO Portal account tied to a personal email I've used for the last 12 years, with all my saved WMS searches, options, and two-factor setup on it, so I'd rather keep that one active and just change its email instead of losing everything by starting over. Can you merge the activity from my current account into that older one and then swap the email address across?
INC_356.worknotes: Agent temporarily re-enabled the caller's older, disabled SSO Portal account so the caller could confirm details directly, then clarified with the caller which of the two accounts should end up as the surviving primary before making any changes. Access team agreed to merge the newer account's mail activity into the legacy SSO Portal account, retire the duplicate, and reassign the caller's current Westfield Logistics email address to the surviving account.

INC_357.short_description: Enable SSO for DocuSign through the SSO Portal
INC_357.description: Please help enable SSO for DocuSign through the Westfield SSO Portal. We use DocuSign for signing carrier agreements and dispatch paperwork and would like staff to be able to log in with their Westfield credentials. Thanks.
INC_357.worknotes: The access team checked the SSO Portal configuration and found DocuSign used to be set up under the company's previous identity provider but was never migrated over when Westfield moved to the current SSO Portal backend, so a call was scheduled with the caller to reconfigure it. The access team rebuilt the DocuSign integration in the SSO Portal configuration and deployed the change.

INC_358.short_description: Level 3 WMS Access Request for Warehouse Data Automation Project
INC_358.description: Requesting Level 3 access to the Warehouse Management System. I have read and agree to abide by the elevated access requirements. CCing my manager and a teammate from the Warehouse Data Automation project to vouch for me.
INC_358.worknotes: Agent noted the caller still needed to attach their SSH public key for the WMS SFTP feed before Level 3 access could be granted; two vouches were logged, one from the caller's manager and one from a project teammate.
INC_358.resolution_notes: Once the SSH key was attached and both vouches were confirmed, the access team provisioned the Level 3 WMS account.

INC_359.short_description: Add caller to Dispatch Reports network share
INC_359.description: Hi, could you please add me to the Dispatch Reports network share? My supervisor is authorizing this request. Thanks.
INC_359.worknotes: Confirmed the authorization with the caller's supervisor and added the caller's account to the Dispatch Reports network share access group. Caller was added to the Dispatch Reports network share group.

INC_360.short_description: Remove DockNotes SSO integration from production
INC_360.description: Please remove the DockNotes relying party registration, client ID 8pQz3RmTxLh92VnKdWsYcBaFgNjEuPqR, from the SSO Portal production environment. I've also filed a change request to remove the entry from the SSO application registry config file.
INC_360.worknotes: Agent verified the DockNotes client registration was still active in the SSO Portal admin console and located the linked change request for the application registry update.
INC_360.resolution_notes: Agent removed the DockNotes relying party registration from the SSO Portal production environment.
INC_360.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that the DockNotes integration no longer appears in the SSO Portal.

INC_361.short_description: Password reset needed - encrypted reset email inaccessible on loaner laptop
INC_361.description: I need my Outlook email password reset because I'm working from a different laptop today. I can't use the self-service 'Forgot password' link since the reset email arrives encrypted - I set up PGP encryption on my mailbox a while back and my private key is only on my usual laptop.
INC_361.worknotes: Since the caller could not receive or decrypt the automated reset email, an agent contacted the caller directly to verify their identity before proceeding.
INC_361.resolution_notes: After confirming the caller's identity out-of-band, an agent manually reset the Outlook/Exchange mailbox password.

INC_362.short_description: Add new lead engineer to WMS integration access group
INC_362.description: Hi there, can you add my account to the wms-integration access group in the Warehouse Management System? I'm the new lead engineer on the WMS upgrade project. Thanks!
INC_362.worknotes: Agent verified the caller's new project role and added their account to the wms-integration group.
INC_362.resolution_notes: Account was added to the wms-integration access group, granting the WMS roles needed for the project.
INC_362.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that the WMS access is now working.

INC_363.short_description: Level 1 WMS SFTP Access Request for Dallas DC Analyst
INC_363.description: I've read and agree to the WMS remote access requirements posted on the intranet, and I'm attaching my SSH public key for the SFTP account. Can I get Level 1 access set up so I can start pulling inventory files?
INC_363.worknotes: The caller's supervisor vouched for them in the ticket, thanking them for their work, and an agent looped in the WMS access approvers to authorize Level 1 provisioning.
INC_363.resolution_notes: The access team created the caller's WMS account using the submitted public key and added the sftp-transfer and wms-level1 role groups.
INC_363.close_notes: Agent confirmed the account was provisioned and told the caller that full setup instructions would follow by email.

INC_364.short_description: Request for WMS edit role after months of submitting inventory corrections
INC_364.description: I've been submitting inventory correction requests to the warehouse team for a while now, and it would really help if I could just edit the records directly instead of routing everything through someone else. Could I get edit access in WMS?
INC_364.worknotes: Access team reviewed the request and confirmed the caller had a history of submitting valid correction requests. The caller's WMS account was updated with the editor role, giving them direct edit rights on inventory records.

INC_365.short_description: WMS Level 3 override access not linked to new SSO account
INC_365.description: My old warehouse floor account has WMS Level 3 override access, but the SSO account I now use for Citrix VDI doesn't have it. The intranet page said I'd need to file a ticket to reset the password on my old account, but I think there's a different way to just connect the two accounts. Also, the intranet page still points to a ticket category for this that doesn't exist anymore.
INC_365.worknotes: Rerouted to the access team since the caller already holds the override access and this is an account-linking request rather than a new grant; the team confirmed the old account carries WMS Level 3 override access along with a Westfield VPN Client certificate tied to it. The access team matched the WMS Level 3 override level and VPN client certificate from the old account onto the caller's SSO account, then asked the caller to log out of the SSO portal and back in for the change to take effect.

INC_366.short_description: Remove "Legacy Citrix VDI" option from SSO portal landing page
INC_366.description: Can someone remove the "Legacy Citrix VDI" option from the otp.westfieldlogistics.com page? That page is public and doesn't require a login to view.
INC_366.worknotes: Agent confirmed the page is public-facing and routed the change to the team managing the SSO portal front end for removal of the legacy option.
INC_366.resolution_notes: The "Legacy Citrix VDI" option was removed from the SSO portal landing page and the change was deployed.

INC_367.short_description: Add three warehouse systems staff to WMS direct-push and auto-release role groups
INC_367.description: Please add our three systems engineers to the WMS-Direct-Push and WMS-AutoRelease groups. Two of them need to be able to push new routing configuration updates directly to the WMS and need to keep that direct access once we change the network share permissions in a few weeks. Please add them to the WMS-Direct-Push group.
INC_367.worknotes: Agent verified the three accounts with the access team and added them to the WMS-Direct-Push group as requested. All three accounts were also added to the WMS-AutoRelease group after the caller flagged it was needed too, restoring their full direct configuration access ahead of the upcoming permissions change.

INC_368.short_description: Level 1 access request for WMS scripts network share (SSH key)
INC_368.description: I need Level 1 access to the WMS configuration scripts share. I've read and agree to abide by the access requirements, and I've attached my SSH public key for the account.
INC_368.worknotes: A colleague vouched for the caller; the access team added them to the level-1 access group and installed the submitted SSH public key, noting it can take up to an hour to sync to the servers, and pointed the caller to the intranet page with SSH config setup details.
INC_368.resolution_notes: The SSH key synced to the servers and level-1 access was granted; the caller confirmed they could connect via SSH.
INC_368.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that the connection works and access is in place; ticket closed.

INC_369.short_description: Remove DNS entry for deprecated WMS reporting hostname
INC_369.description: We're retiring the old WMS reporting tool and no longer need its internal address active. Can the network team remove the DNS entry for wms-analytics.westfieldlogistics.com right away, since the service is being shut down immediately.
INC_369.worknotes: Agent confirmed the hostname was tied to a decommissioned WMS reporting service with no remaining dependents and submitted the removal to the network team.
INC_369.resolution_notes: The internal DNS (CNAME) record for the deprecated hostname was deleted.

INC_370.short_description: Delete duplicate mailbox created with misspelled name
INC_370.description: The caller says their Outlook/Exchange mailbox was set up with their name misspelled. They're asking the service desk to delete the incorrectly created account since they already have (or need) the correctly spelled one.
INC_370.worknotes: An agent confirmed which mailbox was the misspelled duplicate and checked it had no mail history that needed to be preserved before removal.
INC_370.resolution_notes: The agent deleted the misspelled duplicate mailbox from Exchange.

INC_371.short_description: Request for WMS Level 1 system access via SSH key
INC_371.description: I need Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System so my integration script can connect securely. I've attached my SSH public key, and I confirm I have read and agree to abide by the WMS Access Requirements.
INC_371.worknotes: The access team added the caller's SSH public key and granted the WMS Level 1 role group membership, noting that the change could take up to an hour to propagate and the caller might need to log out and back into the SSO portal.
INC_371.resolution_notes: Once the role change propagated, the caller's SSH session showed Level 1 WMS access instead of an access-denied response, confirming the grant had taken effect.

INC_372.short_description: Level 1 WMS access request for new hire — needs supervisor sign-off
INC_372.description: I need Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System for the Dallas distribution center. I've read and agree to abide by the WMS Access Requirements, and I've attached my public key for the secure upload connection. Please have my supervisor confirm in this ticket when they get a chance.
INC_372.worknotes: Access team held the request pending confirmation, and the caller's supervisor posted in the ticket vouching for them before the agent proceeded with provisioning. Level 1 WMS access was granted, including inventory read/write permissions and a registered key for secure upload connections; account and login instructions were emailed to the caller along with a link to the WMS connection setup guide on the intranet.

INC_373.short_description: Level 3 network share access requested for dispatcher
INC_373.description: I'm requesting Level 3 access to the Westfield network shares so I can read and write inventory files across all distribution center shares over SFTP. I've attached my SSH public key for authentication and confirm I've read and agree to the network share access requirements.
INC_373.worknotes: Confirmed the caller's manager vouched for the request and verified the attached SSH public key, then provisioned Level 1 network share access (read/write to their home branch share only) rather than the Level 3 requested. Level 1 SFTP access to the network share was provisioned using the submitted SSH public key, and the caller was told to log out and back into the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com for the change to take effect.

INC_374.short_description: Please restore my WMS access so I can run batch jobs
INC_374.description: Please restore my Warehouse Management System login so I can run some batch jobs. Thanks!
INC_374.worknotes: Looped in the access team, who re-enabled the caller's WMS account and confirmed the existing access key on file was still valid, noting the caller can self-manage it via the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com if needed. The access team re-enabled the caller's WMS account using the existing credential on file, so no new key was required.

INC_375.short_description: WMS Level 1 editor access request for Dallas distribution centre
INC_375.description: I need Level 1 editor access to the Warehouse Management System so I can update inventory records for the Dallas distribution centre. My supervisor has agreed to vouch for the request. I've already set up the access credentials on my workstation.
INC_375.worknotes: Confirmed the caller's supervisor vouched for the request and had the caller acknowledge the WMS acceptable use policy before proceeding with provisioning.
INC_375.resolution_notes: The access team enabled Level 1 editor access on the caller's WMS account.

INC_376.short_description: Update allowed callback URLs for intranet staging app on SSO Portal
INC_376.description: On the intranet staging application configured in the SSO Portal, can we add the new callback URL and remove the old one? This is needed because of infrastructure change request INFRA-503. Thanks!
INC_376.worknotes: Agent located the staging application entry in the SSO Portal admin console and reviewed the requested callback list change against INFRA-503.
INC_376.resolution_notes: Added https://intranet-stage.westfieldlogistics.com/auth/callback to the application's allowed callback list and removed the deprecated https://intranet-staging.westfieldlogistics.com/auth/callback entry.

INC_377.short_description: Credentials request for WMS alert triage bot to query employee profiles
INC_377.description: One of the core components of the WMS Alert Triage Bot is an alert action that will need to query employee profiles given a username. I'd like to request credentials and the scope information needed to pull this data from the SSO Portal directory service.
INC_377.worknotes: Agent confirmed the automation project with the caller and routed the request to the access team to provision a scoped service account for directory lookups.
INC_377.resolution_notes: The access team completed the request and confirmed the credentials had been provided; no further detail was logged beyond that confirmation.
INC_377.close_notes: Followed up with the caller, who confirmed the request had already been handled the prior week.

INC_378.short_description: WMS login blocked with permission error despite correct role assignment
INC_378.description: I'm assigned to the WMS Supervisor role but when I try to log into the Warehouse Management System I get an error saying I don't have permission. This is one of the worst blockers I could have for my daily work right now, so I'd really appreciate help today.
INC_378.worknotes: Agent checked the caller's account in the Warehouse Management System and the SSO Portal and found everything configured correctly, pointing to a session or token issue on the SSO side; caller was asked to re-check specific SSO Portal login steps documented on the intranet before escalating further. Access started working again after the caller went through the SSO Portal login steps, though neither the caller nor the agent could identify exactly what change fixed it.

INC_379.short_description: Remove unused internal hostnames for retired WMS integration services
INC_379.description: Can someone remove these old wms.westfieldlogistics.com DNS records? They pointed to backend WMS integration services we retired a while back (staging scanner gateway, worker manager, secrets, notify, hooks, and others) and they shouldn't still be resolving. Full list: node-provisioner, label-mirror, events, edi-gateway, hooks, purge-cache, secrets, metrics, schemas, references, notify, downloads, scanner-gateway-staging, scanner-gateway, and worker-manager, all under wms.westfieldlogistics.com.
INC_379.worknotes: The network team checked that none of the listed wms.westfieldlogistics.com hostnames were still referenced by any active WMS or network configuration before proceeding. All fifteen listed DNS records were deleted as requested.

INC_380.short_description: SSO Portal account disabled due to bounced notification emails
INC_380.description: My SSO Portal account got disabled because emails to my address kept bouncing. I already verified my identity with the access team over Slack, so can you please restore the account now?
INC_380.worknotes: Verified the caller's identity against the details already confirmed in the Slack thread, then checked the SSO Portal admin console and found the account had been auto-disabled after repeated email delivery failures.
INC_380.resolution_notes: Reactivated the SSO Portal account; the access team is also looking into a longer-term fix for the underlying email delivery issue.
INC_380.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that they could log into the SSO Portal again.

INC_381.short_description: SSO Portal account disabled due to email delivery failures
INC_381.description: My SSO Portal account was disabled because of an issue delivering email to my address. I already completed identity verification through the service desk Slack channel, so can you please restore my account?
INC_381.worknotes: Agent confirmed the caller's identity verification had been completed via the service desk Slack channel and re-enabled the account on the SSO Portal.
INC_381.resolution_notes: The SSO Portal account was restored; the identity & access team is investigating a longer-term fix for the underlying email delivery issue.

INC_382.short_description: SSO Portal account disabled after undeliverable notification emails
INC_382.description: My SSO Portal login got disabled — I got a message saying the system couldn't deliver email to my account. I already went through identity verification with the access team over on the #it-servicedesk Slack channel. Can someone please restore my account?
INC_382.worknotes: Agent confirmed the caller's identity verification had been completed and logged via the #it-servicedesk Slack channel, then re-enabled the SSO Portal account. The SSO Portal account was restored after identity verification was confirmed; the access team is also looking into a longer-term fix for the undeliverable-email issue that triggers these auto-disables.

INC_383.short_description: WMS account disabled after email delivery failures to vendor address
INC_383.description: I got a message saying my Warehouse Management System account was disabled because of issues delivering email to my address. My identity has already been verified on a prior call, so can someone please restore the account? This seems to be happening to a lot of us on the staffing vendor team at the Dallas distribution centre today.
INC_383.worknotes: Agent checked the account and confirmed it was active on Westfield's end, noted the team was also working a longer-term fix, and asked the caller to confirm the exact email address on file since it wasn't showing as disabled in WMS. The caller confirmed the mail delivery issue on the staffing vendor's own email server cleared up and WMS access was working again.

INC_384.short_description: WMS account disabled due to "issues delivering emails" notification
INC_384.description: My WMS account got disabled and says it was disabled due to issues delivering emails to my address. My identity was already verified with the service desk, so can you please restore my account? This seems to be happening to a lot of the contract staff at the Dallas distribution centre today.
INC_384.worknotes: Agent verified the caller's identity and checked the WMS Application account logs, which showed the account was auto-disabled after repeated bounced notification emails, with the connection to the contractor's mail server timing out. The agent manually re-enabled the WMS account and flagged the issue to the operations team to investigate the mail delivery failure, since several other contractor accounts were disabled for the same reason that day.

INC_385.short_description: Locked out of SSO portal; caller also wants email on account updated
INC_385.description: I can't log into the SSO portal and need my account access restored. Now that I've moved from contractor to full-time staff, I also want the email address on my account changed from my old contractor address to my new Westfield Logistics address, if that's possible.
INC_385.worknotes: Verified the caller's identity with their manager, then re-enabled the caller's SSO portal account so they could log in again. SSO portal access was restored; the agent advised that changing the account's email address is handled separately and requires a distinct account provisioning request to the access team.

INC_386.short_description: SSO Portal account disabled due to email delivery failure
INC_386.description: My SSO Portal account was disabled because of an issue delivering emails to my address. My identity has already been verified with the service desk, so please restore my account. This seems to be happening to a lot of us at the Dallas distribution center today.
INC_386.worknotes: Checked the SSO Portal admin console and confirmed the account had been auto-disabled after repeated failed delivery attempts to the caller's Exchange mailbox; the internal mail relay was timing out on connection. Account was re-enabled in the SSO Portal once mail delivery to the caller's mailbox was confirmed to be working again.

INC_387.short_description: SSO Portal account auto-disabled due to failed email delivery
INC_387.description: My SSO Portal account got disabled and I received a notice saying it was because of a problem delivering email to my address. I've already verified my identity with the service desk, so can you please restore my account? It looks like a lot of us at Ridgeline Carriers are getting hit with this today.
INC_387.worknotes: Verified the caller's identity per policy, then checked the SSO Portal account status and found it had been auto-disabled after repeated failed delivery attempts, with the receiving mail server timing out on connection; confirmed several other Ridgeline Carriers accounts were hit by the same issue.
INC_387.resolution_notes: Re-enabled the caller's SSO Portal account; the underlying mail delivery problem was on the partner company's mail server and outside Westfield's systems to fix directly.
INC_387.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that they were able to log back into the SSO Portal.

INC_388.short_description: WMS Level 3 (inventory override) access request for warehouse associate
INC_388.description: I'm requesting an upgrade to Level 3 access in the Warehouse Management System so I can process inventory overrides. My account currently only has Level 1 access, which lets me scan and move inventory but not adjust counts. My shift supervisor has agreed to vouch for the request.
INC_388.worknotes: Agent confirmed the caller's account currently holds Level 1 WMS access and noted that a Level 3 upgrade requires sign-off from two supervisors before it can be applied.
INC_388.resolution_notes: One shift supervisor vouched for the caller, but a second supervisor's sign-off was still outstanding when the thread ended, so the Level 3 upgrade had not yet been applied.

INC_389.short_description: Add team member to WMS security, infrastructure, and dispatch role groups
INC_389.description: Please add a member of our team to the following WMS role groups: WMS-Security-Ops, WMS-Infra-Support, and WMS-Dispatch-Services. If you need someone to confirm they belong in these groups, please check with our manager.
INC_389.worknotes: The agent identified the owner of the requested WMS role groups and reassigned the ticket to them for action. The role group owner reviewed the request and added the caller's team member to all three WMS role groups.

INC_390.short_description: New hostname needed for WMS carrier portal launching Dec. 21
INC_390.description: Our team is launching a new Carrier Portal that connects to the Warehouse Management System, going live December 21st. It's being built by an outside development agency, and we'd like it reachable at carrierportal.westfieldlogistics.com once it launches. Please reach out to our project lead for additional details.
INC_390.worknotes: The network team confirmed they could set up the hostname and asked where to point it; the caller followed up over Slack that the site wasn't live yet but the URL would be ready by the end of the week, with the DNS change to follow the week of Dec. 21st. Once the agency migrated the site to its new hosting server, they provided the destination address for the record.
INC_390.resolution_notes: An A record was created for carrierportal.westfieldlogistics.com pointing to the agency's hosting server; the ticket was held open until the public site was confirmed to load correctly at the new hostname.

INC_391.short_description: Grant WMS edit access to warehouse associate for strong ticket work
INC_391.description: Can you please grant edit permissions in the WMS to my colleague? He's done great work resolving inventory tickets so far, including WMS-48211 and WMS-48339. I've cc'd him on this request.
INC_391.worknotes: Agent verified the colleague's WMS activity on the two referenced tickets and confirmed the request with the caller before submitting it to the access team.
INC_391.resolution_notes: The access team granted WMS edit rights to the colleague's account.

INC_392.short_description: New SSO Portal client ID for local dev of Warehouse Ops Wiki
INC_392.description: I'm doing local development on the Warehouse Ops Wiki and need a client ID set up in the SSO portal so I can test login on my machine. Expected user count is low since it's just developers testing, the callback will point to a local address, and it doesn't really matter who's allowed to log in as long as any Westfield account can authenticate for the test. Let me know if you need anything else from me.
INC_392.worknotes: Agent reviewed the local dev details provided and coordinated with the access team to register a new client entry in the SSO portal for localhost callback testing.
INC_392.resolution_notes: The access team created the requested SSO portal client ID scoped for local developer testing.
INC_392.close_notes: Caller confirmed the new client ID is working and the request is complete.

INC_393.short_description: Reopen intranet account for former contractor
INC_393.description: One of our regular delivery contractors kept contributing to the driver safety forum on intranet.westfieldlogistics.com even after his contract with the Dallas distribution centre ended. His account got closed automatically last Friday as part of standard contractor offboarding. Could someone reopen it so he can keep posting to the community boards? Thanks!
INC_393.worknotes: Agent confirmed the account had been disabled through routine contractor offboarding and checked with the caller that reinstating access for a former contractor was appropriate before proceeding. The access team re-enabled the account on intranet.westfieldlogistics.com.

INC_394.short_description: Request for Level 1 WMS override access using preferred username instead of email ID
INC_394.description: I'd like to request Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System so I can process inventory override adjustments. I've read and agree to the WMS access requirements. Also, can my account be set up under my preferred username instead of my full employee email address?
INC_394.worknotes: Agent confirmed the caller had acknowledged the WMS access requirements and asked the caller's supervisor to vouch for the request before escalating it to account provisioning. The caller's supervisor vouched for the request, and the access team created the Level 1 WMS account under the caller's preferred username.

INC_395.short_description: WMS Level 3 Access Request for Dispatch Operations
INC_395.description: I need Level 3 access in the Warehouse Management System to handle dispatch overrides for my team. I've read and agree to abide by the Elevated Access Requirements, and I've submitted my device access request as instructed. My Westfield account is already active under my employee login.
INC_395.worknotes: Agent confirmed the request needed two supervisor vouches under the Elevated Access policy before the WMS Level 3 role could be applied; two managers confirmed the caller's need for the access.
INC_395.resolution_notes: The access team applied the WMS Level 3 access group to the caller's account.

INC_396.short_description: Level 1 WMS edit access request pending peer vouch
INC_396.description: I'm requesting Level 1 edit access to the Warehouse Management System so I can push my own fixes to the automation scripts instead of routing every change through a supervisor. I tried to run a full test against a fix for an issue I'm tracking but couldn't push it without this access. I've attached my public key for the WMS test environment and confirm I've read and agree to the access requirements.
INC_396.worknotes: The access team confirmed the caller had accepted the WMS access requirements and was waiting on a colleague to vouch for them in the ticket for the underlying issue; a coworker who had been pairing with the caller on that issue was added to the request to help vouch. The ticket closed with the vouch still pending: the caller had asked a colleague to vouch for them and apologized for the delay, and a second coworker working the same issue was looped in to help, but no confirmation of the access being granted was recorded.

INC_397.short_description: WMS sandbox Level 1 access request for new logistics-analytics contributor
INC_397.description: I'm requesting Level 1 access to the WMS test/sandbox environment so I can submit and test route and inventory entries. My supervisor already said they'd vouch for me to get this set up.
INC_397.worknotes: Agent asked the caller to attach their Westfield VPN Client public key and confirm agreement to the WMS Level 1 access requirements, then looped in the access team to provision the account. Caller attached the VPN Client key and confirmed agreement to the access requirements; before finishing provisioning, the agent confirmed whether the caller's personal email or their company email on file should be used as the SSO Portal login.

INC_398.short_description: WMS staging environment access needed to verify a fix before go-live
INC_398.description: I've been asked to confirm a fix works in the WMS staging environment before it gets pushed to production. To do this I need Level 1 access to the staging system, and I've attached my public key for the account.
INC_398.worknotes: Confirmed the caller had acknowledged the staging access requirements and asked their supervisor to post a vouch on the ticket before provisioning could proceed.
INC_398.resolution_notes: The caller's supervisor vouched for the request in the ticket, and the access team provisioned the Level 1 staging account using the submitted public key.

INC_399.short_description: Outlook account disabled after email delivery failures, needs restoring
INC_399.description: My Outlook account got disabled because of some kind of issue with emails not delivering. My manager already confirmed who I am with the help desk, so can you please just turn my account back on.
INC_399.worknotes: Agent verified the caller's identity with their manager and confirmed in Exchange that the mailbox had been automatically disabled due to repeated delivery failures.
INC_399.resolution_notes: The account was re-enabled in Exchange and mail flow was restored.
INC_399.close_notes: Agent confirmed with the caller that they were able to send and receive email again.

INC_400.short_description: Move year-end driver recognition page to a new network share path
INC_400.description: We're running a year-end driver recognition campaign for warehouse staff and need the page moved off its temporary network share location onto a proper folder path. The caller and a colleague are both listed as points of contact for this request, and the page needs to stay live through the end of the year.
INC_400.worknotes: Agent acknowledged the request, then followed up several weeks later to check whether the share path change was still needed since it had not yet been actioned. The campaign had already wrapped up by the time of the follow-up, so no path change was made; the caller confirmed nothing further was needed.

INC_401.short_description: Level 3 WMS access request with SSH key for automated inventory sync
INC_401.description: I'm requesting Level 3 access to the Warehouse Management System so I can push updates to the inventory sync scripts. I've attached my SSH public key for the automated file transfer service, and I have read and agree to abide by the elevated WMS access requirements.
INC_401.worknotes: Two leads from the warehouse operations group vouched for the request before it was routed to the access team for provisioning. The access team provisioned Level 3 WMS access and added the caller's SSH key to the account, noting the key would take about an hour to propagate to all warehouse servers, and asked the caller to log out and back into the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com so the updated permissions would take effect.

INC_402.short_description: WMS access upgrade to Level 3 override permissions
INC_402.description: I need my Warehouse Management System access bumped up to Level 3. Right now I only have Level 1 access to the WMS. My shift supervisor and the dock lead can vouch for me if that's needed to approve the upgrade.
INC_402.worknotes: The caller's shift supervisor and the dock lead both vouched for the elevation in the ticket thread; the access team updated the caller's WMS role group to Level 3. WMS access was elevated to Level 3 override permissions; the caller was told to log out of the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com and log back in so the updated role would sync to their account.

INC_403.short_description: Request for WMS Level 1 Write Access
INC_403.description: I'd like to request Level 1 write access to the WMS automation scripts so I can start contributing routing updates. I've attached my public key as required and confirm I've read and agree to the WMS access requirements.
INC_403.worknotes: The caller's manager and a senior analyst vouched for the request in the ticket thread, so the access team added the WMS Level 1 role and loaded the caller's public key onto the account.
INC_403.resolution_notes: The access team granted WMS Level 1 write access and loaded the caller's key, noting propagation can take up to an hour, and pointed the caller to the WMS setup guide on intranet.westfieldlogistics.com.
INC_403.close_notes: Caller confirmed the WMS write access was working and the ticket was closed.

INC_404.short_description: Service account with SSO access needed to manage Zoom webhook integration
INC_404.description: Per our manager, we need a service account set up so multiple team members can manage a webhook app we built in Zoom for receiving event logs that feed our Warehouse Management System integration. We were told we'd need both a directory account and an SSO Portal (SAML) account since Zoom doesn't support local authentication, and we'd like this in place before December 4th if possible. Anytime we redeploy our integration the endpoint has to be manually updated in Zoom's developer console or the webhook fails — if there isn't already a naming convention for service accounts, wms-zoomconnector-admin works for us.
INC_404.worknotes: The ticket was found sitting untouched in the triage queue; once picked up, the agent created the service account and granted it the access needed to reach Zoom. The service account was created and its credentials sent to the caller through a secure channel; the access team still needs to enable multi-factor authentication on the account via the SSO Portal before it's fully usable.

INC_405.short_description: Request to set up a new WMS tracking queue for the Cold Chain Expansion project
INC_405.description: We're kicking off the Cold Chain Expansion project at the Dallas DC and need a separate queue in the WMS so we can log and track issues for it apart from regular warehouse tickets. Can someone get that created for us?
INC_405.worknotes: Agent replied that a few more details were needed before the queue could be created: a short description of the project, the default access group for the queue, the default issue type, and whether any additional flags or permissions were required beyond the defaults.
INC_405.resolution_notes: Caller provided a description of the Cold Chain Expansion project, asked that the default access group be set to the warehouse-ops team, set the default issue type to defect, and confirmed no extra flags were needed; the new WMS queue was created with those settings.
INC_405.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that the new queue is visible in WMS with the requested access group and defaults, and that they're able to log items against it.

INC_406.short_description: WMS elevated access request closed for inactivity before supervisor vouch
INC_406.description: Requesting Level 1 access in the WMS so I can adjust inventory counts myself instead of routing every correction through my supervisor. I've read and agree to the WMS elevated access policy. Let me know what else you need from me to get this approved.
INC_406.worknotes: Agent asked the caller to have their supervisor, who holds Level 3 WMS access, post an approval/vouch on the ticket confirming the request; no response came in and the request went stale. Ticket was closed due to inactivity after the required supervisor vouch never arrived; a vouch from someone matching the caller's manager was posted afterward but the ticket was not reopened.

INC_407.short_description: WMS Staging Environment Access (Level 1) for Test Pushes
INC_407.description: I need Level 1 access to the WMS staging environment so I can push test configuration changes. My manager can vouch for me for this access level.
