INC_407.worknotes: Agent granted Level 1 WMS staging access, added the caller to the wms-staging-l1 access group, and provisioned an SSH key for the warehouse test servers, noting propagation could take about an hour; setup documentation from the intranet was shared with the caller.
INC_407.resolution_notes: The caller confirmed SSH access to the WMS staging server, verifying group membership in wms-staging-l1, which grants write access to the test and personal staging areas.
INC_407.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that access is working as expected.

INC_408.short_description: Level 1 write access request for WMS integration account
INC_408.description: Please grant me Level 1 (committer) write access to the WMS integration account so I can push inventory feed updates. I've attached my SSH public key for the account. Let me know once this is set up and I can get in.
INC_408.worknotes: The caller's supervisor vouched for the request, and the access team added the Level 1 write role to the WMS integration account, confirming the SSH key already on file matched the one submitted. Level 1 write access was granted on the WMS integration account, and the caller was pointed to the setup guide at intranet.westfieldlogistics.com for WMS SFTP key authentication.

INC_409.short_description: Remove WMS and VPN access for employee no longer on support team
INC_409.description: This employee has moved off the WMS support team and no longer needs elevated access. Please remove them from the following roles/groups if they still have them: WMS-Systems-Admins, WMS-Inventory-Admins, Network-Monitoring-Admins, WMS-Reporting-Admins, Dallas-DC-Ops-Share, Intranet-WMS-Wiki-Editors, VPN-WMS-Admins, VPN-WMS-Core, and VPN-Distribution-Ops. Thanks!
INC_409.worknotes: The access team checked each requested group against the employee's WMS and directory accounts, finding no membership in four of them, and removed access from the rest that were still active. While reviewing, an agent also flagged a related VPN loaner group not on the original list that still granted access to the WMS core network segment.
INC_409.resolution_notes: All applicable WMS, network share, and Westfield VPN Client groups were removed, including the loaner VPN group once the caller confirmed it should also be revoked. The agent noted the loaner ACL still has other active members and hosts, and offered to help with a broader cleanup pass after the holiday if needed.
INC_409.close_notes: Caller thanked the team for the fast turnaround and confirmed the access removal was complete.

INC_410.description: I tried to push a configuration update to the Warehouse Management System through our deployment tool and got an error that the WMS configuration publisher role is required. I need this role to keep doing config work on the WMS.
INC_410.worknotes: The caller's manager vouched for the access, confirming the caller is working on WMS configuration changes and needs the role. The access team added the caller to the WMS configuration publisher role.

INC_411.short_description: Level 1 WMS integration account access with SSH key authentication
INC_411.description: Requesting Level 1 access to the WMS integration environment. I've attached my SSH public key, which uses ed25519 rather than RSA -- apologies if that's a problem, I can generate an RSA key instead. I've read and agree to the WMS Integration Access Requirements.
INC_411.worknotes: A colleague vouched for the request, and the access team created the account with Level 1 WMS integration access and added the submitted SSH key. The access team emailed login credentials, had the caller set up MFA, and added the SSH key to the account, noting it could take up to an hour to propagate and that keys could be self-managed afterward via the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com.

INC_412.short_description: Reactivate inactive WMS editor account to resubmit routing corrections
INC_412.description: I haven't submitted any updates through the WMS in almost a year. I'd like to submit a few corrections to remove references to the old Dallas cross-dock code now that it's been retired, but I think my WMS editor access is marked inactive so I can't submit change requests or push updates.
INC_412.worknotes: Looped in a couple of people on the WMS access team who could help get the account's editor status restored.
INC_412.resolution_notes: The editor role on the WMS account was reactivated, restoring the caller's ability to submit changes.

INC_413.short_description: Delete SSO Portal account provisioned under incorrect last name
INC_413.description: HR asked us to delete an SSO Portal account that was set up for an employee under the wrong last name. The account was never correct and shouldn't stay active with a bad name on file. Please remove it.
INC_413.worknotes: Agent located the account in the SSO Portal, confirmed with HR that the last name on the account was wrong and that removal (rather than a correction) was the intended action, then proceeded with deletion.
INC_413.resolution_notes: The SSO Portal account was deleted as requested by HR.
INC_413.close_notes: Confirmed with HR that the account has been removed.

INC_414.short_description: SSO Portal application credentials needed for teammate's local development environment
INC_414.description: A colleague on my team is helping build out the new driver forum on the intranet, so they'll need SSO Portal application credentials for local development. I already have a working client ID with all the correct scopes set up — could theirs be granted the same scopes?
INC_414.worknotes: The access team asked for the colleague's local port to configure the SSO Portal callback URL, then worked through which read-only API scopes (SSO Portal Management API, Employee Directory API, Employee Directory API v2) the new application needed to match the caller's working setup. Agent matched the new application's SSO Portal Management API and Employee Directory API scopes to the caller's existing credentials, and copied Employee Directory API v2 scopes from other similar registered apps since the reference credential had none configured there.

INC_415.short_description: Add new QA analyst to network share access group
INC_415.description: Hi there, please add my account to the QA-Team network share. I'm the new QA analyst working on the WMS project and need access to get started. Thanks!
INC_415.worknotes: Agent located the caller's account and added it to the requested network share group. Caller's account was added to the QA-Team network share group, restoring access to the shared files.

INC_416.short_description: API access request for staff directory fields behind cost dashboard
INC_416.description: We run a dashboard that lets dispatch supervisors and regional managers see the labor and equipment costs their team is generating, but the org chart data behind it is stale and we have no way to refresh it. We need read access to an internal API that returns each employee's name, WMS login ID, primary work email, manager, and any other email addresses they use, since staff sometimes submit requests from a personal email or through the auto-generated address the WMS creates. I believe we need the 'staff-only' classification scope to pull this.
INC_416.worknotes: An agent generated API credentials scoped for staff directory read access and sent them to the caller gpg-encrypted; the caller confirmed receipt after a short delay.
INC_416.resolution_notes: Credentials were issued, but when the caller tested them the response omitted manager, secondary system accounts, and alternate email fields, so it was unclear whether an extra flag or permission was still needed; the ticket closed with that follow-up unresolved.
INC_416.close_notes: Confirmed the caller had the credentials and would check back with the access team about the missing fields before the ticket was closed.

INC_417.short_description: Request for WMS Level 3 role access at Dallas DC
INC_417.description: I'm requesting Level 3 role access to the WMS Application for the Dallas distribution center. I have read and agree to abide by the WMS Level 3 access requirements. My handheld scanner is already registered under my account.
INC_417.worknotes: Two shift supervisors vouched for the caller's Level 3 request before the access team processed it; confirmed the caller's handheld device pairing was already on file.
INC_417.resolution_notes: The access team added the caller's account to the WMS Level 3 role group and verified the existing device registration.

INC_418.short_description: WMS Level 3 write access request for warehouse routing project branch
INC_418.description: Requesting Level 3 access to the WMS project branch for the new routing optimization work. My SSH public key is attached for the account. I have read and agree to the WMS elevated access requirements.
INC_418.worknotes: The caller's project lead vouched for the request given the project branch timeline, and the access team confirmed the SSH key was already on the account before provisioning the Level 3 WMS role. The access team granted Level 3 WMS access and asked the caller to log out of the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com and log back in so the updated permissions would take effect.

INC_419.short_description: Register new intranet community site with SSO Portal
INC_419.description: Could you set up SSO Portal access for a new intranet site that will live under intranet.westfieldlogistics.com/community-es/? The site is called "Comunidad Westfield" and the callback will need to be /index.php?sso=1. Let me know what else you need from me.
INC_419.worknotes: The access team created the SSO integration for the new site and asked the caller whether it needed any access control restrictions.
INC_419.resolution_notes: The caller confirmed the site did not need any access control at this time, so the integration was left open to standard SSO login.

INC_420.short_description: Elevated VPN Client access requested for remote network connectivity
INC_420.description: The caller requested Level 3 (elevated) access on the Westfield VPN Client so they could connect remotely into the corporate network, and attached their public key for certificate-based authentication as required. They confirmed they had read and agreed to the access requirements for this access tier.
INC_420.worknotes: The agent confirmed the public key attachment was valid and tracked the ticket until two supervisors posted their approval (vouching) for the elevated access before handing it to the access team. Two supervisors vouched for the caller's elevated VPN Client access, and the access team provisioned the account with Level 3 permissions using the submitted public key.

INC_421.short_description: Grant WMS editor access to winter distribution intern
INC_421.description: Can you grant edit access in the WMS Application to our new intern? She's joining the Dallas distribution center team as a winter intern from December through February and will be working mainly on a warehouse reorganization project. She's already contributed to two work orders in the system.
INC_421.worknotes: Agent confirmed the intern's start date and the two work order numbers with her manager before submitting the access request to the WMS team. The WMS Application editor role was added to the intern's account for the Dallas distribution center.

INC_422.short_description: Set up SSO integration for new Portland branch driver community site
INC_422.description: Hey, can you set up an SSO login for the new Portland branch driver community site? The login page is at community.westfieldlogistics.com/login, and I'm guessing the callback URL should be something like /login?sso=1 - can you confirm and get that configured?
INC_422.worknotes: The access team registered a new application entry in the SSO Portal for the community site and generated a client ID and secret for the integration. The access team created the SSO Portal application entry and sent the client credentials to the caller through the team's secure credential-sharing channel, then asked whether login should be restricted to a specific group before finalizing.

INC_423.short_description: Manager requests TOTP reset for dispatcher locked out of WMS login
INC_423.description: A while back I had to reset my phone and lost all my authenticator app logins. One of them was for my Warehouse Management System account - can someone disable the TOTP requirement so I can log back in? I had the same issue with my SSO portal login before, but that got fixed under a different ticket.
INC_423.worknotes: Ticket was submitted by the caller's manager on their behalf since the caller couldn't log in to file it themselves; agent asked how the submitter was related to the caller, and the manager confirmed being the caller's manager and vouched for the caller's identity.
INC_423.resolution_notes: Since the caller is an active employee, the agent explained that TOTP resets on WMS accounts must go through the identity & access team's standard verification process and routed the request to that queue.

INC_424.short_description: WMS Level 3 access upgrade request for Dallas dispatcher
INC_424.description: Please upgrade my WMS account to Level 3 access. I have an existing login on file, so no new credentials should be needed. I have read and agree to abide by the WMS Level 3 access requirements.
INC_424.worknotes: The access team asked for peer sign-off before approving; the caller's supervisor and a fellow dispatcher who owns the returns-processing workflow both vouched for the caller.
INC_424.resolution_notes: The access team granted Level 3 WMS permissions on the existing account without changing the caller's login credentials, and asked them to log out and back into the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com so the updated role would take effect.
INC_424.close_notes: Caller confirmed Level 3 WMS access was active after logging back into the SSO portal.

INC_425.short_description: Grant WMS inventory-adjustment role to Dallas DC warehouse associate
INC_425.description: I'm trying to record an inventory adjustment in the WMS for a shipment discrepancy at the Dallas distribution centre and I keep hitting a permissions error. Can someone grant me the inventory-adjustment role so I can finish this work order?
INC_425.worknotes: Reached out to the caller's shift supervisor, who confirmed the caller needs inventory-adjustment access for ongoing warehouse operations and vouched for the request. The access team added the caller's WMS account to the inventory-adjustment role group.

INC_426.short_description: Delete SSO Portal account created under wrong employee name
INC_426.description: Please delete the SSO Portal account that was set up for the new hire — HR came back after the fact and asked for the account to be recreated under a different first and last name and employee ID, so the original one is no longer valid.
INC_426.worknotes: The access team verified the correction with HR and located the SSO Portal account that had been provisioned under the outdated name and employee ID. The original SSO Portal account was deleted; HR's corrected request was handled separately to provision the account under the updated name and employee ID.

INC_427.short_description: Grant WMS direct-write config access to routing module owner
INC_427.description: As the owner of the WMS routing automation module and an administrator of the multi-site WMS platform, the caller often needs to push cross-site configuration changes directly, along with handling release-blocking issues and complex go-live cutovers between Chicago, Dallas, and Portland. They asked to be added to the WMS role that allows direct configuration pushes without going through the standard review queue.
INC_427.worknotes: The access team confirmed the caller's ownership of the WMS routing automation module and their admin status on the multi-site WMS platform before proceeding.
INC_427.resolution_notes: The caller was added to the WMS direct-write configuration role, giving them push access to deploy cross-site changes directly.

INC_428.short_description: Restore WMS access after inactivity lockout
INC_428.description: My Warehouse Management System login stopped working because the account was flagged inactive. Can someone restore my access so I can get back into WMS? Thanks!
INC_428.worknotes: Looped in the access team to review the account and re-enable WMS access for the caller.
INC_428.resolution_notes: The access team re-enabled WMS access and asked the caller to log out of all existing sessions, wait at least 30 minutes, then log back in to test.
INC_428.close_notes: Caller confirmed WMS access is working again and the ticket was closed.

INC_429.short_description: Level 3 network share access request for Dallas distribution centre
INC_429.description: I've attached my public key as required and I've read and agree to the network share access requirements. Please set up the access using my Westfield Logistics account so it's tied to the right login.
INC_429.worknotes: The access team verified the caller already had Level 1 share access, vouched for by their supervisor and a second team lead, and confirmed the attached public key was already associated with their account.
INC_429.resolution_notes: The access team granted Level 3 access on the network share and had the caller log out and back into the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com to resync their permissions.

INC_430.short_description: Delete unused personal SSO account tied to old email address
INC_430.description: The caller asked the access team to delete an old personal account on the SSO portal that they no longer use. The email on the account matches their current one, but under a personal domain instead of @westfieldlogistics.com, and they offered to email from that address to verify ownership if needed.
INC_430.worknotes: An agent located the unused account on the SSO portal and confirmed it matched the caller's description before taking action. The agent disabled the unused personal account.

INC_431.short_description: Disable old personal intranet portal account still getting CC'd on tickets
INC_431.description: I set up a personal account on the intranet portal a few years back, before I had a real Westfield account. Now that I have my official account, the old one isn't needed anymore, but it's still getting CC'd and assigned to tickets by accident. I'd like the old personal account disabled.
INC_431.worknotes: Agent confirmed the caller only needed to remove the display handle from the old profile and disable it themselves in account settings, since self-service avoided the access team having to verify ownership.
INC_431.resolution_notes: Caller disabled the old personal intranet account themselves using the self-service option the agent pointed them to.

INC_432.short_description: WMS access upgrade from Level 1 to Level 3
INC_432.description: Requesting an upgrade from level 1 to level 3 access on the WMS. I was given level 1 access originally to run test transactions for a specific project. I have read and agree to abide by the WMS access requirements.
INC_432.worknotes: Two colleagues vouched for the caller, but the access team noted that level 3 access specifically requires vouchers from two WMS module owners, and neither voucher's name appeared on the current module owner/peer roster on the intranet, so the caller was asked where else to check. A further vouch came in from a colleague holding a qualifying module owner role, meeting the two-voucher requirement for level 3 access.

INC_433.short_description: Local dev app gets 400 from SSO Portal /authorize endpoint
INC_433.description: I'm getting a 400 error when my local front-end app calls the /authorize endpoint on the SSO Portal. Steps: I run the app locally, log in, then hard refresh the page, and after that the Log In and Log Out buttons both go gray because of the 400 showing up in the network tab. This doesn't happen when I test against the default sandbox client the access team set up for me.
INC_433.worknotes: Agent reviewed the SSO Portal client configuration registered for the caller's application and compared its settings against the working sandbox client. The caller's local development URL was missing from the allowed web origins list on their SSO Portal client; the access team added it and the 400 errors stopped.

INC_434.short_description: Whitelist staging URL in SSO Portal config for Driver Portal app
INC_434.description: The Driver Portal app's SSO Portal client currently only has localhost:5000 whitelisted for local development. Once we push the login flow to our staging server, we'll also need https://driverportal-staging.westfieldlogistics.com whitelisted. There's no production server yet.
INC_434.worknotes: An agent added the staging URL to the SSO Portal client's allowed callback URLs and allowed web origins for the Driver Portal app.
INC_434.resolution_notes: The web origins entry initially had a trailing slash which broke login redirects on staging; removing the trailing slash so the origin read https://driverportal-staging.westfieldlogistics.com fixed it.
INC_434.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that staging login now completes successfully.

INC_435.short_description: Enable API audience for internal Route Analytics dashboard SSO client
INC_435.description: The front-end of our internal Route Analytics dashboard authenticates users through the SSO portal before calling its protected API. Based on the SSO portal's integration docs, it looks like the application's client needs an API configured before the front-end can call the protected endpoints. Can someone enable an API for the Route Analytics client and send me the audience value?
INC_435.worknotes: The access team asked the caller for the protected API's URL to use as the audience; the caller provided the local development path (localhost:8000/api/) and the staging path (https://route-analytics.staging.westfieldlogistics.com/api/) along with a sample list of endpoints. The access team then created an API entry with audience set to the staging URL and confirmed the client is registered as a single-page application, which needs no additional API permissions. The access team enabled an API for the Route Analytics SSO client with the staging hostname configured as the audience value, which was sufficient for the single-page application to reach its protected API.

INC_436.short_description: Request for Level 3 elevated access to WMS Application
INC_436.description: I'd like to request Level 3 access in the WMS Application for my role. I've read and agree to the elevated access requirements, and I already have a Level 1 test account with my login credentials set up on file, so let me know if those still need to be resubmitted.
INC_436.worknotes: Two colleagues on the warehouse team vouched for the request before it was routed to the access team to provision the Level 3 account. The access team granted Level 3 WMS access, noting the change could take up to an hour to propagate and that the caller might need to log out and back into the SSO portal.

INC_437.short_description: SSO portal account password expired, unable to reset in time
INC_437.description: Hi, my SSO portal password expired and I didn't get it changed before the deadline. I tried going to otp.westfieldlogistics.com but I never set up a new password there. Could someone reset my account so I can log back in? Thanks.
INC_437.worknotes: Agent verified the caller's identity and reset the SSO account password, then sent a temporary password to the caller's Outlook mailbox.
INC_437.resolution_notes: Caller received the temporary password by email, logged into the SSO portal, and set a new password successfully.

INC_438.short_description: VPN Client key update for former intern now using personal email
INC_438.description: Hi, can I get my VPN client key updated for the Level 1 remote access I was granted during my internship? I'm no longer a Westfield Logistics intern, so I'm using my personal email now instead of my company one. I tried to update the key through the SSO portal but couldn't figure out the right credentials to log in.
INC_438.worknotes: Agent checked the directory and found no account under the caller's personal email, only a disabled account tied to their former intern email with the Level 1 WMS remote access on file. Agent confirmed with the caller that creating a new account under the personal email, carrying over the same access level, was acceptable. Agent created a new account under the caller's personal email, ported over the Level 1 WMS remote access and VPN client key from the old account, and emailed login credentials plus SSO multi-factor setup instructions, noting the change would take about an hour to propagate.

INC_439.short_description: Restore Level 3 WMS access after return from medical leave
INC_439.description: I've just returned to work after several months of medical leave. If the automatic systems worked the way they should have, my Level 3 WMS access expired while I was out. I need that access restored so I can get back to my normal duties.
INC_439.worknotes: Welcomed the caller back and looped in the access team to review and restore their WMS role and SSO Portal entitlement.
INC_439.resolution_notes: The access team re-enabled the caller's Level 3 WMS role and SSO Portal access, and asked the caller to log out of all active sessions and wait up to an hour before testing.
INC_439.close_notes: Caller confirmed access was working as expected.

INC_440.short_description: WMS Application Level 1 Access for New Dispatcher
INC_440.description: Attached is my device access key for the Warehouse Management System. I have read, and agree to abide by, the WMS Access Requirements. Requesting Level 1 access to get started.
INC_440.worknotes: The caller's supervisor vouched for Level 1 WMS access; the ticket was routed to the access team to provision the account. The access team enabled WMS application access, added the Level 1 role, and applied the caller's device access key, then asked them to log out of all active sessions and test after 30 minutes.

INC_441.short_description: Portland branch DNS resolves WMS hostname to wrong IP with invalid certificate
INC_441.description: From the Portland branch, a DNS lookup for wms.westfieldlogistics.com returns an IP that serves a certificate that isn't valid for that name, while looking it up through a public DNS resolver returns an IP with a good certificate. Looking up www.wms.westfieldlogistics.com from the branch gives no answer at all, even though it resolves fine externally.
INC_441.worknotes: The access team compared the answer from the internal DNS server against a public resolver and found the internal zone was serving a stale, mismatched record for the hostname. The invalid internal DNS record was corrected on the internal DNS server, restoring the correct IP and certificate for the WMS hostname.

INC_442.short_description: Add caller to WMS voice-picking project access group
INC_442.description: Hi there, can you add my account to the voice-picking project group in the WMS? I'm going to be involved with that project soon and need access. Thanks!
INC_442.worknotes: Agent reviewed the request and added the caller's account to the requested WMS voice-picking project access group. Caller's account was added to the voice-picking project group in the Warehouse Management System, granting the access needed for the project.

INC_443.short_description: WMS elevated access request for warehouse associate
INC_443.description: I'd like to request that one of our warehouse associates be added to the WMS Inventory-Config write role. I've already confirmed this with the other process owner, and none of the module peers have objected. My supervisor is on CC for visibility.
INC_443.worknotes: Confirmed the caller's approval from the other process owner and verified the associate already holds base WMS access and had acknowledged the System Access Policy.
INC_443.resolution_notes: Added the associate to the WMS Inventory-Config write role in the Warehouse Management System.

INC_444.short_description: Add caller to WMS label-template-editors access group
INC_444.description: Please add me to the label-template-editors group in the Warehouse Management System. INC_444.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that they now have access to update label templates in WMS.

INC_445.short_description: Grant WMS record-edit access for a warehouse associate
INC_445.description: Caller asked that a colleague on their team be granted edit rights in the WMS so they can update shipment and inventory records directly instead of only leaving comments. INC_446.short_description: New hire on IT security team needs network share access
INC_446.description: Hi! I'm a relatively new hire on the IT security team and need to be added to the network share used by the team. Thanks!

INC_447.short_description: Grant WMS edit access for a colleague on the dispatch team

INC_447.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that the colleague already had edit access and closed the ticket.

INC_448.short_description: Request to share WMS integration client secret with teammate
INC_448.description: A teammate of mine working on the WMS integration project needs the client secret for the WMS application client we use for the automated freight data feed. INC_449.short_description: New VPN Client Access Request for Remote WMS Login

INC_450.short_description: Level 1 WMS Access Request – Dallas Distribution Centre

INC_452.short_description: WMS Level 1 access request for new warehouse associate
INC_452.description: I've read and agree to abide by the WMS Access Policy. My supervisor already vouched for me to get set up. Could you get my Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System going and register the device key I attached for my handheld scanner?

INC_453.short_description: New SSO Portal test-environment credentials for WMS reporting team

INC_454.short_description: WMS posting role expired, shipment batch finalization blocked

INC_455.short_description: Re-enable employee's SSO portal account after removing sensitive access
INC_455.description: The caller, a warehouse supervisor, asked the service desk to reactivate a team member's SSO portal account. Before turning it back on, they wanted the account pulled from any confidential network shares or security-incident WMS roles it was still listed on.

INC_456.short_description: Add me as owner of WMS integration VPN access groups (prod/stage)

INC_457.short_description: Temporarily reassign owner of WMS alerts shared mailbox

INC_458.short_description: Level 3 VPN Client Access Request for Dallas Dispatcher

INC_459.short_description: Request for supervisor-level access in the Warehouse Management System
INC_459.description: I'm requesting supervisor-level access in the WMS. I already have operator-level access that was granted a while back. My shift lead and the inventory control lead are both willing to vouch for this request.

INC_460.short_description: Former warehouse employee's SSO account still active
INC_460.description: The caller reports that a warehouse associate who left Westfield Logistics about 15 days ago still has an active account on the SSO portal. They're asking that access be removed since the person no longer works there.

INC_461.short_description: Request to raise WMS access tier from Tier 1 to Tier 3
INC_461.description: I currently have Tier 1 access to the Warehouse Management System and am requesting that it be raised to Tier 3. INC_462.short_description: Level 3 WMS override access request pending second supervisor sign-off
INC_462.description: I need Level 3 override access in the WMS so I can clear shipment holds and adjust inventory counts during my shift. I've attached my access key file and confirm I've read and agree to the WMS elevated access policy. My shift lead has already signed off on the request.

INC_463.short_description: Restore WMS resolve permission for Carrier Compliance queue owner after email change
INC_463.description: I'm leaving Westfield Logistics today, but I'll continue on as owner of the Carrier Compliance and Carrier Onboarding queues in the WMS. INC_464.short_description: Reassign owner of WMS carrier-integration module

INC_465.short_description: VPN Client access request for new dispatcher — certificate login setup
INC_465.description: I need remote access set up for the Westfield VPN Client so I can connect from home. I've attached my public key file for the certificate. My supervisor said they'd vouch for me to get this approved.

VPN Client access was granted with certificate authentication configured, and a temporary password was sent to the caller's Westfield email.

INC_466.short_description: Request for Level 1 Westfield VPN Client access
INC_466.description: I'd like Level 1 access to the Westfield VPN Client. I've attached my public key for enrollment and I've read and agree to the VPN access terms posted at intranet.westfieldlogistics.com. My supervisor said they'd vouch for me.

INC_467.short_description: Password reset requested for SSO portal account

INC_468.short_description: Restore VPN Client access after returning to the company
INC_468.description: I rejoined Westfield Logistics yesterday and got an error trying to connect through the Westfield VPN Client to reach the WMS. I'm attaching my VPN client certificate again just in case it's needed. Would it be possible to re-enable my VPN access?

INC_469.short_description: Update owner listed for Dallas DC training documentation share

INC_473.short_description: Level 1 access request for WMS test environment
INC_473.description: I'd like to get access to the WMS test environment and need Level 1 access. I've read and agree to abide by the access requirements for this system, and I've attached my public key for the account.
