INC_521.short_description: Request for WMS staging access to run test cases
INC_521.description: I need access to the WMS staging environment so I can run some basic test cases for an issue I'm working on. I've read and agree to abide by the WMS access requirements. Sorry for the extra follow-up emails — I should have included everything in one message.
INC_521.worknotes: A team lead vouched for the request; the access team verified it and provisioned a WMS staging account with an associated network login and SSH key for the caller.
INC_521.resolution_notes: WMS staging access (Level 1) was granted with a network account, SSH key, and staging login; a temporary password was emailed to the caller and they were asked to confirm once able to log in.

INC_522.description: I'd like my WMS access bumped from Level 1 to Level 3 so I can post inventory adjustments myself instead of routing every one through a supervisor. My shift lead and one of the warehouse supervisors can vouch for me if needed.
INC_522.worknotes: The caller's shift lead and a warehouse supervisor both confirmed the request in the ticket thread, and the access team verified the caller had signed off on the WMS elevated-access requirements before approving the change.
INC_522.resolution_notes: The access team granted Level 3 WMS access and asked the caller to log out and back into the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com so the new role would sync to the WMS application.
INC_522.close_notes: Caller confirmed the Level 3 access was working after re-logging into the SSO portal, and the ticket was closed.

INC_523.short_description: Level 1 WMS Access Request with SSH Key
INC_523.description: I'm requesting Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System. My manager can vouch for me for this access level, and I've attached my public SSH key for the account setup.
INC_523.worknotes: Agent verified the caller had acknowledged the WMS access requirements and confirmed the manager's vouch was on record before processing the request. The access team granted Level 1 WMS access, added the caller's SSH key to the account, and emailed a temporary password to the caller.

INC_524.short_description: New WMS scripts repository access requires Level 1 commit rights
INC_524.description: I'm requesting Level 1 commit access to the WMS scripts repository so I can push changes directly instead of routing them through someone else. I've read and agree to the repository access requirements, and I'm vouching for myself on this request. My SSH public key is attached for setup.
INC_524.worknotes: The access team reviewed the caller's signed agreement to the access requirements and the attached SSH public key, then added the caller to the Level 1 repository access group and installed the SSH key on the server. Level 1 commit access was granted, the SSH key was installed, and a temporary password was emailed to the caller's Westfield account.

INC_525.short_description: VPN Client Tier 1 Access Request for Remote Dispatcher
INC_525.description: I'm requesting Tier 1 access on the Westfield VPN Client and have attached my public key as required. I've read and agree to abide by the VPN Client access requirements, and my supervisor has agreed to vouch for the request.
INC_525.worknotes: Agent confirmed the supervisor's vouch, created the VPN account, and applied the Tier 1 access group using the submitted public key. Temporary credentials with setup instructions were emailed to the caller; the key needed about an hour to propagate before the Tier 1 VPN account went active.

INC_526.short_description: Upgrade intranet publishing access from Level 1 to Level 3
INC_526.description: My Level 1 access to the intranet site was granted a while back. I'd like to request Level 3 access now so I can check in my own page updates directly instead of routing them through someone else.
INC_526.worknotes: Two colleagues on the team vouched for the caller being trustworthy to hold direct publish access; the request had been logged against the wrong access queue and was moved to the correct one before processing. Request was redirected to the correct queue, the two vouches were confirmed, and Level 3 publishing access was granted on intranet.westfieldlogistics.com.

INC_527.short_description: WMS Level 1 access request with SFTP key for new hire
INC_527.description: I need Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System so I can start entering shipment and inventory records. I've attached my SSH public key for the SFTP integration setup, and my Chicago HQ email is what I'd like used as the login. I've read and agree to the WMS Level 1 access requirements.
INC_527.worknotes: Agent vouched for the caller, provisioned a WMS account with the Level 1 role, and added the submitted SSH public key for SFTP access; credentials and reset instructions were emailed, along with a link to the intranet.westfieldlogistics.com WMS setup guide. WMS account was created with Level 1 access and the SSH key attached for SFTP; the key propagated within the hour and the caller was able to log in.

INC_528.short_description: Grant WMS level 1 access to trusted vendor contact
INC_528.description: I'd like to request WMS application access (level 1) for a vendor contact who has been a big help with our warehouse scanning integration - he's logged and resolved several issues with the barcode scanner module over the past few months. I vouch for him, and giving him level 1 access to the WMS test environment would let us confirm his recent fixes actually work against our system. I've read and agree to abide by the WMS access requirements.
INC_528.worknotes: Agent verified the requester had acknowledged the WMS access requirements and noted the internal vouch, then routed the request to the access team for provisioning.
INC_528.resolution_notes: The access team granted WMS level 1 access, issued login credentials, and emailed the temporary password to the address on file.
INC_528.close_notes: The caller confirmed the vendor contact was able to log in and submit test transactions, thanked the team, and the ticket was closed.

INC_529.short_description: Level 1 WMS staging environment access request
INC_529.description: I need Level 1 access to the WMS staging environment so I can test route and inventory changes before they go live. My supervisor has already vouched for me to get this access. I've attached my SSH public key for the account setup.
INC_529.worknotes: Agent confirmed the supervisor's approval, verified the submitted SSH public key, and granted Level 1 staging access on the WMS Application account, noting the change could take up to an hour to propagate and that the caller would need to log out and back into the SSO portal for it to take effect. Level 1 staging access was granted on the caller's WMS Application account with their SSH key added; access became active after logging out and back into the SSO portal.

INC_530.short_description: WMS Test Environment Access (Level 1) request for new team member
INC_530.description: I've read and agree to abide by the WMS test environment access requirements. Attached is my SSH public key. I'm on the warehouse inventory integration team and need Level 1 push access to the WMS test environment.
INC_530.worknotes: Confirmed with the caller's manager, who vouched that the caller is an engineer on the WMS integrations team and needs test environment access; reviewed the submitted SSH key. The access team provisioned the account with the appropriate SSO group, the submitted SSH key, and Level 1 WMS test environment access, and advised the caller that the change could take up to an hour to propagate and that they would need to log out and back into the SSO portal.

INC_531.short_description: Request for Level 3 WMS access to commit inventory changes
INC_531.description: I currently have Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System. Could I be granted Level 3 access so I can commit changes directly to the Dallas distribution centre inventory records? I've read and agree to the WMS access requirements policy, and I've attached the authentication key for the WMS terminal.
INC_531.worknotes: The access team asked the caller's manager and two colleagues to vouch for the elevated access, and validated the attached authentication key before escalating the request for provisioning. The request received the two peer vouches required for Level 3 access, satisfying the escalation policy; one colleague also flagged that the older WMS sync module referenced in the request may already be deprecated, which the access team is verifying before final provisioning.

INC_532.short_description: Add approved callback URL to WMS Admin SSO client (all environments)
INC_532.description: We have three separate WMS Application environments -- production, staging, and dev -- each with its own SSO Portal client configuration. All three need a specific callback URL added to their Allowed Callback URLs list so our WMS Devtools browser extension can authenticate and write to each environment. The URL is auto-generated by the browser's extension identity API.
INC_532.worknotes: Agent located the SSO Portal client configurations for all three WMS Application environments (prod, staging, dev) and confirmed the callback URL format submitted by the caller.
INC_532.resolution_notes: Agent added the callback URL to the Allowed Callback URLs list on all three WMS Application SSO Portal clients.

INC_533.short_description: Delegate email-notification subdomain to AWS Route 53
INC_533.description: Please remove the existing CNAME record for notifications.westfieldlogistics.com and delegate that subdomain to our AWS Route 53 name servers (ns-1479.awsdns-56.org, ns-189.awsdns-23.com, ns-883.awsdns-46.net, ns-1998.awsdns-57.co.uk) so our email vendor can manage DNS directly. While you're in there, can you also revoke the SSL certificate tied to that hostname?
INC_533.worknotes: The agent confirmed the change could be made at any time, but checked the hostname's certificate first and found it was a DigiCert cert (serial 05A9AF9E036CD18BA8764C0DC3B1CBF4) still in active use, so declined to revoke it. The existing CNAME for notifications.westfieldlogistics.com was deleted and a delegation to the requested Route 53 name servers was created, leaving the SSL certificate untouched; the caller was told to allow up to 30 minutes for DNS propagation.

INC_534.short_description: Request elevated WMS role to triage and close exception records
INC_534.description: I've been helping out with the WMS for a while now, reporting issues and helping reproduce and test problems that come up. I think I could help more if I had permission to triage and close resolved exception records myself. Right now I can't triage, close, or add info to WMS exception records because I don't have that access level.
INC_534.worknotes: Access team reviewed the caller's history of reported and reproduced WMS exceptions and confirmed the elevated role was warranted. Granted the caller the elevated WMS role needed to triage and close resolved exception records.

INC_535.short_description: WMS edit access requested and granted for new warehouse associate
INC_535.description: I'm a new hire at the Dallas distribution centre and need edit access to the Warehouse Management System so I can start logging inventory moves. My supervisor already knows about the request and can vouch for me.
INC_535.worknotes: The agent confirmed the caller had acknowledged the WMS access policy on file, and the caller's manager vouched for the request before it was processed.
INC_535.resolution_notes: The access team granted Level 1 WMS edit access along with a network share account, and emailed a temporary password to the caller.
INC_535.close_notes: The caller confirmed they were able to log into the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com and successfully changed their password.

INC_536.short_description: SSO licensing costs for opening ideation platform to external users
INC_536.description: We've licensed an ideation platform to run innovation campaigns for Westfield Logistics and our Continuous Improvement group, and it's already integrated with the SSO portal. We have a safety-suggestions campaign that ran internally with employees that we'd like to open to external carrier partners and drivers, with limited promotion. I'm trying to estimate the number of non-employee users authenticating through SSO for this (my rough guess is under 1000) and want to understand the license and cost implications before we proceed.
INC_536.worknotes: The access team provided per-user SSO licensing rate tiers for non-employee/external accounts and confirmed the current contract's included user count, noting overage charges aren't automatic but apply if sustained usage exceeds the contracted tier. The caller confirmed the quoted per-user rates were well within budget and the access team explained that any resulting overage costs would be identified and charged back to the caller's cost center in coordination with them.

INC_537.short_description: Request for WMS Level 1 operator access and device key setup
INC_537.description: I'm requesting Level 1 operator access to the WMS for my account, which currently only has the default Everyone-level access. There are already vouches for me from two colleagues noted on a related ticket, and I've read and agree to abide by the access requirements.
INC_537.worknotes: Confirmed the two prior vouches referenced on the linked ticket and that the caller had acknowledged the access requirements, then granted the WMS Level 1 role and attached a new device key to the caller's account. Device key was applied to the account; agent noted it can take up to an hour to sync across warehouse terminals and pointed the caller to the SSO portal to self-manage keys going forward, plus the intranet page with WMS device setup steps.

INC_538.short_description: Assign owner for unowned WMS Inventory Sync module
INC_538.description: I noticed the Inventory Sync module in the WMS doesn't have anyone listed as the point of contact. It should probably be me, so can you update the record to show me as the owner instead of no one?
INC_538.worknotes: Agent updated the WMS module ownership record to list the caller as point of contact. Ownership of the Inventory Sync module was reassigned to the caller, and the reference link in the internal documentation was updated to point to the correct page on intranet.westfieldlogistics.com.

INC_539.short_description: Update default triage contact for WMS Inventory Discrepancy queue
INC_539.description: I'll be away intermittently over the next couple of months, and a colleague on my team has offered to take over ownership of the Inventory Discrepancy queue in WMS. Can you update the system so tickets route to them as the default contact instead of me?
INC_539.worknotes: Agent confirmed the colleague's WMS role and access, then updated the queue configuration to point the default triage contact to them.
INC_539.resolution_notes: Default triage/owner contact for the WMS Inventory Discrepancy queue was reassigned to the colleague as requested.

INC_540.short_description: Delete duplicate SSO account created with misspelled username
INC_540.description: The caller asks the access team to delete an account that was created with a misspelled username on the SSO portal, noting that the correctly spelled account name is different. They want the mistyped duplicate removed so it doesn't cause confusion at login.
INC_540.worknotes: The access team located the incorrectly named account on otp.westfieldlogistics.com and confirmed the properly spelled account already existed and was active. The duplicate account with the misspelled username was deleted from the SSO portal.

INC_541.description: I've read and agree to the requirements for Level 3 WMS access. My Level 1 access was already approved in an earlier request, and I'd like to move up to Level 3 now.
INC_541.worknotes: The caller's supervisor vouched for them twice in the ticket thread confirming they were ready for elevated access; the access team then added the Level 3 role to the caller's WMS account.
INC_541.resolution_notes: Level 3 WMS access was granted on the account. The caller was told the change could take up to an hour to propagate and to log out and back into the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com to pick it up.

INC_542.description: I'm requesting Level 1 access to the WMS integration environment and have attached my SSH public key. I've read and agree to abide by the WMS Access Requirements policy, and my supervisor has vouched for me on this request.
INC_542.worknotes: The access team confirmed the vouch from the caller's supervisor, added the submitted SSH key, and granted WMS integration Level 1 access, noting propagation could take up to an hour and that the caller would need to log out and back into the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com afterward. Access team granted Level 1 WMS integration access (SSH key plus role group); once propagated, the caller confirmed access with an SSH connection test showing membership in the wms_level_1 group.

INC_543.short_description: Level 1 commit access request for WMS integration scripts repository
INC_543.description: Requesting Level 1 commit access to the WMS integration scripts repository. Please use my Westfield network ID as my login name, and I've attached my SSH public key. I have read and agree to abide by the WMS Repository Access Policy.
INC_543.worknotes: The access team enabled repository access and confirmed the caller's SSH public key matched their account, then advised them to log out and back into the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com to refresh permissions, per the setup guide on the intranet. The caller found their SSH config file was missing under ~/.ssh and created one, but still got a 'Permission denied (publickey)' error connecting to the repository host; the access team was continuing to investigate the key mismatch when the thread ended.

INC_544.short_description: Grant WMS ticket-edit role to warehouse contractor
INC_544.description: Can you grant WMS ticket-editing rights to the temp associate who's been helping the Dallas team clear discrepancy tickets? They've already worked directly on two tickets themselves, so it'd save time if they could update WMS directly instead of routing every change through me.
INC_544.worknotes: Agent confirmed the associate's account was active in WMS and checked that the two referenced discrepancy tickets showed their contributions before adding the ticket-edit role.
INC_544.resolution_notes: The WMS ticket-editing role was added to the associate's account, giving them permission to update discrepancy tickets directly.

INC_545.short_description: Re-enable WMS test environment submit access for dispatcher
INC_545.description: My submit access to the WMS test environment seems to have expired. I need it re-enabled so I can push some updates through for testing.
INC_545.worknotes: The access team re-enabled the caller's WMS submit access and asked them to wait up to an hour, then log out and back in to confirm it worked. WMS submit access was restored; the caller logged back in and confirmed they could push updates to the test environment again.

INC_546.short_description: Abandoned SSO portal subdomains vulnerable to takeover via dangling DNS records
INC_546.description: While doing some external testing I found a few subdomains under otp.westfieldlogistics.com that look like they've already been taken over by someone else. The DNS records still point to a hosting service Westfield no longer controls. I've flagged similar abandoned-subdomain issues before and I'm happy to answer questions over Slack if that's easier.
INC_546.worknotes: Agent verified the DNS records still resolved correctly but the underlying cloud hosting registration had expired, then looped in the team that originally stood up the affected pages before making any changes. The owning team confirmed the subdomains were left over from a discontinued portal pilot with no current owner, so the network team removed the dangling DNS records.

INC_547.short_description: Grant WMS record-edit role to a warehouse colleague
INC_547.description: The caller asked that a colleague on the warehouse floor be given edit rights in the WMS application, noting the colleague had already worked on inventory records tied to a couple of shipment tickets. The caller supplied those ticket numbers as evidence of the colleague's prior contributions.
INC_547.worknotes: An agent checked the shipment/inventory records the colleague had contributed to and confirmed the request was legitimate before applying the change.
INC_547.resolution_notes: The WMS editor role was granted to the colleague's account.

INC_548.short_description: Remove unused internal hostname for decommissioned WMS reporting environment
INC_548.description: We had an internal hostname record, reports-dev.wms.westfieldlogistics.com, pointing to a WMS reporting/dev environment that's been retired. It's not needed anymore, so please remove it.
INC_548.worknotes: Network team located the CNAME record in internal DNS, confirmed with the caller that the WMS reporting environment behind it had been decommissioned, and removed the entry. The stale internal hostname record was deleted from DNS.

INC_549.short_description: Reactivate WMS access for returning contractor on partner integration project
INC_549.description: We need WMS access reactivated for a former team member who is coming back to help set up the integration branch for our new carrier partner project. They will be pushing changes directly to that branch and will also need access to the staging environment to test builds before they go out.
INC_549.worknotes: Checked and confirmed the former contractor's original WMS account had been fully deprovisioned and could not simply be reactivated; asked the caller to have them submit a new account request with a personal contact email and the specific WMS role needed for the integration branch.
INC_549.resolution_notes: A separate request for elevated WMS access was filed and covered the same need, so this ticket was closed as a duplicate once that request was confirmed to be moving forward.
INC_549.problem_display: Level 3 write access request for Dallas DC routing project share

INC_550.short_description: Remove broken DNS record for retired WMS reporting subdomain
INC_550.description: reports.westfieldlogistics.com is currently a CNAME pointing to our old WMS reporting server. The SSL certificate on that server hasn't been fixed in years and throws a certificate error when you hit the page, and the request to fix it was closed as won't-fix. Since it's broken with no plan to repair it, can we just delete the DNS record so people get a normal site-not-found error instead of a security warning?
INC_550.worknotes: Confirmed the record isn't owned by the WMS application team and routed the request to the internal network/DNS team; caller also corrected a typo in the hostname they'd originally listed.
INC_550.resolution_notes: The network team deleted the CNAME record for the retired WMS reporting subdomain.

INC_551.short_description: Restore Westfield VPN Client access disabled due to inactivity
INC_551.description: The caller said they can no longer connect through the Westfield VPN Client. They hadn't needed to work remotely in several months, and now that they do, their login is being rejected even though the account should still exist.
INC_551.worknotes: Agent confirmed the caller's account was still provisioned but had been automatically deactivated after an extended period without a VPN connection, which is standard for accounts that go unused for a few months. Agent reactivated the caller's standard remote access tier on the Westfield VPN Client account.

INC_552.short_description: Add new WMS tracker component for scanner performance testing
INC_552.description: Can you set up a new component in the WMS issue tracker under the Testing product? Call it dock-scan-perf - it's for the new performance testing framework we're rolling out for the handheld scanners. Default assignee and triage owner should be the WMS test lead, no reviewers needed for now. Thanks!
INC_552.worknotes: Agent created the dock-scan-perf component under the Testing product in the WMS issue tracker and set the default assignee and triage owner to the WMS test lead as requested. New component was added to the tracker as specified.

INC_553.short_description: Level 3 write access request for Dallas DC routing project share
INC_553.description: I need Level 3 access so I can write directly to the Dallas DC route optimization project folder on the network share, using my usual network login. My SSH public key is attached for the SFTP connection. My manager can confirm I'm on this project.
INC_553.worknotes: Agent saw that two managers vouched for the caller in the ticket thread, but flagged that it was unclear whether Level 1 (read-only) or Level 3 (write) access was actually needed since the caller will be actively editing files in the folder, not just viewing them. Once the required manager vouches were on record and the access team confirmed the caller would be writing files rather than just reading them, Level 3 write access to the project share was granted and the caller was added to the corresponding share permissions group.
INC_553.problem_display: Level 3 write access request for Dallas DC routing project share

INC_554.short_description: Grant network share access for new Dallas DC project setup
INC_554.description: I'm going to need access to the new distribution center project's network share so I can push the initial batch of setup files over. This is for the project we're standing up at the Dallas facility.
INC_554.worknotes: Agent confirmed the request and target share with the caller, then verified the project folder existed before adding access.
INC_554.resolution_notes: Access to the network share was granted so the caller could upload the initial project files.

INC_555.short_description: Update default contact for WMS Compliance Exceptions queue
INC_555.description: The caller asked the service desk to change the default contact on all tickets filed under the Warehouse Management System's Compliance Exceptions category from the current contact to themselves. They explained they are taking over this responsibility from the previous compliance contact and need new tickets in that category routed to them going forward.
INC_555.worknotes: Agent located the routing configuration for the WMS Compliance Exceptions category and confirmed the caller's new role assignment before making the change.
INC_555.resolution_notes: The default contact field for the WMS Compliance Exceptions category was updated to the caller, replacing the previous default contact.
INC_555.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that the default contact change was applied and new compliance exception tickets would now route to them.

INC_556.short_description: Remove QA contact from WMS Inbound Receiving component
INC_556.description: Please remove the current QA contact listed on the Inbound Receiving component in the Warehouse Management System. No replacement contact is needed for this field. Thank you.
INC_556.worknotes: Agent located the Inbound Receiving component record in the Warehouse Management System and cleared the QA contact field as requested. The QA contact field on the component was updated to remove the listed contact; no replacement was assigned.

INC_557.short_description: Level 3 WMS Application access request with SSH key for integration account
INC_557.description: I need Level 3 access to the WMS Application for the route integration work I'm doing. I've attached my public SSH key as required and I have read and agree to abide by the WMS access requirements. Let me know once it's set up so I can start using it.
INC_557.worknotes: The access team confirmed two supervisors vouched for the request and validated the attached SSH key before assigning the Level 3 WMS Application role, noting account changes can take up to an hour to propagate to the SSO portal. Level 3 WMS Application access was granted with the provided SSH key on file, and the change propagated to the SSO portal within the hour.

INC_558.short_description: Reset MFA authenticator device on SSO portal account
INC_558.description: I have an authenticator token linked to my account that was set up back in 2019, but I no longer have access to that device. I need it reset so I can enroll a new one.
INC_558.worknotes: Advised the caller to install an authenticator app on their phone and log in to the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com with their SSO credentials to enroll a new MFA device. Caller installed the mobile authenticator app and registered a new MFA device profile through the SSO portal, restoring their access.

INC_559.short_description: WMS Level 3 Access Request for Dispatcher
INC_559.description: I'm requesting Level 3 access to the Warehouse Management System. I've attached my device's SSH public key as required, and I've read and agree to abide by the WMS access requirements.
INC_559.worknotes: Two colleagues from the caller's team vouched for the request before the access team reviewed it; the SSH key was added to the caller's account and the Level 3 WMS role was applied. The access team granted Level 3 WMS access tied to the submitted SSH key and asked the caller to log out and back into the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com so the change could propagate.

INC_560.short_description: Grant WMS exception-reviewer permission for a coworker
INC_560.description: Can you grant a coworker of mine the exception-reviewer permission in the WMS? We want them to start reviewing inventory discrepancy reports for the Dallas distribution centre. They've already worked on two of those reports, so they should be ready for the added access.
INC_560.worknotes: Agent checked the two WMS discrepancy records the coworker had worked on and confirmed they were ready for the elevated role.
INC_560.resolution_notes: Updated the coworker's WMS account to include exception-reviewer permissions.
INC_560.close_notes: Confirmed the permission is now showing on their account; closing the ticket.

INC_561.short_description: Level 1 commit access request for WMS configuration repository
INC_561.description: I need Level 1 commit access to the WMS configuration repository so I can start pushing route and inventory script updates. I've attached my SSH public key for authentication, and my login is my Westfield Logistics email address. I have read, and agree to abide by, the WMS Access Requirements.
INC_561.worknotes: The caller's supervisor vouched for them, and the access team verified the SSH key on file matched the attached key before adding the caller to the WMS Level 1 commit group.
INC_561.resolution_notes: Level 1 commit access was granted to the WMS configuration repository; the caller was told to log out and back into the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com to refresh permissions for web-based WMS tools, and was pointed to the setup guide on the company intranet for configuring SSH access to push updates.
INC_561.close_notes: The caller confirmed everything was working as needed.

INC_562.short_description: Re-enable network share access after permission denied error in Westfield Drive
INC_562.description: My access to the shared route-planning folder seems to have been turned off. When I try to sync it through Westfield Drive I get a message saying permission denied. Can someone please turn my access back on?
INC_562.worknotes: The access team checked the caller's account and confirmed sync access to the network share had been disabled; the account was re-enabled and the caller was told Westfield Drive requires sign-in with the full company email address rather than a short username. Caller's account was re-enabled for network share sync, and after signing in to Westfield Drive with the full email address the permission denied error stopped occurring.

INC_563.short_description: WMS Level 3 access request for a Dallas DC dispatcher
INC_563.description: I need Level 3 access in the Warehouse Management System so I can process inventory override adjustments for my team. I've read and agree to follow the WMS Elevated Access requirements. Let me know if you need anything else from me to get this approved.
INC_563.worknotes: Two team leads vouched for the caller's request; the ticket was escalated to the access team's WMS provisioning queue for a second verification before the higher tier was granted.
INC_563.resolution_notes: WMS Level 3 access was granted, which includes the underlying Level 1 and Level 2 permissions; the change can take up to an hour to propagate, and the caller was asked to log out and back into the SSO portal afterward.

INC_564.short_description: Level 1 WMS role access request for new dispatch analytics hire
INC_564.description: Requesting Level 1 WMS access for our new hire, who will be working on dispatch route performance testing projects. Their manager can vouch for them, and a colleague on the team is also willing to vouch. Let us know what else is needed to get this approved.
INC_564.worknotes: Agent logged the vouches from the manager and a colleague, then advised the caller that the outstanding WMS elevated-access acknowledgment steps needed to be completed before the Level 1 role could be provisioned.
INC_564.resolution_notes: Caller confirmed they had read and agreed to abide by the WMS Access Requirements, and Level 1 WMS access was provisioned for the new hire.

INC_565.short_description: Request for Level 1 write access to WMS integration scripts repository
INC_565.description: I'd like to request Level 1 access to the WMS integration scripts repository so I can start submitting changes. I've attached my SSH public key and I've read and agree to abide by the access requirements.
INC_565.worknotes: Access team held the request pending peer vouching; two senior WMS integration developers confirmed the caller has been actively contributing scripts to the warehouse slotting automation and inbound receiving scan projects. Agent asked the caller to confirm their last name to verify identity before provisioning. After identity was confirmed and both peer vouches were logged, the access team provisioned Level 1 write access to the WMS integration scripts repository using the submitted SSH key.

INC_566.short_description: Reactivate disabled Warehouse Management System account
INC_566.description: The caller asks the service desk to reactivate their Warehouse Management System login, saying it appears to have been deactivated and they can no longer sign in.
INC_566.worknotes: Agent located the caller's WMS account and confirmed it was flagged inactive. Agent re-enabled the account flag in the Warehouse Management System; access should now be restored.

INC_567.short_description: Restore Warehouse Management System access for dispatcher account
INC_567.description: I tried to log into WMS this morning to pull my shift's load report and got an access denied message. This login has always worked for me before, so I think my account access got turned off somehow. Can someone check and get it working again?
INC_567.worknotes: Agent checked with the WMS access team and found the caller's warehouse role had been deactivated on the account, and requested it be reinstated. The access team re-enabled the caller's WMS role, restoring their account access.

INC_568.short_description: Reinstate contractor account with Level 3 WMS access for returning driver
INC_568.description: I haven't contributed in a while, but I'd like to start submitting shipment corrections through the WMS again. I'm currently working on a load record and want to use the WMS test environment to validate it, and I still have the VPN security key from my last access grant. I no longer have access to my old Westfield email account, so I can use my personal email on file, or verify with my driver portal login instead.
INC_568.worknotes: Agent confirmed the caller's original Westfield email account was deactivated and could not be reused, then began setting up a new contractor account under the caller's personal email with baseline WMS access restored. The access team created the contractor account with the caller's personal email, and after checking with a senior teammate, upgraded the access level to match the caller's prior role based on existing vouches.

INC_569.short_description: Request to grant WMS ticket edit permission to a warehouse associate
INC_569.description: The caller asks that a fellow warehouse associate be granted edit permissions on WMS work orders. They note the associate has already worked on or contributed to a couple of prior WMS tickets as evidence they should have edit rights.
INC_569.worknotes: Agent reviewed the two referenced WMS work orders to confirm the associate's prior contributions before processing the request. Edit-level WMS role was granted to the associate's account so they can update work orders directly.

INC_570.short_description: Subdomain takeover: VDI image-hosting hostname points to a deleted storage bucket
INC_570.description: I found that vdiimages.westfieldlogistics.com is still pointing to a cloud storage bucket that Westfield no longer owns, which means anyone could claim it and serve content under our domain. I registered the bucket myself and posted a test page to prove it: http://vdiimages.westfieldlogistics.com/takeover.html. This needs the DNS record removed so it can't be used for phishing or hosting malicious content.
INC_570.worknotes: The access team confirmed the report and checked prior tickets, finding the same hostname had been flagged once before and closed as invalid because the storage was still in active use at that time.
INC_570.resolution_notes: The storage bucket had since been deleted as part of a Citrix VDI golden image refresh, leaving the DNS entry dangling; the network team removed the CNAME record for vdiimages.westfieldlogistics.com and agreed to add DNS cleanup as a required step in future decommission checklists.
INC_570.close_notes: The agent confirmed with the caller that the DNS record was removed and the exposure was closed.

INC_571.short_description: Rename WMS ticket routing category and update triage owner
INC_571.description: I'd like to update the ticket routing category we use for automation testing requests in WMS. Please rename it to 'Automation Testing', update the description so it covers automated test script issues and any team requests that don't fit anywhere else (individual test target issues should still go to their own categories), clear the default assignee, and set the triage owner to our automation testing lead. Let me know if you need anything else - thanks!
INC_571.worknotes: The agent located the routing category in the WMS admin console and applied the rename, updated the description, cleared the default assignee, and set the new triage owner.
INC_571.resolution_notes: The WMS ticket routing category was renamed to 'Automation Testing' with the updated description, no default assignee, and the automation testing lead set as triage owner.

INC_572.short_description: Point wms-api.westfieldlogistics.com to new WMS backend server
INC_572.description: The new backend server for the Warehouse Management System API is already live internally and has its SSL certificate configured for wms-api.westfieldlogistics.com. It just needs the internal DNS record created so traffic can start routing to it.
INC_572.worknotes: The access team created the internal DNS record for the hostname and pointed it at the new WMS backend server. Internal DNS was updated so wms-api.westfieldlogistics.com resolves to the new backend server; caller was told to allow up to 30 minutes for propagation.

INC_573.short_description: Level 1 access to WMS test environment - SSH key attached, needs vouching
INC_573.description: I've attached my SSH public key and would like Level 1 access to the WMS test environment so I can start pushing test changes. I've read and agree to the access requirements, and a colleague on the team already vouched for me. Let me know if you need anything else from me.
INC_573.worknotes: Since the request only listed a login email, the agent asked the caller to confirm their first and last name before proceeding, and the caller replied with both. Once identity was confirmed, the access team granted Level 1 access to the WMS test environment using the submitted SSH key.

INC_574.short_description: WMS staging access disabled after months of inactivity
INC_574.description: I used to have push access to the WMS staging/test bench under my account, but when I tried connecting today it said access was disabled because I hadn't logged in for a few months. This is the same access that was set up for me a while back - could someone re-enable it? Test bench access enabled please :)
INC_574.worknotes: Agent confirmed the caller's account was still active in the directory and had previously been granted level 1 WMS staging access via an earlier provisioning request, but the role had been auto-disabled after 90+ days without a login. The access team reinstated the caller's WMS role (level 1) and asked them to log out and back into the SSO portal to confirm access was restored.

INC_575.short_description: Level 1 access request for engineering network share
INC_575.description: I need Level 1 write access to the network share our warehouse scripting team uses for WMS deployment scripts. I've attached my SSH public key and I agree to abide by the access requirements.
INC_575.worknotes: A teammate vouched for the caller, confirming they work on the Dallas WMS integrations team; the access team verified the request and added the caller's SSH key to their account.
INC_575.resolution_notes: The access team added the caller's SSH key and granted Level 1 access to the network share, and pointed them to the setup guide on intranet.westfieldlogistics.com; propagation across systems can take up to an hour.

INC_576.short_description: Update triage owner for WMS General queue
INC_576.description: The team lead who handles triage for the WMS General queue is changing. Can someone update the queue so incoming issues route to the new lead instead of the outgoing one?
INC_576.worknotes: Agent located the General queue configuration in the WMS admin console and verified the outgoing lead's current assignment before making the change. Updated the triage owner field on the WMS General queue from the outgoing lead to the incoming lead.

INC_577.short_description: WMS Level 3 role escalation for senior dispatcher duties
INC_577.description: I completed WMS Level 1 training and already have Level 1 access from an earlier request. To take on senior dispatcher duties like reversing shipment holds and correcting cycle counts, I need my WMS role escalated to Level 3. My shift lead is willing to vouch for me as well.
INC_577.worknotes: Confirmed the caller's existing WMS Level 1 access and the shift lead's vouch, then flagged that future WMS role escalation requests should be submitted through the correct WMS Access Request category so the access team is notified directly.
INC_577.resolution_notes: The request stayed open pending a required sign-off step from the access checklist that had not been completed yet; the access team was waiting on that before the Level 3 WMS role could be finalized.
INC_577.close_notes: Let the caller know the outstanding sign-off step was the only remaining item before their WMS role could be upgraded.

INC_578.short_description: New account and share access needed for incoming summer intern
INC_578.description: Our summer intern starts next week working on the WMS reporting project out of the Chicago office. Can you set them up with an SSO Portal account and access to the project network share? Please send over the access agreement so they can send back their signed copy.
INC_578.worknotes: Confirmed the intern's manager agreed to the access policy and vouched for them, then provisioned an SSO Portal account with Level 1 network share access for the WMS reporting project folder. SSO Portal account and network share access were granted, and the temporary password was emailed directly to the intern.

INC_579.short_description: Reassign triage owner for WMS Inbound Freight queue
INC_579.description: Can someone update the triage owner on the Inbound Freight queue in the WMS? The person who used to own it moved to a different role a few weeks back, so new issues in that queue aren't getting picked up. It should go to the dispatch supervisor covering that queue now.
INC_579.worknotes: Agent opened the queue configuration in the WMS admin console, confirmed the incoming owner already had the correct WMS role assigned, and verified the outgoing owner no longer needed queue-level access. Updated the triage owner field on the Inbound Freight queue to the current dispatch supervisor so new tickets route correctly.

INC_580.short_description: Level 1 WMS integration access request with SSH key
INC_580.description: I've attached my SSH public key (id_ed25519.pub) and I'm requesting Level 1 access so I can push data through the WMS integration. My supervisor already agreed to vouch for me on this.
INC_580.worknotes: The access team confirmed the caller's manager had submitted a vouch for Level 1 access, then verified the SSH key on file matched the one attached to the request before granting the access tag.
INC_580.resolution_notes: Level 1 WMS integration access was granted after the manager's vouch and the SSH key match were confirmed, and the caller was pointed to the setup guide on intranet.westfieldlogistics.com for connecting via SFTP.

INC_581.short_description: New Dispatcher Needs WMS Application Access (Level 1)
INC_581.description: I've read and agree to the Warehouse Management System access policy that was sent to me. My manager has vouched for this request, so could you set up my WMS login so I can start working?
INC_581.worknotes: Confirmed the caller's manager had vouched for the request, then added the caller's account to the WMS Level 1 role group and issued system login credentials.
INC_581.resolution_notes: WMS Level 1 access was granted; the caller was told it could take up to an hour to propagate and to log out and back into the SSO portal at otp.westfieldlogistics.com to pick up the new permissions.

INC_582.short_description: WMS route-sync integration access request (SSH key)
INC_582.description: I need push access to the WMS route-sync repository so I can update route files directly. My manager has already vouched for the request, and I've read and agree to the WMS Application access requirements — my SSH public key is attached.
INC_582.worknotes: Agent granted the WMS integration role, emailed the caller their initial credentials, and added the attached SSH key to the account, noting it could take up to an hour to sync across all WMS servers; the agent also pointed the caller to the SSH setup guide on intranet.westfieldlogistics.com. The ticket log ends without a confirmed fix: after the SSH key was added, the caller reported getting a 'Bad passphrase' error when connecting to wms.westfieldlogistics.com despite entering the correct passphrase, and no cause was captured before the log stops.

INC_583.short_description: Restore WMS staging access after inactivity lockout
INC_583.description: It's been more than six months since I last submitted anything to the WMS staging environment, and it looks like my access got deactivated because of that. Could you reactivate it for me? Thanks for the help!
INC_583.worknotes: Agent confirmed the caller's account had been auto-disabled under the six-month WMS inactivity policy and re-enabled the staging access role.
INC_583.resolution_notes: WMS staging access was reactivated for the caller's account.

INC_584.short_description: WMS Level 1 access request for new Dallas DC warehouse associate
INC_584.description: I've read and agree to abide by the WMS access requirements. Requesting Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System so I can start logging inventory movements at the Dallas distribution centre. My supervisor can vouch for me.
INC_584.worknotes: Caller's supervisor vouched for the request; the access team created the WMS account, assigned the Level 1 role, and uploaded the caller's access key after converting it to the required format.
INC_584.resolution_notes: WMS account was provisioned with the Level 1 role and the access key uploaded; caller received an email with preliminary credentials and setup instructions once the change propagated (up to 1 hour).

INC_585.short_description: Grant WMS record-edit role for dispatch associate
INC_585.description: Requesting that the record-edit role in the WMS be granted to one of our dispatch associates. They've already worked on two shipment tickets that needed edits beyond their own submissions, and I'd like their account updated so they can keep making those changes.
INC_585.worknotes: Agent checked the two referenced WMS tickets to confirm the associate had already contributed to them before submitting the role change. The access team updated the associate's account to include the WMS record-edit role.

INC_586.short_description: WMS Level 1 access request for new warehouse associate
INC_586.description: I'm requesting Level 1 access to the Warehouse Management System. I'll use my Westfield Logistics email as my login. I've read the WMS access requirements and agree to abide by them.
INC_586.worknotes: The caller's supervisor vouched for the request, so the access team provisioned a WMS account with the Level 1 role, an SSO login, and an internal system credential.
INC_586.resolution_notes: Level 1 WMS access was granted and a temporary password was emailed to the caller; the caller confirmed they were able to log in.

INC_587.short_description: WMS Level 1 access setup for new Dallas warehouse associate
INC_587.description: I just started on the floor at the Dallas distribution center and need Level 1 access to the WMS so I can start scanning and picking orders. I've attached the public key for my handheld scanner so it can authenticate against the system, and I've read and agree to the WMS Access Policy.
INC_587.worknotes: The caller's supervisor vouched for the request, so the access team created the network account, assigned the WMS Level 1 role, and registered the scanner's device key. Account was provisioned with WMS Level 1 access and the device key added; the caller was emailed initial credentials along with a link to the intranet setup guide for configuring the handheld scanner login, noting the key can take up to an hour to propagate across warehouse systems.

INC_588.short_description: Restore Warehouse Management System access for the caller
INC_588.description: Please restore my Warehouse Management System access. Thanks!
INC_588.worknotes: The access team checked the caller's account and found WMS access had been disabled; access was re-enabled.
INC_588.resolution_notes: WMS access was re-enabled for the caller's account.

INC_589.short_description: Restore Warehouse Management System access for caller
INC_589.description: The caller asked the service desk to restore their access to the Warehouse Management System, noting it had worked previously and had since stopped. They provided their username so the access team could re-enable it. Thanks!
INC_589.worknotes: Agent checked the caller's WMS account and found access had been disabled; re-enabled it. The access team re-enabled the caller's Warehouse Management System account, restoring login access.

INC_590.short_description: WMS Application access (Level 1) requested for new warehouse associate
INC_590.description: I need Level 1 access to the WMS Application. My supervisor has vouched for me and I've read and agree to the WMS access policy. Thanks.
INC_590.worknotes: The access team confirmed sponsor approval from the caller's supervisor and noted that future access requests like this should go through the Account Provisioning request form instead of a general ticket. Level 1 WMS Application access was provisioned with the associated network share, and a temporary password was sent to the caller's email.

INC_591.short_description: Request to grant WMS edit access for a warehouse associate
INC_591.description: I'd like to request the WMS edit/contributor role for one of our warehouse associates so they can update shipment records directly instead of routing changes through me. They've already contributed corrections on two prior shipment records, and their supervisor vouched for them on a separate access request. Please approve when you can.
INC_591.worknotes: Agent reviewed the two shipment records the associate had contributed to and confirmed the supervisor's vouch noted on the related request, then forwarded the request to the access team for provisioning.
INC_591.resolution_notes: The access team granted the associate's account the WMS Application edit/contributor role.
INC_591.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that the associate's WMS edit access is active and working.

INC_592.short_description: WMS application access request for summer intern on integration project
INC_592.description: I'm vouching for our summer intern, who needs WMS application access to work on the load-tracking and shipment sync integration project. I've attached their SSH public key for setup and they've read and agreed to the system access requirements.
INC_592.worknotes: Agent confirmed the vouching request from the intern's manager, reviewed the attached public key and signed access agreement, then provisioned the account with WMS write access and registered the key.
INC_592.resolution_notes: Granted WMS application role access and registered the SSH key for authenticated access; the manager was told it could take up to an hour to propagate, with setup instructions posted on the intranet.
INC_592.close_notes: Caller thanked the agent and confirmed access was working; ticket closed with instructions to reopen if any issues came up.

INC_593.short_description: WMS login setup for new seasonal warehouse associate
INC_593.description: I'm starting as a seasonal warehouse associate at the Dallas distribution centre this summer and need a Warehouse Management System login created for me. I've read and agree to the WMS access policy.
INC_593.worknotes: Confirmed with the caller's supervisor that they were a summer hire on the team and could vouch for the access request. Granted the caller a Level 1 WMS operator role; noted that new permissions can take up to an hour to sync across WMS and the SSO portal.

INC_594.short_description: Level 1 WMS access request for warehouse associate
INC_594.description: I've read and agree to abide by the WMS access requirements, and I've attached the public key for my handheld scanner login as requested. What are the next steps to get this approved?
INC_594.worknotes: Agent checked the WMS access policy on intranet.westfieldlogistics.com and confirmed the request needed a Level 3 WMS user to vouch for the caller before Level 1 access could be provisioned. A Level 3 WMS supervisor vouched for the caller, and Level 1 WMS access was granted.

INC_595.short_description: New hire Level 1 access setup for WMS, network share, and VPN Client
INC_595.description: Requesting Level 1 system access for a new dispatcher joining the Dallas distribution center. I've attached the SSH public key for VPN Client authentication and confirm I've read and agree to the Westfield access requirements policy.
INC_595.worknotes: The caller's manager vouched for the new hire before the access team proceeded; the agent then provisioned the network share and WMS role, added the SSH key to the Westfield VPN Client, and created the SSO portal account. Access team granted the network share and WMS role, enabled VPN Client access with the submitted SSH key, and emailed a temporary password to the caller with instructions to confirm access.

INC_596.short_description: Update DNS records for labelcheck.westfieldlogistics.com after hosting migration
INC_596.description: The caller, migrating the labelcheck.westfieldlogistics.com tool off its old application host and onto a static-page host, asked the network team to point the root domain to four new IPv4 addresses and to make www.labelcheck.westfieldlogistics.com a CNAME to the root domain.
INC_596.worknotes: The agent updated the A records for labelcheck.westfieldlogistics.com to the four IPv4 addresses provided and set www.labelcheck.westfieldlogistics.com as a CNAME pointing to the root domain. DNS records were updated as requested; the agent noted propagation can take up to 30 minutes.

INC_597.short_description: Restore WMS incident ticket commenting permission for a contributor
INC_597.description: I used to be able to add comments on incident tickets in the Warehouse Management System, but I'm no longer able to comment on this one. I have some information to contribute about it.
INC_597.worknotes: The access team confirmed the caller had previously added useful comments on two other WMS incident tickets and verified they should retain that ability, then updated their WMS role to include commenter access. The caller's WMS account role was updated to restore comment permissions on incident tickets.

INC_598.short_description: SSO Portal access request for internal session tool (dev environment)
INC_598.description: I'm the service owner for an internal session management tool we're standing up in our test environment, and I'd like it wired into the Westfield SSO Portal. The hostname is session-tools-dev.westfieldlogistics.com with a callback to /callback, no session refresh needed, and only members of our security access group should be able to log in. We expect five to fifteen users total, logging in maybe once every few months.
INC_598.worknotes: Agent checked the directory and found the group name the caller gave doesn't exist, and suggested the actual group (secops-access) that covers the same team; caller confirmed that was fine. Agent sent the SSO credentials to the caller over an encrypted channel and opened a change request to add the secops-access rule to the SSO Portal configuration, which still needs review, approval, and deployment before login will work.

INC_599.short_description: Restore WMS login access disabled due to inactivity
INC_599.description: My Warehouse Management System account isn't letting me log in today. I think it's because I haven't used it in a few months — can someone restore my access so I can get back into WMS for my shift?
INC_599.worknotes: Agent verified the caller's identity in the SSO Portal and found the WMS login role had been auto-disabled after 90+ days without use; submitted a request to the access team to reinstate the role. The access team restored the caller's WMS application role and asked the caller to log out and back into the SSO Portal to pick up the change.

INC_600.short_description: Grant WMS edit/assign role to contractor supporting inventory reconciliation project
INC_600.description: We have a contractor helping out with the inventory reconciliation project at the Dallas distribution centre. Could you grant them edit and assign permissions in the WMS so they can update and take ownership of work orders? I'm sure they'll find editing and claiming tasks useful for the work.
INC_600.worknotes: Confirmed with the requesting supervisor that the contractor's involvement in the project warranted elevated WMS permissions, then had the access team apply the appropriate role to the contractor's existing account. The access team added the edit/assign role to the contractor's WMS account.

INC_601.short_description: New Westfield VPN Client access request (Level 1) for remote dispatcher role
INC_601.description: I've read and agree to abide by the Westfield VPN Client access requirements. I'm attaching my SSH public key so the certificate-based connection can be set up. Please let me know once access is active so I can start connecting remotely.
INC_601.worknotes: A colleague vouched for the caller's request; the access team provisioned Level 1 VPN Client access using the attached public key and added the caller to the corresponding network share group. VPN Client access (Level 1) was granted and a temporary password was emailed to the caller's Westfield account, with a request to confirm the connection worked.

INC_602.short_description: VPN Access Request to WMS Dispatch Console for New Dispatcher
INC_602.description: I'd like to request Westfield VPN Client access to the WMS dispatch console for one of our dispatchers. They just need access to the staging environment for now.
INC_602.worknotes: Agent added the dispatcher to the WMS access group and provisioned their account on the staging dispatch console. Access was granted to the staging WMS dispatch console and the account was added to the required WMS access group.

INC_603.short_description: Repoint internal hostname for network share cluster to specific IPs (again)
INC_603.description: I'm embarrassed about this because I've asked before, but I messed up again and need the internal hostname changed once more. Can you have shares.westfieldlogistics.com point to these IP addresses: 10.12.44.21, 10.12.44.22, 10.12.44.23, 10.12.44.24, instead of the CNAME record that's there now.
INC_603.worknotes: The access team located the existing CNAME record for the network share hostname and verified the four replacement IP addresses the caller provided before making the change. The access team removed the CNAME record and added A records pointing shares.westfieldlogistics.com to the four IP addresses supplied by the caller.

INC_604.short_description: Reactivate WMS account access for warehouse associate
INC_604.description: My WMS login got deactivated and I can't get into the system. Can you turn it back on so I can get back to work on the floor?
INC_604.worknotes: Agent located the caller's WMS account and reactivated it.
INC_604.resolution_notes: WMS application access was reactivated for the caller's account.

INC_605.short_description: Grant WMS record edit/confirm rights for warehouse associate based on past contributions
INC_605.description: Can you grant edit/confirm rights in the WMS to one of our warehouse associates? They've already helped resolve two exception reports in the system and need to be able to update and confirm records directly instead of routing every change through someone else.
INC_605.worknotes: Access team reviewed the associate's account and confirmed their prior activity on the two referenced WMS exception records before making the change. Edit/confirm permissions were added to the associate's WMS account.

INC_606.short_description: Restore Level 3 WMS configuration access for staging environment
INC_606.description: I'm starting work on updates to the address autofill feature in the WMS, and I need my Level 3 configuration access restored so I can use the staging environment. My original Level 3 access was granted under a previous access request.
INC_606.worknotes: The access team confirmed the account already had the Level 3 WMS configuration role assigned and re-enabled staging environment access accordingly.
INC_606.resolution_notes: Staging environment access was re-enabled for the account, which still holds the existing Level 3 WMS configuration role.

INC_607.short_description: VPN Client access request for new hire on Dallas dispatch team
INC_607.description: Requesting Level 1 VPN Client access so I can connect remotely for dispatch work out of the Dallas distribution center. I'll be using my Westfield email as the account login, and I've attached my public key for the connection. I've read and agree to the VPN Access Requirements.
INC_607.worknotes: A colleague vouched for the caller as a recent hire on the Dallas dispatch team, and the access team verified the request before provisioning the account with the attached key.
INC_607.resolution_notes: VPN Client access was granted, the caller's key was added to the account, and the account was placed in the correct access group. A temporary password was emailed to the caller's Westfield address.

INC_608.short_description: New hire access request: SSO Portal and WMS account provisioning - Dallas DC
INC_608.description: I need my new account set up so I can log into the SSO portal and the WMS at the Dallas distribution center. I'd like my login name to use my personal email format instead of the standard employee ID naming convention. I've read and agree to abide by the access requirements policy.
INC_608.worknotes: The caller's supervisor vouched for the request in the ticket thread, and the access team reviewed and approved the provisioning request.
INC_608.resolution_notes: The access team provisioned the SSO portal account with Level 1 WMS access and emailed a temporary password to the caller; the caller confirmed access was working.
INC_608.close_notes: Caller confirmed in the ticket that login access is working; ticket closed.

INC_609.short_description: WMS Level 1 access request for new Dallas warehouse analyst
INC_609.description: Requesting Level 1 access to the WMS application for my new role at the Dallas distribution centre. I've attached the public key for my assigned handheld scanner as required for authentication. I've read and agree to the WMS Access Requirements policy.
INC_609.worknotes: A shift supervisor vouched for the caller's request; the access team added the caller to the Dallas WMS user group, registered the attached scanner key, and granted WMS module access at Level 1. Account changes were applied and the caller was told to allow up to an hour for propagation, then log out of the SSO portal and back in to pick up the new WMS Level 1 permissions.

INC_610.short_description: Grant WMS order-edit permission for warehouse associate
INC_610.description: Requesting edit access to order records in the Warehouse Management System for one of my warehouse associates. They've handled work orders WH-46213, WH-58821, and WH-60347, so I think that's enough to justify giving them edit rights on order records.
INC_610.worknotes: Access team reviewed the manager's request and confirmed the associate's activity on the referenced work orders in the WMS before granting the role.
INC_610.resolution_notes: The access team granted the order-edit role in the WMS for the associate.

INC_611.short_description: Create new network share access group for automated WMS config deployment
INC_611.description: Can you create a new access group for the WMS configuration share? It'll own the folder that automatically deploys changes to the warehouse floor once they're checked in, and it needs to restrict who can push into the config-admin and config-deploy subfolders that trigger that automatic deployment. Please set the membership to match our existing IT Operations and Warehouse Systems support groups.
INC_611.worknotes: The access team created the new share group, confirmed the file servers picked it up through the standard permissions sync, and set initial membership to mirror the IT Operations and Warehouse Systems groups.
INC_611.resolution_notes: The new group was granted ownership of the config-admin and config-deploy subfolders on the WMS configuration share, with membership set to mirror the two requested support groups so access stays in sync automatically.
INC_611.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that the group was live and the right people had access.

INC_612.short_description: SSO Portal integration needed for dispatch tool staging site
INC_612.description: The caller reported that the staging site for the dispatch incident-response tool had been connected to an old SSO integration that was deleted without their knowledge. They asked for it to be reconnected with the same settings as the production version, just pointed at the staging callback URL, and asked whether it could be tied into the production SSO Portal tenant since only low traffic is expected. They noted a colleague is the service owner for the application and should receive the credentials.
INC_612.worknotes: An agent compared the production integration settings for the dispatch tool against the staging request and confirmed the callback URL and scopes with the SSO Portal admin team before provisioning. A new SSO Portal integration was created under the production tenant using the staging callback URL, and the credentials were sent directly to the service owner.

INC_613.short_description: Add two accounts to WMS direct-edit role for Dallas DC inbound queue
INC_613.description: Please add two of my team members to the WMS direct-edit role so they can make changes directly to the Dallas distribution center's inbound receiving queue, which I need for a project. The access team lead had previously said anyone on our team could just file a request and be granted this, but since she's since moved to a different team, I'm having my manager formally sign off here.
INC_613.worknotes: Agent added both accounts to the WMS direct-edit role group; flagged that it's unclear which downstream systems consume this role and that any SSO-linked access may take up to an hour to propagate.
INC_613.resolution_notes: Both accounts were granted the WMS direct-edit role; access through the SSO portal requires logging out and back in after about an hour for the sync to finish, but direct WMS terminal access took effect immediately.

INC_614.short_description: Add WMS account to dispatch-planning role group
INC_614.description: Please add my WMS account to the dispatch-planning role group so I can access the routing tools I need for my job.
INC_614.worknotes: Agent reviewed the request and added the account to the requested WMS role group. The account was added to the dispatch-planning role group in the Warehouse Management System.

INC_615.short_description: Request to self-edit own entries in WMS incident notes
INC_615.description: I found a typo and some sensitive customer details left in a note I filed in the WMS, but I can't fix it myself without special access. I don't understand why staff can't edit their own entries by default like other systems I've used allow. Can you explain the reasoning, and can I get that permission?
INC_615.worknotes: Agent reviewed the caller's account and escalated the request to the WMS access team to evaluate granting edit rights on the caller's own submitted entries.
INC_615.resolution_notes: The access team granted the caller an edit role scoped to their own WMS entries, noting that edit history is logged so misuse can still be traced.

INC_616.short_description: Add contractor to SSO Portal allow list for driver session-reset tool
INC_616.description: SSO access was recently set up for the driver session-reset tool on the SSO portal, restricted to the network-ops group. We have a contractor helping us test it who needs temporary access to some of the authenticated pages. Once testing wraps up, we'd like that access revoked.
INC_616.worknotes: The access team added the contractor's account to the network-ops allow list on otp.westfieldlogistics.com and confirmed the change was deployed; the caller then tried to verify access but hit a login error directing them to use their staff SSO credentials instead of the guest login option they had used.
INC_616.resolution_notes: The access team got on the phone with the caller and cleared cached SSO session cookies from their browser, which resolved the login loop; the likely cause was the browser not fully signing out of the alternate login provider despite the portal UI showing it had.

INC_617.short_description: VPN Client access needed for two new dispatch admins to reach WMS
INC_617.description: Can you add our two new warehouse operations administrators to the Westfield VPN Client access group so they can reach the WMS admin console remotely? They'll need this to manage shipping schedules from off-site. Thanks!
INC_617.worknotes: The access team added both accounts to the Westfield VPN Client access group tied to the WMS admin console. Access was granted for both administrators; they were told to disconnect and reconnect the Westfield VPN Client to pick up the new access.

INC_618.short_description: SSO Portal setup for internal Session Revocation Console
INC_618.description: I need SSO Portal credentials set up for our new Session Revocation Console, which runs in production at sessionrevocation.westfieldlogistics.com with a callback URL of sessionrevocation.westfieldlogistics.com/callback. I'm the service owner and would like otp.westfieldlogistics.com set as the only identity provider, with login restricted to members of the network security role. We expect five to fifteen users who will use it very infrequently, sessions should last only fifteen minutes with no session refresh, and credentials can be sent to me directly.
INC_618.worknotes: Agent registered the application in the SSO Portal, issued client credentials to the caller, and submitted the access-control change restricting login to the network security role, setting the ID token expiration to 900 seconds.
INC_618.resolution_notes: Ticket was closed once the access-control change was confirmed merged, since no one was available to verify further at the time.

INC_619.short_description: Grant WMS edit permissions for a team member
INC_619.description: Can someone give edit access in WMS to a colleague on the receiving dock? They've already been helping resolve open work orders in the system but only have read-only access right now. They've handled work orders 546052 and 506364 if that helps confirm they've been pitching in.
INC_619.worknotes: Agent checked the two referenced WMS work orders to confirm the team member's involvement, then updated their WMS role to include edit permissions.
INC_619.resolution_notes: The team member's WMS role was updated to grant edit access.
INC_619.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that the new permissions were showing correctly.

INC_620.short_description: Grant WMS discrepancy-report edit access for a Dallas DC associate
INC_620.description: Please grant edit access in the WMS for one of our associates at the Dallas distribution center. They've already worked on a couple of shipment discrepancy records (SD-40881 and SD-41056) and need full edit rights so they can keep helping resolve open cases.
INC_620.worknotes: Checked the two discrepancy records the caller referenced and confirmed the associate had contributed to both, then updated the associate's WMS role to include edit permissions.
INC_620.resolution_notes: WMS role updated to grant discrepancy-report edit rights for the associate.

INC_621.short_description: Request to grant WMS edit permissions for a warehouse associate
INC_621.description: Requesting edit permissions in the WMS for one of our warehouse associates. They've already been contributing to shipment records — for example order #48213 and order #50877 — so it would help to move them from view-only to full edit access.
INC_621.worknotes: Agent checked the WMS activity history against the two order records the caller cited to confirm the associate had genuinely been working in those records, then applied the elevated role.
INC_621.resolution_notes: Elevated edit permissions were granted to the associate's WMS account.
INC_621.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that the permission change was live and thanked them for the details.

INC_622.short_description: Grant WMS edit-role access to warehouse associate
INC_622.description: Requesting that a warehouse associate be granted edit-role access in the WMS application. As justification, the associate has worked on WMS records for shipments #48213 and #51867.
INC_622.worknotes: Agent verified the associate's account in the WMS application and confirmed the two shipment records cited as justification for the elevated role.
INC_622.resolution_notes: Edit-role permissions for the WMS application were granted to the associate's account.

INC_623.description: I'm requesting the task-assignment permission in the WMS so I can claim picking and packing orders myself, since a couple of times now two of us have ended up working the same order by accident. I've already handled orders 48213, 48877, and 49102, and my shift lead pointed me to this form when I asked about getting the permission.
INC_623.worknotes: Access team verified the caller's WMS account and confirmed the requested permission matched their warehouse role before applying the change.
INC_623.resolution_notes: Task-assignment permission was granted on the caller's WMS account.

INC_624.short_description: Subdomain found pointing to an openly listable/readable network share
INC_624.description: While going through the subdomains of westfieldlogistics.com I found one, reports.westfieldlogistics.com, that points to a cloud storage container I could list and read every file in using the CLI. I tried uploading a file to it but that failed. A couple of other subdomains show the same bad configuration.
INC_624.worknotes: An agent logged the report and routed it to the network team for verification, but it wasn't picked up right away.
INC_624.resolution_notes: When someone followed up, the storage container behind that subdomain had already been taken offline as part of an unrelated decommissioning effort, so no separate fix was needed here.

INC_625.short_description: Request for edit and tagging permissions in Warehouse Management System
INC_625.description: I'd like to request edit and tag permissions in the WMS application for my account. I've been the one filing discrepancy notes on several loads at the Dallas distribution centre, including a couple of tickets from when the system was first rolled out, and I keep running into cases where I can't add tags to notes on shipment records, which would help when flagging repeat issues on a route. I also do some light scripting against our internal tools, so I understand how the record permissions are structured.
INC_625.worknotes: Agent verified the caller's WMS account and reviewed their history of shipment discrepancy entries before escalating the role change to the access team.
INC_625.resolution_notes: The access team granted the caller edit and tagging rights on shipment and load records in WMS.

INC_626.short_description: Grant WMS exception-editor role to former employee's personal account
INC_626.description: I'm asking that the exception-editor role in WMS be granted to my personal email account. I used to work at Westfield Logistics and now work for a different logistics partner, but I'd still like to help cross-reference shipment exception tickets, including linking related exceptions reported through our partner's system. Here are two WMS exception tickets I've worked on before as reference.
INC_626.worknotes: The access team checked the two referenced WMS exception tickets and confirmed prior contributions from the caller's account before granting the role. The exception-editor role was granted to the caller's personal account in WMS.

INC_627.short_description: Grant WMS record-edit permissions for a warehouse associate
INC_627.description: Requesting that WMS editor-level access be granted to one of our warehouse associates.
