INC_627.worknotes: The access team reviewed the associate's recent WMS submission history and confirmed a consistent track record of accurate edits on the flagged order and inventory records before approving the change.

INC_627.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that the new WMS permissions were active and thanked them for flagging the associate's contributions.

INC_628.short_description: Request edit permission for WMS exception reports I've filed
INC_628.description: Can you please grant me edit rights on the WMS for entries I've filed? Every once in a while I need to go back and correct typos or fix dependencies on exception reports I've submitted.
INC_628.worknotes: Agent reviewed the caller's WMS activity history to confirm the exception reports filed under their account.
INC_628.resolution_notes: Access team granted the caller edit permission on WMS exception reports they filed.
INC_628.close_notes: Thanked the caller and confirmed the new edit permission was applied to their account.

INC_629.short_description: Request to grant WMS record-edit permission
INC_629.description: I'd like to request the edit-records permission in the WMS for my own account. I've already had two inventory correction tickets approved with supervisor sign-off, so I think that shows I can be trusted to make these edits myself instead of routing them through someone else.
INC_629.worknotes: Access team confirmed the two referenced correction tickets had supervisor approval on file before granting the additional WMS role.
INC_629.resolution_notes: WMS edit-records permission was added to the caller's account based on the two previously approved correction tickets.
INC_629.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that they can now edit records directly in WMS.

INC_630.short_description: Request to enable WMS shipment-record edit permission
INC_630.description: My supervisor already okayed this on the note from our last ticket, and you can see in my WMS activity log that I've been covering these shipment-record edits for the Dallas team anyway. INC_630.resolution_notes: Agent enabled the shipment record-edit role on the caller's WMS account.
INC_630.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that WMS edit access is now active and working as expected.

INC_631.short_description: Dispatcher requests edit access to WMS shipment records
INC_631.description: Hi, I help out with shipment tracking for the Portland branch and occasionally spot typos or missing cross-references in the WMS records. INC_631.worknotes: Access team confirmed the caller's role with their manager and verified that occasional record edits were appropriate for their position. Edit permissions were added to the caller's WMS account so they can correct shipment records and link related work orders directly.

INC_632.short_description: Request edit access to correct own submitted WMS exception reports
INC_632.description: I regularly file inventory exception reports in the WMS for the Dallas distribution centre, and it would help to be able to edit them afterward - I sometimes need to fix a typo or add a detail I missed when I first submitted the report.

INC_632.resolution_notes: Edit permission for self-submitted WMS exception reports was added to the caller's account.
INC_632.close_notes: Thanks for your reports - permission updated, you're all set.

INC_633.short_description: Grant edit permissions to WMS integration service account

INC_633.resolution_notes: The access team granted the service account edit permissions in the WMS; the automated status updates are now posting correctly.

INC_634.short_description: WMS edit access for former employee supporting Dallas regional documentation team
INC_634.description: I'm former Westfield Logistics staff, but I'm still working with the Dallas distribution center's Spanish-language documentation team in a volunteer capacity. INC_635.short_description: Request to restore WMS exception-ticket edit permission after email change
INC_635.description: Hi, I recently switched my WMS login from my westfieldlogistics.com address to a personal email and it looks like that stripped my edit permissions. INC_636.short_description: Request to upgrade WMS access from view-only to editor role
INC_636.description: Can you please give me edit rights in the WMS? I've been submitting inventory correction requests for months now and it would be a lot faster if I could just make the changes myself instead of routing them through someone else each time.
INC_636.worknotes: Agent reviewed the caller's WMS activity log and confirmed a consistent history of submitted correction requests going back to earlier in the year. Upgraded the caller's WMS role from view-only to editor, allowing them to update inventory and shipment records directly.

INC_637.short_description: Dangling DNS record allows subdomain takeover of assets.westfieldlogistics.com
INC_637.description: I found that assets.westfieldlogistics.com still has a DNS CNAME pointing to an Amazon CloudFront distribution that's no longer claimed by your company, so I was able to register that distribution myself and serve my own content under your subdomain (I've got a harmless test page up right now as proof). I wanted to flag that this could also be used to get a real SSL certificate issued for the subdomain, turning it into a full HTTPS takeover, but I stopped short of doing that part.
INC_637.worknotes: An agent verified the report, confirmed the CNAME was still resolving to an unclaimed CloudFront distribution, and escalated to the network/infrastructure team to review the record's ownership status. The infrastructure team was assigned to investigate and remove the stale CNAME; no follow-up confirming the record had been cleaned up was logged before the ticket was closed.

INC_638.short_description: Edit access needed for own WMS exception report comments
INC_638.description: I'm working on some cross-dock exception handling in the WMS and I filed an exception report earlier. I need edit access so I can update my own comments on it. It would be great to get that access when you have a chance, thanks.
INC_638.worknotes: Agent checked whether the WMS edit role needed manager sign-off; a supervisor offered to vouch for it anyway, and the access team reviewed the account.
INC_638.resolution_notes: WMS edit permissions were added to the caller's account so they can update their own report comments.
INC_638.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that they could now edit their comments; caller thanked the team for the quick turnaround.

INC_639.short_description: Request for WMS record-edit permissions based on contribution history
INC_639.description: I've submitted a number of corrections to shipment and inventory records in WMS over the past couple of months and it would be handy to have edit permissions directly instead of routing each change through someone else.

INC_640.short_description: VPN access group needed to submit shipments through WMS

Could I be added to the same Westfield VPN Client access group as one of my teammates on the dispatch team so I can get this working? Thanks in advance.

INC_641.short_description: VPN group access needed to publish WMS handheld app update
INC_641.description: I'd like to publish the new handheld scanner update for the warehouse app through our deployment tool, but that seems to require some permissions. I found out access is now handled through VPN groups - could you add me to the same group as my colleague who already ships these updates? Thanks in advance.
INC_641.worknotes: Agent confirmed that deployment access to the release tool is now managed entirely through Westfield VPN Client groups rather than individual approvals, and identified which access group the caller's colleague belonged to.
INC_641.resolution_notes: Added the caller's account to the same Westfield VPN Client access group as their colleague, granting permission to publish through the deployment tool.

INC_642.short_description: Grant WMS edit access for a colleague
INC_642.description: The caller asked the access team to grant edit-level access in the WMS for a colleague on their team, since that colleague has been helping triage and correct shipment records. They listed two shipment records the colleague had recently worked on as evidence of the contributions, and mentioned they'd submitted the request a bit too soon while still filling it in.
INC_642.worknotes: An agent reviewed the two shipment records the caller referenced, and the colleague's manager vouched for the ongoing triage work, noting they'd also been following several other shipments.
INC_642.resolution_notes: The access team granted the colleague edit access in the WMS application.

INC_643.short_description: Request WMS editor role for a colleague currently limited to comment-only access
INC_643.description: Can you grant full edit permissions in the WMS Application for one of our warehouse associates? They've already contributed to a couple of shipment records, but on three others they wanted to correct the information and could only leave a comment because they don't have edit rights. Thanks!
INC_643.worknotes: Agent reviewed the referenced WMS shipment records to confirm the associate's prior contributions, then updated their WMS account role to grant edit permissions.
INC_643.resolution_notes: The associate's WMS role was updated from comment-only to editor, letting them update shipment records directly instead of adding comments.
INC_643.close_notes: Caller confirmed the new edit access was working and thanked the agent for the quick turnaround.

INC_644.short_description: Request for edit access to WMS exception ticket descriptions
INC_644.description: Hi, I'd like to request edit permissions on Warehouse Management System exception tickets so I can clean up ticket descriptions, like adding spacing or formatting when reference numbers get run together. I mainly work inbound exceptions at the Dallas distribution centre. I can point to tickets where I've attached corrected notes, plus a few where I wanted to fix the description directly but couldn't, so I left a comment instead.
INC_644.worknotes: Agent reviewed the two WMS exception tickets where the caller had attached corrected notes and the ticket where they left a comment instead of editing the description directly, confirming a consistent pattern of formatting fixes.
INC_644.resolution_notes: Access team granted the caller the WMS ticket-editor role.
INC_644.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that they can now edit WMS exception ticket descriptions directly.

INC_645.short_description: New hire requesting WMS access to deploy driver check-in surveys
INC_645.description: Hi, I'm a new hire and I'd like access to the Warehouse Management System so I can deploy driver check-in surveys going forward. Let me know if you need any more information from me. Hope this is the right place, thank you!
INC_645.worknotes: Followed up with the caller to clarify exactly what access was being requested and what the surveys were for, then added the WMS role needed to create and edit driver check-in surveys. Edit access to driver check-in surveys in WMS was confirmed working; the caller's test survey could not be removed since WMS does not support deleting published survey campaigns, so it was left in place with a note to use the staging environment for future testing.

INC_646.short_description: Delegated DNS for vendor.westfieldlogistics.com points to an unclaimed external host
INC_646.description: While enumerating hostnames under westfieldlogistics.com, I found that vendor.westfieldlogistics.com still delegates to an external DNS hosting provider that nobody currently has an account with. I signed up for about $10 and put a test page live to prove the zone could be taken over. Whoever controls that hosting account can point vendor.westfieldlogistics.com anywhere they like, including a fake copy of the SSO portal login page, and can issue valid SSL certificates for it.
INC_646.worknotes: An agent pulled up the test page and confirmed the subdomain really was resolving to the caller's hosting account, then looped in network engineering to trace who had originally set up the old vendor portal and why the delegation was never removed. Network engineering traced the subdomain back to a discontinued vendor portal project, but the ticket closed before the stale DNS delegation was removed or the external hosting account reclaimed.

INC_647.short_description: Request to grant WMS edit permissions for a colleague based on contribution history

The caller is asking the access team to review the activity and update the colleague's role accordingly.
INC_647.worknotes: Agent reviewed the two referenced WMS order records to confirm the colleague's contribution history before approving the elevated role.
INC_647.resolution_notes: The colleague's WMS role was updated to include edit permissions based on their demonstrated contribution history.

INC_648.short_description: SSO setup request for new freight-rate analytics vendor account

The vendor has assigned us a project coordinator and sent over a technical questionnaire to speed up the configuration. Can someone from the access team pick this up and work with them directly?

INC_649.close_notes: Caller acknowledged the update and asked to be notified either by email or on the ticket once FleetIQ responds.

INC_650.short_description: Warehouse associate requests edit access to WMS issue tickets

INC_652.short_description: Request to grant WMS edit permissions for warehouse associate
INC_652.description: Can we get WMS edit permissions granted to one of our warehouse associates? INC_652.close_notes: Confirmed with the caller that the new WMS edit permissions are working as expected.

INC_654.short_description: Grant WMS record edit access for a warehouse associate with shipment history

INC_658.short_description: Request for edit access to own submitted WMS exception reports
